docs.title: Field Properties
docs.text: Each field of a DocType is a DocField row with properties such as reqd, default or depends_on. This page explains how the main properties behave on the desk and on the server. Use it when you design a DocType or debug why a rule does not apply. For the full list of properties with types and defaults, read DocField Properties. For fieldtypes, read Field Types.

docs.title: Where the rule runs
docs.text:
Many properties are desk rules only. A REST call, frappe.get_doc(...).insert() or a data import does not check them. This table shows where each rule runs. "Server" means Document.insert() and Document.save().

Property Desk Server reqd Blocks save, marks the label Raises frappe.MandatoryError mandatory_depends_on Blocks save when the condition is true Not checked depends_on, read_only_depends_on, collapsible_depends_on Evaluated Not evaluated hidden Field not shown Not checked read_only Value shown as text Not checked. API writes are saved. set_only_once Read-only after insert Raises frappe.CannotChangeConstantError allow_on_submit Editable after submit Other fields raise frappe.UpdateAfterSubmitError unique - Unique index. Raises frappe.UniqueValidationError. non_negative - Raises frappe.NonNegativeError min_value, max_value - Raises frappe.ValidationError length - Raises frappe.CharacterLengthExceededError permlevel Read or write per role Values reset on save, removed on read fetch_from Copies on link change Copies on save link_filters Filters the dropdown Not checked default Set on new form Set on insert

docs.title: fieldname
docs.text:
• The column name in tab<DocType> and the key in the document.
  • If fieldname is empty, the DocType save makes it from label: strip, lowercase, spaces to _, ? removed. Section, Column and Tab Breaks get the suffix _section, _column or _tab.
  • The save removes these characters: ' " , . / % @ ( ) < > { }. Then it lowercases the name.
  • A name with other non-word characters raises frappe.db.InvalidColumnName.
  • The maximum length is 64 characters. On Postgres it is 63 bytes.
  • These names are restricted: name, parent, creation, owner, modified, modified_by, parentfield, parenttype, file_list, flags, docstatus. A typed name raises InvalidFieldNameError. A name made from a label gets the suffix 1, for example owner1.
  • SQL reserved words (RESERVED_KEYWORDS in frappe/model/__init__.py) are not allowed. autoname is reserved in all DocTypes except DocType.
  • Fieldnames must be unique in a DocType.

docs.title: Label, description and help
docs.text: Property Behavior label Shown next to the input and translated with __(). description Shown below the input. HTML is allowed. <code> gets syntax colors. show_description_on_click The description shows in a popup when the user clicks the label, not below the input. documentation_url Adds an info popup with the link next to the label. Not for layout fields, Button and HTML. placeholder Placeholder text of the empty input. Color and Icon fields have their own placeholder when empty.

docs.title: Default
docs.text:
default sets the value of a new document. The desk sets it when you open a new form (frappe.model.get_default_value). The server sets it on insert for each field that has no value (_set_defaults), and in frappe.new_doc. The server skips defaults during data import (frappe.flags.in_import).

default Desk Server A static value That value That value Today frappe.datetime.get_today() frappe.utils.nowdate() now (Datetime) Current system date and time now_datetime() now (Time) Current time nowtime() __user frappe.session.user frappe.session.user user frappe.session.user The text user user_fullname Full name of the user The text user_fullname :DocType, for example :Company Value of this field in the record named by the user default of company Same. In a child row, the name comes from the parent field company.

Rules:

  • A Select field without a default gets its first option.
  • A Check field gets 0 when the default is empty. The DocType save rejects a Check default other than 0 or 1.
  • A Select default must be one of the options.
  • The default is ignored for the DocType title_field.
  • Today is case-sensitive. now is not.

docs.title: User defaults for Link fields
docs.text:
For a Link field (not a Link to User), the user's defaults come before default:

  1. If a User Permission for the linked DocType has Is Default, or the user has only one allowed record, use it. ignore_user_permissions turns this off.
  2. Otherwise use the user default with the key fieldname. Set it with frappe.defaults.set_user_default("company", "Example Corp").
  3. On the desk, if remember_last_selected_value is set, use the last value that the user selected in this Link field. The desk keeps it in memory until the page reloads.

A default that User Permissions do not allow is not used.

docs.title: not_nullable
docs.text: The column is NOT NULL. When the value is None, Frappe stores default or an empty value for the fieldtype, for example "" for Data. Check, numbers, Rating and Select already have a non-null column, so the property does not apply to them.

docs.title: Display rules
docs.text:
depends_on, mandatory_depends_on, read_only_depends_on and collapsible_depends_on take a condition. The desk evaluates it in frappe.ui.form.Layout.evaluate_depends_on_value and in GridRow for child rows. The server only checks the syntax on DocType save.

Condition Result eval:<JavaScript> The value of the expression. doc is the current document or child row. parent is the form document. Globals such as frappe and in_list are available. fieldname True when doc[fieldname] has a value. For a table field, true when it has rows. 
{
    "fieldname": "discount_reason",
    "fieldtype": "Small Text",
    "label": "Discount Reason",
    "depends_on": "eval:doc.discount > 0",
    "mandatory_depends_on": "eval:doc.discount > 10",
    "read_only_depends_on": "eval:doc.docstatus === 1"
}
  • depends_on: the field shows only when the condition is true. The desk sets hidden_due_to_dependency.
  • mandatory_depends_on: the desk sets reqd when true. The desk checks it before save.
  • read_only_depends_on: the desk sets read_only when true.
  • collapsible_depends_on: for a Section Break with collapsible. The section opens when true. A section with a missing mandatory field always opens.
  • The desk evaluates the conditions again after each value change.
  • The DocType save rejects a condition with a single = assignment, for example eval:doc.status = "Open", with "Invalid ... condition".

Warning

Do not use these conditions for data rules. The server does not evaluate them. Check the same rule in validate of the controller.

docs.title: fetch_from and fetch_if_empty
docs.text:
fetch_from copies a value from a linked document. The format is link_fieldname.source_fieldname.

{
    "fieldname": "rate",
    "fieldtype": "Currency",
    "label": "Rate",
    "fetch_from": "item.rate",
    "fetch_if_empty": 1
}

Desk. When the user changes the Link field, the desk calls frappe.client.validate_link_and_fetch and sets the target fields. The desk sets up the fetch for Data, Read Only, Text, Small Text, Currency, Check, Text Editor, Attach Image, Code, Link, Float, Int, Date, Datetime, Select, Duration, Time, Percent, Phone, Barcode, Autocomplete, Icon, Color and Rating fields, and for any read_only or virtual field. Without fetch_if_empty, the target is read-only while the Link field has a value.

Server. On save, _validate_links reads the linked record and sets the target field:

  • Without fetch_if_empty, the server fetches again on every save and overwrites the value.
  • With fetch_if_empty, the server fetches only when the target is empty.
  • After submit, it fetches only into fields with allow_on_submit.
  • If the source field does not exist, a Data, Small Text or Text target raises "Wrong Fetch From value".
  • A Text Editor source copied to Data, Small Text or Text loses its HTML tags.
  • fetch_from cannot point to the field itself.

DocType save. When you add a fetch_from field, the DocType save fills the field in existing records that are empty.

docs.title: Constraints
docs.text: Property Rule reqd The value must not be empty. HTML with no text counts as empty, except an <img> in Text Editor and HTML Code. Check always passes. A table needs one row. doc.flags.ignore_mandatory = True skips the check. A field cannot be hidden and reqd without default. read_only The desk shows the value as text. The Read Only fieldtype and virtual fields are always read-only on the desk. hidden The desk does not show the field. The value is still in the document and in the API. set_only_once The value can be set only on insert. A change after insert fails, also from empty to a value. For a table, any row change fails. allow_on_submit The field stays editable after submit. On a submitted document, changing a field without it raises frappe.UpdateAfterSubmitError. New rows in a table with allow_on_submit are allowed. unique A unique index on the column. Allowed only for Data, Link, Read Only and Int. An empty string is stored as NULL, so many empty values are allowed. The DocType save fails when saved values are not unique. non_negative Int, Float, Currency and Percent. A value below 0 fails. min_value, max_value Int, Float, Currency and Percent. 0 means not set, so min_value: 0 does nothing. Use non_negative for that. An empty value passes. length The maximum length for varchar fieldtypes, checked on save. The column is at least varchar(64). Int with length above 11 becomes bigint. no_copy Duplicate on the desk (frappe.model.copy_doc) leaves the field empty. frappe.copy_doc(doc) in Python copies it. Pass ignore_no_copy=False to leave it empty.

docs.title: Permissions and security
docs.text: Property Behavior permlevel Field-level permission. A role needs rights at this level to read or write the field. On save, values at a level without write access are reset to the saved or default values. On read, frappe.read_doc and the desk form remove fields without read access. Administrator is not restricted. See Permissions. ignore_user_permissions Link, Dynamic Link and Table MultiSelect. User Permissions on the linked DocType do not restrict the value, the link search or the default. mask Users without the mask right at the field's permlevel see a masked value in forms, lists, reports and prints. Phone shows the first 3 characters plus XXXXXX. Email shows XXXXXX@domain. Date shows XX-XX-XXXX. Other types show XXXXXXXX. Administrator sees the real value. ignore_xss_filter On save, _sanitize_content does not sanitize HTML in this field. Code, JSON, Attach, Attach Image, Barcode and Email fields are never sanitized. translatable Data, Select, Text, Small Text and Text Editor only. The DocType save clears it for other fieldtypes. Users who can write Translation see a translate button next to the field. The button saves Translation records for the value.

docs.title: is_virtual
docs.text:
A virtual field has no database column. Its value comes from a property of the controller class. If there is no property, Frappe evaluates options as a Python expression with doc in scope (frappe.safe_eval).

# sample_app/selling/doctype/sample_order/sample_order.py
from frappe.model.document import Document


class SampleOrder(Document):
    @property
    def item_count(self):
        return len(self.items)
  • doc.as_dict(), the REST API and the desk form include the value. doc.get("item_count") returns None when only options is set.
  • frappe.get_all and frappe.db.get_value cannot select a virtual field. There is no column.
  • The desk shows a virtual field as read-only.
  • A virtual Table field is a computed child table.

docs.title: link_filters
docs.text:
link_filters limits the rows in the Link search dropdown. It is JSON: a list of [doctype, fieldname, operator, value]. A value that starts with eval: is evaluated on the desk with doc, parent and frappe.

{
    "fieldname": "item",
    "fieldtype": "Link",
    "options": "Sample Item",
    "link_filters": "[[\"Sample Item\", \"disabled\", \"=\", 0]]"
}

The DocType save checks that each filter has four values. For Attachment Gallery, each filter must target File. The server does not check link_filters when it saves the document.

docs.title: List, search and grid
docs.text: Property Effect in_list_view A column in list view. In a child DocType, a column in the grid. Not for virtual fields in list view. in_standard_filter A filter in the list view filter bar. in_global_search Adds the formatted value to global search. in_preview Shows in the link preview popup when the DocType has show_preview_popup, and on Kanban cards. Without any in_preview field, the popup shows mandatory fields. bold Bold value. Mandatory fields are always bold. columns Grid column width. 1 to 12 map to pixels, for example 2 is 100px and 4 is 200px. width Grid and Report view column width in pixels. sticky The grid column stays visible when the grid scrolls sideways. allow_in_quick_entry Shows in the quick entry dialog. Mandatory fields always show there. Read-only and virtual fields do not. allow_bulk_edit Table fields only. The grid shows Download and Upload buttons for rows. report_hide Report view drops the field. search_index A database index on the column. unique fields do not need it. in_import_template Select Mandatory in the Data Import export dialog also selects this field.

docs.title: Print
docs.text: Property Effect print_hide The standard print format does not show the field. print_hide_if_no_value Int, Float, Currency and Percent. Print hides the field when the value is 0. print_width Column width in print, with px or %.

docs.title: History
docs.text: Property Effect ignore_versioning Changes to the field are not saved in Version. show_on_timeline For a hidden field. Changes still show on the form timeline.

docs.title: Change properties on one site
docs.text:
Do not edit the DocType JSON of another app. Use these instead:

  • Customize Form saves a Property Setter for each changed property of a standard field. See Customize Form.
  • A Custom Field adds a new field with its own properties.
  • frappe.make_property_setter in a patch or a fixture sets one property from code.
  • frm.set_df_property changes a property in one open form only. See Form Scripts.

The list of properties that Customize Form can change is in DocField Properties.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• read_only, hidden and all *_depends_on rules do not protect data. Check the rule in the controller.
  • min_value: 0 and max_value: 0 do nothing.
  • set_only_once blocks a change from empty to a value after insert.
  • fetch_from without fetch_if_empty overwrites manual values on every save.
  • The defaults user and user_fullname work only on the desk. Use __user for the user ID.
  • frappe.copy_doc copies no_copy fields unless you pass ignore_no_copy=False.
  • A fn:<event> condition always evaluates as true on the desk. The form event returns a promise. Use eval: instead.

docs.title: Layout and Display Fields
docs.text:
Layout fields split a form into tabs, sections and columns. Display fields show content but store no value. None of these fieldtypes has a database column. They are in no_value_fields in frappe/model/__init__.py, so they cannot be mandatory, in list view or in global search. For the list of fieldtypes, see Field Types.

Fieldtype Use it to Tab Break Start a tab. Section Break Start a section, optionally with a label and collapse. Column Break Start a new column in the current section. Fold Hide the rest of the form behind "Show more details". Heading Show the label as a heading. HTML Show static or rendered HTML. Button Run a form script handler or a controller method. Attachment Gallery Show the attachments of the document as a grid. Vue Component Mount a UI island inside the form.

docs.title: How the form layout is built
docs.text:
frappe.ui.form.Layout.render() in frappe/public/js/frappe/form/layout.js reads the fields in idx order. Each field goes into the current tab, section and column.

  1. If the DocType has a Tab Break and the first visible field is not one, the layout adds a tab "Details" (fieldname __details) at the start.
  2. If the DocType has no tab and the first field is not a Section Break, the layout adds a section at the start.
  3. A Tab Break starts a tab and a new section in it.
  4. A Section Break starts a section. The next field starts the first column.
  5. A Column Break starts a column in the current section.
  6. A Fold puts the next sections on a hidden page.
  7. Any other field goes into the current column.

Sections and columns that the layout adds get fieldnames such as __section_1 and __column_1.

At display time:

  • The columns of a section have equal width (col-sm-<12 / n>). Hidden columns do not count.
  • A section with no visible field is hidden.
  • A tab with no visible section is hidden. A tab is also hidden if the user has no read permission on its permlevel.
  • If only one tab is visible, the tab bar is hidden.
  • depends_on and hidden work on Tab Break, Section Break and Column Break. They hide the whole tab, section or column.

When you save a DocType, a layout field without a fieldname gets one. With a label, the fieldname is the label in snake case plus _section, _column or _tab. Without a label, it is section_break_, column_break_ or tab_break_ plus 4 random characters.

docs.title: Tab Break
docs.text:
• Desk: a tab in the tab bar. The label is the tab name.
  • Properties: show_dashboard puts the form dashboard (connections, stats) at the top of this tab. Without it, the dashboard goes on the first tab.
  • JS: frm.layout.tabs is the list of Tab objects. frm.layout.select_tab(label_or_fieldname) opens a tab. A URL hash with the tab fieldname, for example #dates_tab, opens that tab on load.

docs.title: Section Break
docs.text:
• Desk: a section with an optional label (head) and description.
  • Properties:
Property Effect label Section head. A collapsible section needs a label. Without one, it does not collapse. description Text below the head. collapsible Click the head to collapse or expand. The section starts collapsed. collapsible_depends_on Expression. When it is true, the section is expanded. See Field Properties. hide_border No top border between this section and the one before.

A collapsible section stays expanded if a mandatory field in it has no value, or if the user expanded it.

  • JS: frm.fields_dict.<section fieldname> is a Section object, not a control. It has wrapper, body, collapse(hide), is_collapsed(), hide() and show(). frm.toggle_display("<section fieldname>", false) hides the section.
frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order", {
    refresh(frm) {
        frm.fields_dict.more_info_section.collapse(false);
    },
});

docs.title: Column Break
docs.text:
• Desk: starts a column. A label shows above the column. A description shows below the label.
  • JS: columns are not in frm.fields_dict. Use depends_on or frm.toggle_display on a column fieldname to hide it. The other columns then get wider.

docs.title: Fold
docs.text:
• Desk: a "Show more details" link. The sections after the Fold are hidden until the user clicks it.
  • Server: when you save a DocType, check_fold() in frappe/core/doctype/doctype/doctype.py checks:
  • Only one Fold is in the form.
  • The next field is a Section Break.
  • The Fold is not the last field.
  • JS: frm.layout.unfold() toggles the hidden part.

docs.title: Heading
docs.text:
• Desk: the translated label in an <h4>.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlHeading (extends ControlHTML).

docs.title: HTML
docs.text:
• Desk: the content of options, translated with __() and rendered with frappe.render(). The template context is the control, so doc, frm and df are available.
  • Properties: options holds the HTML.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlHTML (extends Control). Set the content from a form script:
frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order", {
    refresh(frm) {
        frm.get_field("status_html").html(`<p>${__("Total")}: ${format_currency(frm.doc.total)}</p>`);
    },
});
Method Effect html(html) Replace the content. Without an argument, render options again. set_value(html) Set df.options to html and render it. A jQuery object is appended instead. The document value does not change. $wrapper jQuery element of the field. 
{"fieldname": "help_html", "fieldtype": "HTML", "options": "<p>{{ doc.doctype }}: {{ __(\"Fill all fields\") }}</p>"}

Warning

Escape document values before you put them in HTML. frappe.render() does not escape them.

docs.title: Button
docs.text:
• Desk: a button with the label. The field label is not shown above it. A button is always clickable, also on a read-only or submitted form.
  • Properties:
Property Effect button_color Default, Primary, Info, Success, Warning or Danger. options Optional. Name of a whitelisted controller method. Used only when no form script handles the click.
  • Click order: the control calls the form script event with the fieldname of the button. If there is no handler and options is set, it calls run_doc_method with the method name. The source marks this path as deprecated. The method must be whitelisted.
frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order", {
    recalculate(frm) {
        frm.call("recalculate").then(() => frm.reload_doc());
    },
});
  • Child tables: a Button in a child DocType triggers the event on the child DocType, with (frm, cdt, cdn). Button and HTML fields can be in_list_view in a child table. In an editable grid, the button shows in every row.
  • Dialogs: in a frappe.ui.Dialog or FieldGroup, set click on the field. See Controls.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlButton (extends ControlData).

docs.title: Attachment Gallery
docs.text:
• Desk: a grid of the attachments of the document, sorted by file name. Images open in a lightbox. Other files open in a new tab. With write permission, the grid has an upload button and a delete button on each file. The upload button is hidden when the DocType max_attachments is reached. An unsaved document shows "Save the document to attach files."
  • Properties:
Property Effect link_filters Optional JSON list of filters on File, for example [["File", "file_type", "=", "PDF"]]. A value that starts with eval: is evaluated with doc, parent and frappe. make_attachment_public Select "public" in the uploader by default.
  • Server: on DocType save, each filter must have 4 values and target File. With filters, the control calls frappe.desk.form.load.get_filtered_attachments. It checks read permission on the document.
  • Uploads: the upload button makes a File with attached_to_field set to the gallery fieldname. Use a filter on attached_to_field to show only these files:
{
    "fieldname": "photos",
    "fieldtype": "Attachment Gallery",
    "label": "Photos",
    "link_filters": "[[\"File\", \"attached_to_field\", \"=\", \"photos\"]]"
}
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlAttachmentGallery (extends ControlInput). It refreshes on the attachments_change event of the form.

docs.title: Vue Component
docs.text:
• Desk: mounts the UI island named in options with frappe.ui.mount_island(). If the island does not exist, the field shows "<name>" is not available on this site.
  • Props passed to the island:
Prop Value doctype DocType of the document name Document name, null for a new document doc A copy of the document is_new true for a new document read_only true when the field is not editable
  • Updates: when the form becomes dirty, the control calls island.update() with new props, at most every 300 ms. The island is unmounted when the field is removed.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlVueComponent (extends Control). To build an island, see Islands.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• A Section Break with collapsible and no label does not collapse.
  • frm.fields_dict has sections, but not columns or tabs.
  • Changing options of an HTML field in Customize Form changes the content for all users. For content per document, set it in refresh.
  • depends_on on layout fields runs only in the desk. The server does not evaluate it.

docs.title: Link and Select Fields
docs.text: Use these fieldtypes when a value must come from a list. A Link points to one document of a fixed DocType. A Dynamic Link points to a document of a DocType that another field holds. A Select takes one value from a fixed list. An Autocomplete suggests values but does not check them on the server. All four store one string in a column of the parent table. For column types and the rules for options, see Field Types. For properties that apply to all fields, see Field Properties.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text: Fieldtype options Desk control Server check on save Link Target DocType Search input with a dropdown Target document must exist and must not be cancelled Dynamic Link Fieldname that holds the target DocType Same as Link Same as Link. The DocType field must have a value. Select Values, one per line <select> list Value must be one of the options Autocomplete Suggestions, one per line, or a JSON list Input with suggestions None

docs.title: Link
docs.text:
• Stores: the name of the linked document as a str, or None. REST JSON has the same string. The value is always the name, also when the desk shows a title.
  • Desk: an input with a dropdown. Focus on an empty input opens the list at once. Typing searches again 500 ms after the last key. The dropdown shows up to link_field_results_limit rows (System Settings, default 10). Each row shows the label in bold and the values of the search fields below it.
  • Properties: options (target DocType), ignore_user_permissions, link_filters, remember_last_selected_value, fetch_from on other fields, fetch_if_empty. See Field Properties.
  • Server: _validate_links() in frappe/model/document.py. See Server validation.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlLink in frappe/public/js/frappe/form/controls/link.js.
{
    "fieldname": "item",
    "fieldtype": "Link",
    "label": "Item",
    "options": "Sample Item",
    "reqd": 1
}

docs.title: The dropdown
docs.text:
After the search results, the dropdown adds these rows:

Row When it shows Filtered by: ... The field has filters, or the df has filter_description. The text describes the filters. It cannot be selected. Create a new <DocType> The user can create the target DocType and the df has no only_select. Custom rows frappe.ui.form.ControlLink.link_options(control) returns a list of rows. Advanced Search In the desk, not in web forms. Opens a search dialog with filters.

The arrow button next to a value opens the linked document. It is hidden when the user has only select permission on the target DocType. A clear (x) button shows only when System Settings has allow_clearing_link_fields set.

Create a new <DocType> opens the quick entry dialog of the target DocType. If the DocType has no quick entry, it opens the full form. The typed text goes to the new document as name_field in frappe.route_options. After the new document is saved, its name is set in the Link field. To fill more fields in the new document, set df.get_route_options_for_new_doc to a function that gets the field control and returns an object of values.

docs.title: How the search works
docs.text:
The desk calls frappe.desk.search.search_link. Without a custom query, search_widget() in frappe/desk/search.py builds the query:

  1. It matches the text with LIKE %txt% on name, the DocType title_field and the DocType search_fields. Only fields of type Data, Text, Small Text, Long Text, Text Editor, Link, Select, Read Only and Autocomplete are matched.
  2. It adds the filters of the field.
  3. It removes disabled records. A Check field enabled must be 1. A Check field disabled must not be 1. To include disabled records, add the filter include_disabled: 1.
  4. It applies the read permission and the User Permissions of the user, with frappe.get_list.
  5. It sorts by position of the text in name, then by idx descending, then by the DocType sort order. Results that start with the text come first.

idx on the target documents counts how often they were linked. The count is sampled for 10% of requests and skipped for some DocTypes, for example User and Role. See frappe/model/utils/link_count.py.

Call the endpoint directly to test a search:

curl -b cookies.txt -G "http://frappe.localhost:8000/api/method/frappe.desk.search.search_link" \
  --data-urlencode doctype="Sample Item" \
  --data-urlencode txt="o" \
  --data-urlencode 'filters={"category": "Hardware"}'

{"message": [
    {"value": "Keyboard", "description": "Keyboard", "label": "Keyboard"},
    {"value": "Laptop", "description": "Laptop", "label": "Laptop"},
    {"value": "Monitor", "description": "Monitor", "label": "Monitor"}
]}

search_link arguments:

Argument Type Default Description doctype str Target DocType. txt str Search text. query str None Dotted path of a whitelisted custom query. filters dict, list or JSON str None Filters in the frappe.get_list format. page_length int 10 Number of rows. searchfield str None Extra field to return. Passed to a custom query. reference_doctype str None DocType of the form that holds the field. ignore_user_permissions bool False Skip User Permissions. Needs reference_doctype and link_fieldname. link_fieldname str None Fieldname of the Link field. start int 0 Offset for paging. include_image bool False Add image to each row from the DocType image_field.

ignore_user_permissions is checked on the server. The field link_fieldname in reference_doctype must have ignore_user_permissions = 1 and must not be read-only or hidden. Otherwise the search throws an error or keeps the User Permissions.

docs.title: Filter the dropdown
docs.text:
There are three ways to filter. All three apply in the desk only. The server accepts any existing record on save.

Method Where Example link_filters DocField property, JSON [["Sample Item", "category", "=", "Hardware"]] frm.set_query Form script frm.set_query("item", "items", () => ({ filters: { category: "Hardware" } })) df.filters Dialog or field group df { fieldtype: "Link", options: "Sample Item", filters: { disabled: 0 } }

A link_filters value can start with eval:. The desk evaluates it with doc, parent and frappe in scope, for example "eval:doc.category". link_filters replace filters on the same fieldnames from set_query.

frm.set_query(fieldname, fn) sets the query of a parent field. frm.set_query(child_fieldname, table_fieldname, fn) sets it for a column of a child table. The function gets (doc, cdt, cdn) and returns one of these:

  • { filters: {...} } or { filters: [[...], ...] } for filters.
  • { query: "dotted.path", filters: {...} } for a custom server query.
  • A string with the dotted path of a custom query.

Filter keys with an empty value are removed when the key is a Link or Dynamic Link field of the form. See Form Scripts for where to call set_query.

docs.title: Custom server query
docs.text:
Use a custom query when filters cannot express the list. Write a whitelisted function with this signature. Return a list of tuples. The first value is the document name. The other values show as the description.

# sample_app/api.py
import frappe


@frappe.whitelist()
@frappe.validate_and_sanitize_search_inputs
def item_query(doctype: str, txt: str, searchfield: str, start: int, page_len: int, filters: dict):
    return frappe.get_list(
        "Sample Item",
        filters={"disabled": 0, "category": filters.get("category") or "Hardware"},
        or_filters={"name": ["like", f"%{txt}%"], "item_name": ["like", f"%{txt}%"]},
        fields=["name", "category", "rate"],
        limit_start=start,
        limit_page_length=page_len,
        order_by="name asc",
        as_list=True,
    )

// sample_app/sample_module/doctype/sample_order/sample_order.js
frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order", {
    setup(frm) {
        frm.set_query("item", "items", () => ({
            query: "sample_app.api.item_query",
            filters: { category: "Hardware" },
        }));
    },
});

The search shows Laptop with the description Hardware, 900.0. Frappe also passes as_dict, reference_doctype, ignore_user_permissions and link_fieldname as keyword arguments, if the function accepts them. validate_and_sanitize_search_inputs rejects a searchfield with special characters and converts start and page_len to integers.

To use one query for every Link field to a DocType, add the standard_queries hook. Frappe uses the last value when several apps set the same DocType. Frappe itself sets one for User.

# sample_app/hooks.py
standard_queries = {"Sample Item": "sample_app.api.item_query"}

docs.title: Validation in the desk
docs.text:
When the user leaves the field or picks a row, the control calls frappe.client.validate_link_and_fetch. The call uses the same filters and query as the search.

  • If the record exists and passes the filters, the value is set with the case of the stored name. For example, laptop becomes Laptop.
  • If the record does not exist or is filtered out, the field is cleared. With filters, an alert shows ": did not match any results."
  • The same call returns the values for fields with fetch_from on this Link, and the control sets them.

    • With a custom query, the value passes only if the query returns it when txt is the full name. frm.set_value() and frappe.model.set_value() skip this validation and do not run fetch_from. The server fills fetch_from fields on save.

docs.title: Link titles
docs.text:
Set show_title_field_in_link = 1 and a title_field on the target DocType to show titles. The input shows the title, for example User 1, and the field stores the name user1@example.com. The dropdown shows the title as the label and the name in the description. The list of these DocTypes is in frappe.boot.link_title_doctypes.

When a form loads, frappe/desk/form/load.py sends the titles of all Link and Dynamic Link values, also in child tables. For other values the control calls frappe.desk.search.get_link_title. That method returns the name when the user cannot read the title field.

Set translated_doctype = 1 ("Translate Link Fields") on the target DocType to show translated names. The search then matches the translated text.

docs.title: Server validation
docs.text:
_validate_links() in frappe/model/document.py runs on insert and save, for the parent and all child rows. For each Link and Dynamic Link field with a value:

Check Error The target document exists. frappe.LinkValidationError: Could not find Item: Nope. In a child row: Could not find Row #1: Item: Nope. The parent and the target DocType are submittable, and the target is cancelled. amended_from is skipped. frappe.CancelledLinkError: Cannot link cancelled document: ...

The check also sets the value to the name as stored, and sets the fields that use fetch_from on this Link. It does not apply link_filters, set_query or custom queries. To skip it, set doc.flags.ignore_links = True. It does not run on cancel.

Frappe also protects links in the other direction. Deleting a document that other documents link to raises frappe.LinkExistsError. Renaming a document updates the Link fields that point to it.

docs.title: Dynamic Link
docs.text:
• Stores: a document name as a str, like Link.
  • Desk: the same control as Link. The target DocType is the current value of the field named in options. If that field is empty, the dropdown does not search. If it names a Single DocType, the desk throws "is not a valid DocType for Dynamic Link".
  • Properties: options (fieldname of a Link to DocType or of a Select field), ignore_user_permissions.
  • Server: the same checks as Link. If the DocType field is empty, the save throws <label> must be set first.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlDynamicLink in dynamic_link.js. It reads the DocType from the form, or from cur_dialog.get_value(options) in a dialog. Set df.get_options to a function that returns the DocType to override this.
[
    {"fieldname": "reference_doctype", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "DocType", "label": "Reference DocType"},
    {"fieldname": "reference_name", "fieldtype": "Dynamic Link", "options": "reference_doctype", "label": "Reference Name"}
]

docs.title: Select
docs.text:
• Stores: one option as a str. An empty first line in options allows a blank value.
  • Default: if default is empty, a new document gets the first option. This applies in the desk (frappe/public/js/frappe/model/create_new.js) and on the server (frappe/model/create_new.py). So a Select whose first option is not blank always has a value.
  • Desk: a <select> element. Each label is translated with the DocType as context, and the stored value stays untranslated. placeholder shows when the value is blank. In grid cells, the value is shown translated.
  • Properties: options, default, sort_options (sort by translated label, desk only), placeholder.
  • Server: _validate_selects() strips spaces from the value and checks it against options. A wrong value throws Status cannot be "Weird". It should be one of "Draft", "Open", "Completed", "Cancelled". The check skips empty values, naming_series, fields without options, and data import (frappe.flags.in_import).
  • DocType save: options are stripped, and empty lines are removed except the first. A default must be one of the options.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlSelect in select.js.

Change the options at runtime with frm.set_df_property. Pass a string with one value per line, or an array. Array items can be strings or objects with value, label and optional disabled.

frm.set_df_property("status", "options", ["Draft", "Open"]);
frm.set_df_property("status", "options", [
    { value: "Open", label: __("Open") },
    { value: "Completed", label: __("Done"), disabled: true },
]);

frm.set_value() with a value that is not an option still sets it in frm.doc. The server rejects it on save.

{
    "fieldname": "status",
    "fieldtype": "Select",
    "label": "Status",
    "options": "Draft\nOpen\nCompleted\nCancelled",
    "default": "Draft"
}

docs.title: Autocomplete
docs.text:
• Stores: a str. The server does not compare it with options. Any value is saved.
  • Desk: an input with a suggestion list. The list is filtered in the browser, and the text can match the label, value or description. It shows up to df.max_items rows (default 99). When the user leaves the field, a value that is not a suggestion is cleared. If there are no suggestions, any value is kept.
  • Options: one value per line, or a JSON list that starts with [. JSON items can be strings or objects with value, label and description. The input shows the label and stores the value. The special value Installed Applications loads the installed apps.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlAutocomplete in autocomplete.js. Set df.ignore_validation = 1 to keep typed values that are not suggestions.

To load suggestions from the server, use set_query. The control calls the method with txt and the keys of params. The method returns a list of strings or of objects with value and label.

frm.set_query("autocomplete", () => ({
    query: "sample_app.api.get_colors",
    params: { palette: "basic" },
}));

# sample_app/api.py
@frappe.whitelist()
def get_colors(txt: str = "", palette: str | None = None):
    return [c for c in ["Red", "Green", "Blue"] if txt.lower() in c.lower()]

docs.title: Combobox controls (beta)
docs.text:
System Settings has enable_combobox_link_field ("Enable Combobox Fields (Beta)"), off by default. When it is on, Link, Dynamic Link, Autocomplete and Table MultiSelect fields use the Control<Fieldtype>Combobox classes, for example ControlLinkCombobox in link_combobox.js. They accept the same hooks as the classic controls. They always show a clear button.

Two DocType properties change how a combobox Link to that DocType works. The classic Link control ignores them.

DocType property Default Effect link_display_mode Search Select loads the whole list once and hides the search box. A list longer than 1000 rows, or a custom query, uses Search. show_image_in_link 0 Shows the DocType image_field as an avatar in the dropdown and the input.

A combobox Link also accepts map_options(rows, { query, start }) on the control or the df. Use it to change, remove or group the rows before they show.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• link_filters, set_query and custom queries filter the desk only. Check the rule again in the controller validate if it matters.
  • A custom query must return the exact name when txt is the full name. Otherwise the desk clears a valid value.
  • frappe.model.set_value() on a Link does not run fetch_from in the browser. Set the fetched values in your script, or let the save fill them.
  • A Select without a blank first option is never empty on a new document.
  • Autocomplete values are not validated on the server. Use Select or Link when the value must be from a list.
  • Select validation does not run during data import.

docs.title: Media and Special Fields
docs.text: Use these fieldtypes for files, images, drawn signatures, barcodes, map shapes, colors, icons and phone numbers. Each one has a column in the parent table and a special desk control. Most of them store a plain string. The server validates only Attach, Attach Image and Phone values. For column types, see Field Types. For properties that apply to all fields, see Field Properties. Rating is on Number Fields.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
Fieldtype Stores Server validation on save Attach File URL string Rejects unsafe URL schemes. Links a File to the document. Attach Image Image file URL string Same as Attach. Upload rejects non-image files. Image Nothing None. No column. Signature PNG data URL string None Barcode SVG markup string None. XSS filter skipped. Geolocation GeoJSON text None. The JSON is not parsed. Color Hex color string None Icon Icon name or emoji string None Phone +<code>-<number> string Must be a valid number with a country code.

In Python (frappe.get_doc, frappe.db.get_value) and in REST JSON, every value is a str or None. Geolocation is also a string, not an object. Call json.loads() on it.

docs.title: Attach
docs.text:
• Stores: the file_url of a File, for example /files/manual.pdf, /private/files/manual.pdf or https://example.com/a.pdf.
  • Desk: an "Attach" button opens the upload dialog. After upload, the control shows the URL as a link and a "Clear" button. "Clear" asks for confirmation, sets the value to null, saves the form, and deletes the attachment if the save succeeds. On a saved document, an upload also saves the form. In list view and grid, the value shows as a link.
  • Properties: make_attachment_public selects "public" in the uploader by default. Without it, the DocType setting make_attachments_public applies. The DocType settings force_private_attachments and max_attachments also apply.
  • Server: _validate_data_fields() in frappe/model/document.py rejects a URL with an unsafe scheme, such as javascript:. The on_update and on_update_after_submit hook attach_files_to_document in frappe/core/doctype/file/utils.py then links the file. See How files link to the document.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlAttach (extends ControlData). on_attach_click() opens frappe.ui.FileUploader. clear_attachment() runs the "Clear" action. In a dialog, if df.options is an object, its keys are merged into the uploader options.

docs.title: Upload dialog
docs.text:
The control opens frappe.ui.FileUploader with allow_multiple: false. The dialog has these sources: the device (drag and drop or file picker), "Library" (existing files), "Link" (a web URL), "Camera", and Google Drive if it is enabled. Each file has a public or private toggle. Images (except SVG) and PDFs have an "optimize" toggle. It is on by default for images above 200 KB.

Restriction Source Enforced by Allowed file types restrictions.allowed_file_types. Default: System Settings allowed_file_extensions. Uploader, and File.validate_file_extension() for files uploaded over HTTP Maximum file size System Settings max_file_size (MB), else site config max_file_size (bytes), else 25 MB Uploader, and File.check_max_file_size() Maximum number of files DocType max_attachments Uploader, and File.validate_attachment_limit() Image only Attach Image fieldtype Uploader, and upload_file in frappe/handler.py Private only DocType force_private_attachments Uploader hides the toggle. File.enforce_public_file_restrictions() throws. Public files for System Managers only System Settings only_allow_system_managers_to_upload_public_files Uploader hides the toggle. File throws.

When you save a DocType, max_attachments is raised to the number of Attach and Attach Image fields if it is lower.

docs.title: How files link to the document
docs.text:
The uploader posts to /api/method/upload_file with doctype, docname and fieldname. The handler makes a File with these values:

File field Value attached_to_doctype The DocType of the form attached_to_name The document name attached_to_field The fieldname of the Attach field is_private The toggle in the dialog

Other rules:

  • A new, unsaved document has a temporary name such as new-sample-order-abc. When the desk saves the document, files with that name, made in the last 60 minutes, get the real name (relink_mismatched_files).
  • If code sets a URL in an Attach field, attach_files_to_document runs after the save. It links an unattached File of the current user with the same URL. If there is no such file, it makes a new File in Home/Attachments. This applies only to URLs that start with /files, /private/files, http:// or https://.
  • An Attach field in a child table row links the file to the parent document, with attached_to_field set to the child fieldname.
  • You cannot delete a File while its URL is still set in an Attach field of the document. Frappe raises LinkExistsError. Clear the field first, or set file.flags.force_delete = True.

To make and attach a file from code, see Files.

docs.title: Attach Image
docs.text:
• Stores: the file_url of an image file.
  • Desk: same as Attach. Hover over the link to see a preview. The uploader accepts only image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp, image/svg+xml, image/avif, image/bmp and image/x-icon.
  • Properties: same as Attach. Set the DocType property image_field to this fieldname to show the image in the form sidebar. A click on that image opens the uploader for the field. image_field must point to an Attach Image field, else the DocType does not save.
  • Server: same as Attach. upload_file throws FileTypeNotAllowed ("{label} only accepts images") if the file type is not image/*.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlAttachImage (extends ControlAttach).

docs.title: Image
docs.text:
• Stores: nothing. It shows the image whose URL is in another field.
  • Desk: an <img> of doc[options]. If that field is empty, it shows a placeholder icon.
  • Properties: options is the fieldname that holds the URL, usually an Attach Image field.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlImage (extends Control).
{"fieldname": "image_preview", "fieldtype": "Image", "options": "attach_image"}

docs.title: Signature
docs.text:
• Stores: a data URL, for example data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo....
  • Desk: a drawing pad, 200 px high, with a reset button. Each stroke updates the value. Reset sets an empty string. A read-only field shows the image.
  • Server: no validation. The server saves any string.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlSignature (extends ControlData). It loads jSignature on demand.

docs.title: Barcode
docs.text:
• Stores: the SVG markup of the barcode. The raw value is in the data-barcode-value attribute of the <svg>.
  • Desk: a text input and the rendered barcode below it. The control turns typed text into SVG with JsBarcode. If JsBarcode cannot encode the value, the description shows "Invalid Barcode".
  • Properties: options is an optional JSON object of JsBarcode options. The control sets fontSize 16, width 3 and height 50 first. "format": "EAN" selects EAN8 for 8 characters and EAN13 otherwise. "valueField": "<fieldname>" also copies the raw value into that field.
  • Server: no validation. A value set from code stays as you set it. The desk converts a raw value to SVG when it shows the form. Barcode fields skip the XSS filter.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlBarcode (extends ControlData). get_barcode_html(value) returns the SVG.
{"fieldname": "barcode", "fieldtype": "Barcode", "options": "{\"format\": \"EAN\", \"valueField\": \"barcode_value\"}"}

A Data field with options Barcode is a different thing. It stores plain text. See Text Fields.

docs.title: Geolocation
docs.text:
• Stores: a GeoJSON FeatureCollection as text. A circle is a Point feature with properties.point_type circle and properties.radius.
  • Desk: a Leaflet map, full width, 400 px high. Users draw markers, lines, polygons, rectangles and circles, and edit or delete them. A locate button centers the map on the user. A layer control switches between the default (OpenStreetMap) and satellite tiles. A read-only field disables drag and zoom. The default center and tile URLs are in frappe.utils.map_defaults.
  • Server: no validation. The server saves any string, also text that is not JSON.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlGeolocation (extends ControlData). Override point_to_layer, set_style or on_each_feature in a subclass to change how features show.
import json

doc = frappe.get_doc("Sample Field Demo", name)
shapes = json.loads(doc.geolocation) if doc.geolocation else None

docs.title: Color
docs.text:
• Stores: a hex color, for example #077DDF.
  • Desk: a text input with a swatch. A click on the swatch opens a color picker with preset swatches. In list view and grid, the value shows with a swatch.
  • Server: no validation.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlColor (extends ControlData). validate() accepts only #RRGGBB (6 hex digits). When a user types another value, the control sets null.

Warning

frm.set_value() and server code do not run the control validation. They can save values such as red or #fff.

docs.title: Icon
docs.text:
• Stores: the name of an icon in the desk icon sprite, for example star, or an emoji.
  • Desk: a text input and an icon picker. Custom icons of the site show in their own section. In list view and grid, the value shows with the icon.
  • Properties: options Emojis adds emojis to the picker.
  • Server: no validation. The server does not check that the icon exists.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlIcon (extends ControlData).

docs.title: Phone
docs.text:
• Stores: the country calling code, a hyphen and the number, for example +1-2025550123.
  • Desk: a country picker with flags and a number input. A new field selects the country from System Settings (frappe.sys_defaults.country). If a number has no code, the control adds the code of the selected country.
  • Server: validate_phone_number_with_country_code() in frappe/utils/__init__.py parses the value with the phonenumbers library. A value without a country code raises InvalidPhoneNumberError ("Please select a country code"). An invalid number raises the same error. Empty values pass.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlPhone (extends ControlData). split_isd(value) returns {isd, number}.
doc.phone = "+1-2025550123"   # valid
doc.phone = "2025550123"      # InvalidPhoneNumberError on save

A Data field with options Phone checks only a character pattern and needs no country code. See Text Fields.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Signature, Barcode, Geolocation, Color and Icon have no server validation. Validate them in the controller if the data comes from the API.
  • Barcode values set from code are not SVG. Code that reads the field gets the raw value or the SVG, depending on where it was set.
  • An Attach URL that is not under /files, /private/files or http(s):// gets no File document.
  • Changing is_private of a File changes its URL. Frappe updates the attached_to_field of the attached document only.

docs.text:

docs.title: Number Fields
docs.text: Use these fieldtypes for counts, amounts, rates, flags, star ratings and time spans. Each one has a numeric column. Int, Float, Currency, Percent and Check columns are NOT NULL with default 0. For column types, see Field Types. For properties that apply to all fields, see Field Properties.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
Fieldtype Python value after load REST JSON Server on save Int int 12 Cast with cint(). Range check. Float float 1.5 Cast with flt(). Not rounded to precision. Currency float 10.5 Same as Float Percent float 12.5 Same as Float. No range limit. Check int (0 or 1) 1 Any truthy value becomes 1 Rating float from 0 to 1 0.6 Clamped to 0..1 Duration float seconds 3725.0 None. A non-number string fails in the database.

The server casts values only when it writes the row. After insert() or save(), the object in memory keeps what you set, for example the string "12". load_from_db() calls _fix_numeric_types(), so frappe.get_doc() and doc.reload() return the types above.

docs.title: System Settings that change numbers
docs.text: Field Effect number_format Digit group and decimal separators, for example #,###.## or #.###,##. Default #,###.## in the desk. float_precision Decimals for Float and Percent when the field has no precision. Python uses 3 if it is empty. currency_precision Decimals for Currency when the field has no precision. If empty, the decimals of the number format apply. currency Default currency use_number_format_from_currency Use the number_format of the Currency record instead of the system format rounding_method Banker's Rounding (legacy) (default), Banker's Rounding or Commercial Rounding. Used by flt(), rounded() and the desk.

docs.title: Number input in the desk
docs.text:
Int, Float, Currency and Percent share these rules:

  • The input has inputmode numeric (Int) or decimal (others). Focus selects all text.
  • The value is set on the change event when you leave the input, not while you type. Typing marks the form dirty.
  • You can type an expression with + - * / ( ). The control calculates it: 2+3*4 gives 14, 100*1.18 gives 118.
  • Digit group separators are removed. Text after the number is dropped: 12abc gives 12.
  • The alignment property sets text alignment in the input.

docs.title: Int
docs.text:
• Stores: an integer. A length above 11 makes a bigint column.
  • Desk: no digit groups. In list view and grid, the value is right-aligned. With options File Size, the formatter shows K or M, for example 1.50K.
  • Properties: non_negative, min_value, max_value, length, unique.
  • Server: cint() on write. 3.7 is stored as 3. _validate_length() throws frappe.CharacterLengthExceededError when the value is above 2147483647 for int.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlInt. ControlLongInt is the same class.

docs.title: Float
docs.text:
• Stores: a decimal with 9 places in the column by default.
  • Desk: the input shows precision decimals with the number format, for example 1,234.500 for precision 3. The list view hides decimals for whole numbers: 1234.0 shows as 1,234. If options names a currency field, the field shows a currency symbol like Currency.
  • Properties: precision (1 to 6), length, non_negative, min_value, max_value.
  • Server: flt() on write, without precision. The column rounds to its own scale. Round values yourself in validate, for example with self.round_floats_in(self).
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlFloat. get_precision() returns df.precision or float_precision. If both are empty, the control does not round.

docs.title: Currency
docs.text:
• Stores: a decimal, the same as Float. The currency is not stored in the field.
  • Desk: the input shows the number with the currency number format. The read-only view and list view add the currency symbol, for example ₹ 1,234.50. The Currency record sets symbol, symbol_on_right, number_format and fraction_units.
  • Properties: options, precision, non_negative, min_value, max_value.
  • Server: the same cast as Float.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlCurrency.

docs.title: Currency resolution
docs.text:
get_field_currency() (Python, frappe/model/meta.py) and frappe.meta.get_field_currency() (JS, frappe/public/js/frappe/model/meta.js) find the currency from options:

options Currency used Empty System Settings currency. Python format_value() uses the currency default. A fieldname, for example currency The value of that field in the document. In a child row, the field of the row, then the field of the parent. DocType:link_field:currency_field, for example Company:company:default_currency Reads currency_field from the record in link_field. JS uses the user default of link_field if the field is empty. 
{"fieldname": "rate", "fieldtype": "Currency", "label": "Rate", "options": "currency"}

docs.title: Precision
docs.text:
get_field_precision() and frappe.meta.get_field_precision() use the first value that is set:

  1. precision of the field.
  2. System Settings currency_precision.
  3. The decimals of the number format for the currency.

doc.precision("rate") returns the same value for a document field.

docs.title: Percent
docs.text:
• Stores: a decimal. 150 is valid. Add min_value and max_value to limit it.
  • Desk: the input shows only the decimals the value has, up to the precision: 12.5 shows as 12.5. The formatter adds %.
  • Server: the same cast as Float.
  • Format: Python format_value() always rounds to 2 decimals: 12.345 gives 12.34% with banker's rounding.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlPercent.

docs.title: Check
docs.text:
• Stores: 0 or 1.
  • Desk: a checkbox with the label on the right. The list view and grid show a disabled checkbox.
  • Properties: default must be 0 or 1. The DocType save sets it to 0 if empty, and throws on other values.
  • Server: get_valid_dict() stores 1 for any truthy value, also True or 5. Check fields skip the length check.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlCheck. get_input_value() returns 1 or 0.

docs.title: Rating
docs.text:
• Stores: a fraction from 0 to 1. With 5 stars, 3 stars is 0.6.
  • Desk: a row of stars. A click on the left half of a star sets a half star. A second click on the same value clears it, unless the field is mandatory. The list view shows the stars.
  • Properties: options is the number of stars, from 3 to 10. The default is 5.
  • Server: _fix_rating_value() sets values below 0 to 0 and above 1 to 1. It does not change the scale, so rating = 3 is stored as 1.
  • Format: Python format_value() returns the raw number.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlRating. It extends ControlFloat.
stars = 3
doc.rating = stars / 5  # 0.6 for a 5-star field

docs.title: Duration
docs.text:
• Stores: seconds as a decimal.
  • Desk: the input shows the value as 1d 2h 3m 4s. Focus opens a picker with Days, Hours, Minutes and Seconds boxes. You can also type 1d 2h 3m 4s or a plain number of seconds, for example 90. An empty value shows as 0s in list view.
  • Properties: hide_days shows days as hours, for example 26h 3m 4s. hide_seconds hides the seconds box and the seconds in the text.
  • Server: no conversion. Send a number. A string such as "1h" fails in the database.
  • Format: Python format_duration(seconds, hide_days=False) and format_value() use hide_days but not hide_seconds. duration_to_seconds("1d 2h 3m 4s") returns 93784.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlDuration. get_value() returns an integer. Helpers: frappe.utils.get_formatted_duration(value, options), frappe.utils.seconds_to_duration(seconds, options), frappe.utils.duration_to_seconds(days, hours, minutes, seconds).

docs.title: Format numbers in code
docs.text:
Python JS Result frappe.format_value(1234.5, {"fieldtype": "Currency"}) frappe.format(1234.5, {fieldtype: "Currency"}, {only_value: 1}) ₹ 1,234.50 with currency INR frappe.utils.fmt_money(1234.5, currency="USD") format_currency(1234.5, "USD") $ 1,234.50 doc.get_formatted("rate") frappe.format(doc.rate, df, {}, doc) Uses the field and document currency frappe.format_value(93784, {"fieldtype": "Duration"}) frappe.format(93784, {fieldtype: "Duration"}) 1d 2h 3m 4s

frappe.format() wraps numbers in a right-aligned <div>. Pass {inline: 1} or {only_value: 1} as the third argument to get the text only. For flt, cint and rounded, see Utilities.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Values are not cast in memory after insert(). Use cint() or flt() before you compare them, or reload the document.
  • Float and Currency values are not rounded to precision on save. Two values that look equal in the desk can differ in the database.
  • A Rating value is a fraction, not a star count.
  • Percent has no limit of 100.
  • A Duration value is in seconds. Do not send "1h 30m" through the API.

docs.title: Table Fields
docs.text: A Table field holds a list of rows of a child DocType, for example the items of an order. A Table MultiSelect field holds rows too, but shows them as pills of one Link value, for example the roles of a user. The rows are stored in the table of the child DocType, not in a column of the parent. For the rules on options, see Field Types. For form events of child rows, see Form Scripts.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text: Fieldtype options Desk control Value Table A child DocType (istable = 1) Grid with rows and columns List of row documents Table MultiSelect A child DocType with at least one Link field Input with pills List of row documents

docs.title: How rows are stored
docs.text:
Each row is a document of the child DocType. Frappe adds these fields to each row:

Field Value parent Name of the parent document parenttype Parent DocType parentfield Fieldname of the Table field in the parent idx Position of the row, from 1 name Random 10-character name, set on insert

When the parent is saved, Frappe deletes the rows that are no longer in the list, updates the other rows and inserts new ones. See update_child_table() in frappe/model/document.py. A row has no permissions of its own. Frappe checks the permissions of the parent.

A Table field with is_virtual = 1 is a computed table. Its rows come from a controller property or from the options expression. Frappe does not save them.

docs.title: Table
docs.text:
• Stores: no column in the parent. frappe.get_doc returns a list of child Document objects, or []. REST JSON has a list of row objects.
  • Desk: a grid. See The grid.
  • Properties: options, reqd (at least one row), read_only, hidden, allow_on_submit, allow_bulk_edit (Upload and Download buttons), description. On child fields: in_list_view, columns, sticky, bold, reqd.
  • Child DocType properties: editable_grid (default 1), grid_page_length (default 50), rows_threshold_for_grid_search (default 20), allow_bulk_edit (default 1, the Edit rows dialog).
  • Server: a mandatory Table with no rows raises frappe.MandatoryError. Each row is validated like a document: links, Select values, mandatory fields and lengths. Errors start with the row number, for example Could not find Row #1: Item: Nope.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlTable in table.js. The grid is frm.fields_dict.<fieldname>.grid, an instance of the Grid class in grid.js.
{
    "fieldname": "items",
    "fieldtype": "Table",
    "label": "Items",
    "options": "Sample Order Item",
    "reqd": 1
}

REST JSON of a Sample Order with one row:

{
    "name": "SO-00016",
    "customer_name": "Customer G",
    "items": [
        {
            "name": "tg1bsfrdjo",
            "idx": 1,
            "item": "Laptop",
            "qty": 2.0,
            "rate": 900.0,
            "amount": 1800.0,
            "parent": "SO-00016",
            "parentfield": "items",
            "parenttype": "Sample Order",
            "doctype": "Sample Order Item"
        }
    ]
}

docs.title: Columns
docs.text:
The grid shows the child fields that have in_list_view = 1. If no field has it when you save the child DocType, Frappe sets it on the first four mandatory fields that are not hidden. Fieldtypes without a value, such as layout fields and Table, cannot have in_list_view. In a child DocType, Button and HTML fields can.

The width of a column comes from the first of these that is set:

  1. The width the user set in the column settings.
  2. columns on the DocField, 1 to 12, mapped to 60 to 600 px.
  3. The fieldtype default: 200 px for Text, Small Text and Long Text, 100 px for numbers, 60 px for Check.
  4. 140 px.

The width is kept between 60 and 600 px. A user can pick columns, widths and sticky columns with the gear icon in the header. The choice is saved in the user settings of the parent DocType, under GridView.

docs.title: Edit rows
docs.text:
• If the child DocType has editable_grid = 1, the user edits values in the cells. Otherwise a click opens the row form.
  • The pencil icon at the end of a row opens the row form. It shows all child fields and the buttons Move, Duplicate, Insert Above, Insert Below and Delete.
  • Drag the row handle to change the order. This works only when the grid is editable.
  • Select rows with the checkboxes. Shift-click selects a range. The footer then shows Delete, Duplicate and Edit buttons for the selected rows.
  • Edit rows opens a dialog that sets one field to one value in all selected rows. It shows only when the child DocType has allow_bulk_edit = 1.
  • Paste tab-separated data, for example from a spreadsheet, into a cell. If the first row has field labels or fieldnames, Frappe maps the columns by them. Otherwise it fills the visible columns from the cell to the right. It adds rows as needed.
  • The grid shows grid_page_length rows per page. A search row shows when the table has at least rows_threshold_for_grid_search rows.

Keyboard shortcuts in an editable cell:

Keys Action Ctrl + Down / Ctrl + Up Insert a row below / above Ctrl + Shift + Down / Up Add a row at the end / at the start Shift + Alt + Down Duplicate the row Up / Down Go to the same cell in the previous / next row Tab in the last cell of the last row Add a row Esc Remove a new row that the user did not change

On macOS, Cmd works as Ctrl. In Text, Small Text, Code, Text Editor and HTML Editor cells, the arrow keys move the cursor in the text. Add Alt to move between rows.

docs.title: Upload and Download
docs.text:
Set allow_bulk_edit = 1 on the Table field to show these buttons. Upload shows when the grid is editable. Download shows when the grid is read-only, for example on a submitted document.

Upload opens a dialog in grid_import.js:

  • The file can be CSV, XLSX or XLS, or a public Google Sheets URL. The dialog also has a Download Template button.
  • The Import Type can be Insert New Records, Update Existing Records or Insert or Update Records. Updates match rows by the ID column, which is the row name.
  • The dialog shows issues and a preview before the import. A file with more than 5000 rows is refused.
  • The rows change in the form. The user must save the document to keep them.

docs.title: Python API
docs.text:
doc = frappe.new_doc("Sample Order")
doc.customer_name = "Customer A"
row = doc.append("items", {"item": "Laptop", "qty": 2})  # returns the child Document
doc.append("items", {"item": "Monitor", "qty": 1})
doc.insert()

row.idx, row.parentfield, row.rate  # (1, 'items', 900.0) - rate came from fetch_from on save
doc.get("items", {"item": "Monitor"})  # rows that match, a list
doc.remove(doc.items[0])  # remove the row and number the others again
doc.save()  # deletes the removed row in the database
Method Description doc.append(fieldname, value=None, position=-1) Add a row from a dict or a child Document. Returns the row. With position, insert at that index and number all rows again. doc.extend(fieldname, rows) Append each row of a list. doc.set(fieldname, rows) Replace all rows. An empty value clears the table. doc.get(fieldname, filters=None, limit=None) Rows that match a filter dict. Values can be "x", ["!=", "x"], ["in", [...]], "^prefix", True (set) or False (not set). doc.getone(fieldname, filters) The first matching row. doc.remove(row) Remove a row from the list and number the rest again. doc.get_all_children() All rows of all Table fields. row.parent_doc The parent Document. It is None for a row loaded alone with frappe.get_doc(child_doctype, name).

Rows are saved only through the parent. To read rows without the parent, query the child DocType with the parent filters:

frappe.get_all(
    "Sample Order Item",
    filters={"parenttype": "Sample Order", "parent": "SO-00016"},
    fields=["item", "qty"],
    order_by="idx",
)

frappe.get_list on the parent can also read child fields with <table fieldname>.<field>, for example fields=["name", "items.item"]. This returns one row for each child row.

docs.title: REST API
docs.text:
• GET /api/resource/Sample Order/SO-00016 returns the rows in the items key.
  • PUT with an items list replaces all rows. Rows without name are inserted. Rows that are not in the list are deleted.
  • PUT without the items key keeps the rows.
  • To list rows of a child DocType, pass the parent DocType: GET /api/resource/Sample Order Item?parent=Sample Order&fields=["item","parent"]. Without parent, the response has only the name of each row.

See REST API.

docs.title: JavaScript API
docs.text:
Form methods for tables are listed in Form Scripts. This table shows what each one does to events and rendering. It was checked in the browser on a Sample Order form.

Call Fires <table>_add / _remove Renders Notes frm.add_child("items", {item: "Laptop"}) No No. Call frm.refresh_field("items"). No change events, no fetch_from. frm.fields_dict.items.grid.add_new_row() _add Yes Same as the Add row button. Does nothing if rows cannot be added. frm.set_value("items", [{...}, ...]) No Yes Replaces all rows. name, idx and other standard keys in the input are ignored. frm.clear_table("items") No No. Call frm.refresh_field("items"). Delete button on selected rows before_items_remove, items_remove for each row, then items_delete Yes frappe.model.set_value(cdt, cdn, field, value) The child field event Yes No fetch_from for Link fields.

To set a value in a row and run the field event, use frappe.model.set_value:

// sample_app/sample_module/doctype/sample_order/sample_order.js
frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order", {
    refresh(frm) {
        frm.fields_dict.items.grid.add_custom_button(__("Set Qty to 1"), () => {
            for (const row of frm.doc.items || []) {
                frappe.model.set_value(row.doctype, row.name, "qty", 1);
            }
        });
    },
});

docs.title: Grid methods
docs.text:
Get the grid with frm.fields_dict.<fieldname>.grid or frm.get_field(<fieldname>).grid.

Method or property Description add_new_row(idx, callback, show) Add a row. idx inserts at that position. show opens the row form when the grid is not editable. Returns the row. get_row(key) The GridRow by index (negative counts from the end) or by row name. get_row(0).doc is the row data. get_selected_children() Selected rows as objects. frm.get_selected() returns the names for all grids. update_docfield_property(fieldname, property, value) Change a child DocField property for all rows of this form, for example read_only. toggle_reqd(fieldname, reqd), toggle_enable(fieldname, enable), toggle_display(fieldname, show) Set reqd, read_only or hidden on a child field through update_docfield_property. set_column_disp_in_list_view(fieldname, show) Hide or show a grid column. Affects only this grid. add_custom_button(label, click, position) Add a button to the footer, or above the grid with position = "top". Returns the button. clear_custom_buttons() Hide all custom buttons. set_multiple_add(link_fieldname, qty_fieldname) Show an Add multiple button that opens a search dialog for the Link field. only_sortable() Allow drag to reorder, but no other edits. refresh() Render the grid again. grid_rows, data The GridRow objects and the row data on the current page.

To stop adding or deleting rows, set a property on the Table field. These are df keys, not DocField properties in the DocType.

frm.set_df_property("items", "cannot_add_rows", true);
frm.set_df_property("items", "cannot_delete_rows", true);

cannot_add_rows hides Add row and Duplicate, and add_new_row() adds nothing. cannot_delete_rows hides the Delete buttons. To block one row from drag and drop, set _sortable = false on the row data.

To open the row form of a row from code, call frm.fields_dict.items.grid.get_row(0).toggle_view(true).

docs.title: Table MultiSelect
docs.text:
• Stores: rows of the child DocType, like Table. The control uses the first Link field of the child DocType. In JSON, roles on a Sample Field Demo is [{"role": "Sample Role", "parentfield": "roles", "doctype": "Has Role", ...}].
  • Desk: an input that shows one pill for each row. Typing searches the target DocType of the Link field, with the same search as a Link field. Values that are already selected do not show. A click on a pill opens the linked document. The x on a pill removes the row. Backspace in the empty input removes the last pill. A new value is validated like a Link value. A value that is already selected is ignored. Pills show link titles when the target DocType uses them.
  • Properties: options, reqd, ignore_user_permissions. ignore_user_permissions on the Table MultiSelect field or on the child Link field allows the search to skip User Permissions.
  • Server: the same as Table. Each row is validated, so the Link value must exist. When you save the parent DocType, Frappe checks that the child DocType has a Link field.
  • JS: frappe.ui.form.ControlTableMultiSelect in table_multiselect.js. It extends ControlLink, so frm.set_query("roles", ...) filters the search. get_value() returns the rows. Adding one row fires <fieldname>_add. Removing a pill fires before_<fieldname>_remove and <fieldname>_remove.
frm.set_value("roles", [{ role: "Sample Role" }]);

{
    "fieldname": "roles",
    "fieldtype": "Table MultiSelect",
    "label": "Roles",
    "options": "Has Role"
}

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• frm.add_child() and frm.clear_table() do not render and do not fire _add or _remove. Call frm.refresh_field() and run your own logic.
  • A PUT with a partial items list deletes the rows that are not in it. Send all rows, or leave out the key.
  • grid.toggle_display() hides a field in the row form. It does not remove the grid column. Use set_column_disp_in_list_view() for the column.
  • grid.set_column_disp(fieldname, false) empties the cells but keeps the column header. Use set_column_disp_in_list_view() instead.
  • cannot_add_rows and cannot_delete_rows work only in the desk. The server accepts any rows. Check limits in the controller validate.
  • Child rows saved with frappe.db.set_value or SQL skip the parent validate.
