docs.title: JavaScript Form API
docs.text:
This page lists the client-side API of desk forms: frappe.ui.form, the form events, and the frm object (frappe.ui.form.Form). Use it to look up an exact name, its arguments and what it does. For how to write a form script and where the code goes, see Form Scripts. For controls (frm.fields_dict.<fieldname>), see Controls.

The names come from Object.keys(frappe.ui.form) and the prototypes of the classes in a logged-in desk at /desk on develop. The event order was checked in the browser on a Sample Order form.

docs.title: frappe.ui.form functions
docs.text:
Function Description on(doctype, events) or on(doctype, event, handler) Register form event handlers for doctype. events is an object {event: handler}. Handlers add up: many calls for the same event all run, in the order they were registered. Use "*" as doctype for all DocTypes. Also frappe.ui.form.on_change. off(doctype, event, handler) Remove all handlers of event for doctype, and the matching frm.events and frm.cscript entries. The handler argument is ignored. trigger(doctype, event) Run the handlers of event on cur_frm. Returns nothing. Use frm.trigger(event) to get a promise. set_controller(doctype, ControllerClass) Bind a class-based controller to the DocType. Its methods get (doc, cdt, cdn). They run after the frappe.ui.form.on handlers of the same event. make_quick_entry(doctype, after_insert, init_callback, doc, force, skip_insert) Open the quick entry dialog, or the full form if quick entry does not apply. Returns a promise of the dialog object. See Quick entry. make_control(opts) Make one control outside a form. See Controls. get_open_grid_form() Return the GridRow whose row form is open, or undefined. close_grid_form() Close the open row form and the editable grid row. save(frm, action, callback, btn) Low-level save. Checks mandatory fields, then calls frappe.desk.form.save.savedocs (or frappe.desk.form.save.submit for Submit, frappe.desk.form.save.cancel for cancel). Does not run validate or before_save. Use frm.save(). check_mandatory(frm) Return false and show the missing mandatory fields, or true. update_calling_link(newdoc) After a document was made from a Link field, set it in that Link field and go back. remove_old_form_route() Remove the current route from frappe.route_history. get_breadcrumbs(frm) Return the breadcrumb items of a form. get_event_handler_list(doctype, event) Return the list of handlers of an event. Makes an empty list if there is none. handlers, controllers Registered handlers by DocType and event, and classes set with set_controller.

Related globals:

Name Description frappe.new_doc(doctype, opts, init_callback) Open a new document. opts is set as frappe.route_options, so its keys become field values. Opens the route in frappe.create_routes[doctype] if set, else calls make_quick_entry. For File, opens the file uploader. Returns a promise. frappe.quick_edit(doctype, name) Load a document and open it in the quick entry dialog. frappe.validated Set to false in validate, before_save, before_submit, before_cancel or before_discard to stop the action. frappe.route_hooks.after_load, after_save, after_submit Set a function fn(frm) before you open a form. The form calls it once after load, save or submit, then deletes it. cur_frm The form on screen. Prefer the frm argument of handlers.

docs.title: Form events
docs.text: Handlers of form events get frm. A handler that returns a promise delays the next handler and the rest of the action.

docs.title: Trigger order
docs.text:
Action Events, in order Open a document for the first time in this session (new or saved) setup (once per DocType), before_load, onload, refresh, onload_post_render Open a document again refresh Change a field value <fieldname> Save validate, before_save, server save, after_save, refresh Submit before_submit, validate, before_save, server submit, after_save, on_submit, refresh Cancel before_cancel, server cancel, after_cancel, refresh Delete after_delete Workflow action before_workflow_action, server action, after_workflow_action

timeline_refresh also runs each time the timeline renders, for example after save.

docs.title: All form events
docs.text:
Event When it runs setup Once, when the form object of the DocType is made. Runs at once, not in series. before_load The first time a document opens in this session, before onload. onload The first time a document opens in this session. refresh Each time the form renders: after load, save, submit, cancel and reload. onload_post_render After the first refresh of a document. <fieldname> After the value of the field changes through frm.set_value, frappe.model.set_value or the user. <button fieldname> When the user clicks a Button field. validate Before save and before submit. Stop with frappe.throw() or frappe.validated = false. Not run for Update (save after submit). before_save After validate, before the request. after_save After the server saved or submitted the document. before_submit After the user confirms submit. Stop with frappe.validated = false. on_submit After the server submitted the document. before_cancel After the user confirms cancel. Stop with frappe.validated = false. after_cancel After the server cancelled the document. before_discard, after_discard Before and after the user discards a draft. after_delete After the document was deleted, before the browser goes back. before_workflow_action, after_workflow_action Before and after a workflow action. frm.selected_workflow_action holds the action. timeline_refresh After the timeline renders. dashboard_update After the connections dashboard loads its counts. on_tab_change After the active form tab changes. on_hide When the form page is hidden. <table fieldname>_on_form_rendered On the parent DocType, when a row form of that table opens. Old style. Prefer form_render.

A depends_on, mandatory_depends_on or read_only_depends_on value of the form fn:<event> runs the form event <event> and uses its return value.

docs.title: Child table events
docs.text:
Register child table events on the child DocType. Handlers get (frm, cdt, cdn). Read the row with locals[cdt][cdn].

Event When it runs <child fieldname> After a field of a row changes. <table fieldname>_add After the user adds a row, or after grid.add_new_row(). Not after frm.add_child(). before_<table fieldname>_remove Before a row is removed. <table fieldname>_remove After a row is removed. <table fieldname>_delete After the user deletes selected rows or all rows. cdn is not set. <table fieldname>_move After the user drags a row to a new position. form_render When the row form of a row opens.

A Table MultiSelect field runs <fieldname>_add, before_<fieldname>_remove and <fieldname>_remove on the child DocType when the user adds or removes one value.

// sample_app/sample_module/doctype/sample_order/sample_order.js
frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order Item", {
    qty(frm, cdt, cdn) {
        const row = locals[cdt][cdn];
        frappe.model.set_value(cdt, cdn, "amount", flt(row.qty) * flt(row.rate));
    },
    items_remove(frm) {
        frm.set_value("total", frm.get_sum("items", "amount"));
    },
});

docs.title: Old-style handlers
docs.text: frm.cscript holds old-style handlers. A method frm.cscript.<event> or frm.cscript.custom_<event> runs with (doc, cdt, cdn) after the new-style handlers. frm.events.<event> is the last handler registered for the event while the form was on screen.

docs.title: frm properties
docs.text:
Property Description doc The document, the same object as locals[doctype][docname]. doctype, docname DocType and name of the open document. meta The DocType meta. fields_dict Controls by fieldname. fields_dict.<table>.grid is the grid. fields List of controls. perm Permissions of the document by permlevel, for example frm.perm[0].write. page The frappe.ui.Page of the form. layout The frappe.ui.form.Layout. toolbar, dashboard, sidebar, timeline, footer Form parts. See the sections below. script_manager The frappe.ui.form.ScriptManager. states The workflow helper (frappe.ui.form.States). attachments, assign_to, shared, tags, comment_box Sidebar and footer parts. comment_box is the comment control. custom_buttons Buttons added with add_custom_button, by label. grids Grids of the form. wrapper, $wrapper, body DOM elements of the form. opendocs Names of documents opened in this form object. read_only true if a workflow makes the document read-only. save_disabled true after disable_save(). state_fieldname Workflow state field, or null. selected_doc The document or row of the event that runs now. selected_workflow_action The workflow action that runs now. doctype_layout The active DocType Layout, or null. undo_manager Undo and redo history of field changes. refresh_if_stale_for Seconds after which an unchanged document reloads when the user opens it again. Default 120. fetch_dict Fetch rules added with add_fetch.

Properties that a form script can set:

Property Description custom_make_buttons {doctype: button_label}. The + button of that DocType in the connections dashboard clicks this custom button. make_methods {doctype: fn(frm)}. The + button of that DocType in the connections dashboard calls fn. can_make_methods {doctype: fn(frm)}. Return true to show the + button of that DocType. ignore_doctypes_on_cancel_all DocTypes that cancel does not cancel with the document. show_print_first Open the print view when a submitted document opens.

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Method Description set_value(fieldname, value, if_missing, skip_dirty_trigger = false) or set_value({fieldname: value, ...}) Set parent fields and run their events. Returns a promise. With an array for a Table field, replaces all rows and renders the table. Standard keys such as name, idx and parent in the array are ignored. With if_missing, sets only empty fields. Throws if the field is not in the form. In the object form, unknown fields are skipped. get_field(fieldname) Return the control. Same as fields_dict[fieldname]. get_docfield(fieldname, child_fieldname) Return the DocField copy of this document. With two arguments, return the field of the child DocType of the Table field fieldname. get_formatted(fieldname) Return the formatted value as HTML. get_title() Return the title of the document. get_doc() Return locals[doctype][docname]. is_new() Return doc.__islocal: truthy for an unsaved document. is_dirty() Return true if the document has unsaved changes. dirty() Mark the document as changed. Adds the leave-page warning unless developer mode is on. add_fetch(link_field, source_field, target_field, target_doctype) When link_field changes, copy source_field of the linked document into target_field. Prefer fetch_from in the DocType. set_currency_labels(fields_list, currency, parentfield) Add (<currency>) to the labels of these fields. With parentfield, change the columns of that table. With no currency, reset the labels. reset_currency_labels(fields, parentfield) Restore the labels changed by set_currency_labels. set_fields_as_options(fieldname, reference_doctype, filter_function, default_options = [], table_fieldname) Load the fields of reference_doctype and set them as the options of a Select field. Returns a promise of the options.

docs.title: Field properties
docs.text:
These change the DocField copy of the open document only, then render the field again.

Method Description set_df_property(fieldname, property, value) Set a field property, for example read_only, hidden, reqd, options, label, description. set_df_property(table_fieldname, property, value, docname, child_fieldname, row_name) Set a property of a child field. With row_name, for that row only. Pass frm.docname as docname. toggle_display(fieldnames, show) Set hidden. fieldnames is a fieldname, a list, or "*". toggle_reqd(fieldnames, mandatory) Set reqd. toggle_enable(fieldnames, enable) Set read_only. set_query(fieldname, fn) or set_query(child_fieldname, table_fieldname, fn) Set the get_query of a Link field. fn(doc, cdt, cdn) returns {filters} or {query, filters}. set_indicator_formatter(fieldname, get_color, get_text) Show a Link column as a colored indicator. get_color(doc) returns a color class. field_map(fieldnames, fn) Call fn(df) for each DocField and render the fields that changed. refresh_field(fieldname) Render one field again. refresh_fields() Render all fields in the next animation frame. set_read_only() Remove write rights from frm.perm and render the fields. disable_form() Make all fields read-only and hide the save button. 
frm.set_df_property("items", "read_only", 1, frm.docname, "qty", row.name);
frm.set_query("item", "items", () => ({ filters: { disabled: 0 } }));

docs.title: Child tables
docs.text: Method Description add_child(table_fieldname, values) Add a row and return it. idx and name in values are ignored. Does not render and does not run <table>_add. Call refresh_field(table_fieldname). clear_table(table_fieldname) Remove all rows. Does not render. get_sum(table_fieldname, fieldname) Sum a column with +. An empty value gives NaN. update_in_all_rows(table_fieldname, fieldname, value) Set value in each row where the field is empty. Runs the child field event. get_selected() Return the selected rows of all grids as {table_fieldname: [row names]}. open_grid_row() Return the GridRow whose row form is open.

docs.title: Buttons and messages
docs.text: Method Description add_custom_button(label, fn, group, type = "default") Add a button to the form toolbar. With group, add it to a dropdown with that label. Returns the button. Call it in refresh: the toolbar is cleared on each render. remove_custom_button(label, group) Remove one custom button. clear_custom_buttons() Remove all custom buttons and sidebar user actions. change_custom_button_type(label, group, type) Change the button style, for example "primary". set_intro(text, color) Show a message at the top of the form. Call with no text to clear it. set_footnote(text) Show a note at the end of the form. add_web_link(path, label) Add a link to the sidebar. show_success_action() Show the Success Action message of the DocType. scroll_to_field(fieldname, focus = true) Open the tab, open the section, scroll to the field, focus it and highlight it. Returns false if the field is not found. set_active_tab(tab), get_active_tab() Set or get the active frappe.ui.form.Tab. Use frm.get_field(tab_fieldname).tab to get a tab.

docs.title: Document actions
docs.text: Method Description save(action = "Save", callback, btn, on_error) Run validate and before_save, then save. action is "Save", "Submit", "Update" or "Cancel". Returns a promise. Shows "No changes in document" if nothing changed. savesubmit(btn, callback, on_error) Ask, then run before_submit and submit. Returns a promise that resolves after on_submit. savecancel(btn, callback, on_error) Find submitted linked documents. If there are some, offer to cancel them all. Else ask, run before_cancel and cancel. savetrash() Find linked documents. Offer to delete them with the document, or ask, then delete. discard(btn, callback, on_error) Ask, then discard the draft with frappe.desk.form.save.discard. amend_doc() Make an amended copy of a cancelled document. Needs an amended_from field. copy_doc(onload, from_amend) Open a copy of the document. onload(newdoc) runs before the form opens. reload_doc() Remove the document from locals, load it again, then render. Returns a promise. save_or_update() Save a draft, or update a submitted document that has changes. enable_save(), disable_save(set_dirty = false) Show or hide the primary save button. Call disable_save in refresh. With set_dirty, changes still mark the form dirty. print_doc() Open the print view. email_doc(message, opts) Open the email composer. Returns the frappe.views.CommunicationComposer. rename_doc() Open the rename dialog. share_doc() Open the share dialog. navigate_records(prev) Open the next record (prev = 0) or the previous record (prev = 1) with the filters of the list view. execute_action(action) Run a DocType Action by label or row. A Server Action calls the method with doc, syncs a returned document and renders. make_new(doctype, fieldname) Make a new linked document from the connections dashboard. Uses make_methods or custom_make_buttons if set. can_create(doctype) Return true if the dashboard can show + for this DocType.

docs.title: Permissions and data
docs.text: Method Description has_perm(ptype) Return true if the user has ptype ("read", "write", "submit"...) at permlevel 0 on this document. get_perm(permlevel, access_type) Return frm.perm[permlevel][access_type], or null. get_docinfo() Return frappe.model.docinfo[doctype][docname]. get_files() Return the attachments, sorted by file name. get_involved_users() Return users linked to the document, its comments, versions, assignments and emails. Leaves out Administrator and the current user. trigger(event, doctype, docname) Run the handlers of an event. Returns a promise. refresh(docname) Render the form. With docname, switch to that document first.

docs.title: Call the server
docs.text:
frm.call(method, args, callback) or frm.call(opts) calls the server and returns the promise of frappe.call.

Form What it calls frm.call("method_name", args) The whitelisted method method_name of the controller class. The current document from locals is sent as docs. The server runs frappe.handler.run_doc_method, which checks read permission. frm.call({method, doc: frm.doc, args}) Same as above. frm.call({method, args}) with no doc A module function. A method without a dot is prefixed with the Python module of the DocType. If r.message is an object, its keys are set on the form with set_value. With child, they are set on that row.

When you call a controller method, the response includes the document. Desk syncs it into locals and renders the fields again. The changes are not saved.

# sample_app/sample_module/doctype/sample_order/sample_order.py
class SampleOrder(Document):
    @frappe.whitelist()
    def get_open_count(self):
        return frappe.db.count("Sample Order", {"customer_name": self.customer_name, "docstatus": 0})

const r = await frm.call("get_open_count");
r.message; // a number

docs.title: Internal methods
docs.text: Desk calls these. Do not call them from a form script: setup, setup_meta, setup_std_layout, watch_model_updates, setup_notify_on_rename, setup_file_drop, setup_image_autocompletions_in_markdown, setup_doctype_actions, setup_docinfo_change_listener, add_form_keyboard_shortcuts, switch_doc, check_reload, trigger_onload, initialize_new_doc, render_form, render_fields, cleanup_refresh, refresh_header, apply_layout_defaults, onload_post_render, configure_breadcrumb_width, focus_on_first_input, run_after_load_hook, show_upload_first_review, validate_and_save, validate_form_action, handle_save_fail, trigger_link_fields, show_conflict_message, show_submit_message, show_web_link, show_report_bug_link, show_submission_queue_banner, show_workflow_read_only_banner, mark_mask_fields_readonly, fetch_permissions, has_read_permission, check_doctype_conflict, rename_notify, get_active_tab_hash, is_form_builder, scroll_to_element, set_link_field, and the methods that start with _.

docs.title: frm.page
docs.text:
frm.page is a frappe.ui.Page. All its methods are in UI Components. These are the ones form scripts use most:

Method Description add_inner_button(label, action, group, type = "default", align_right = false) Add a toolbar button. frm.add_custom_button calls this. add_menu_item(label, click, standard, shortcut, show_parent, group) Add an item to the ... menu. add_action_item(label, click, standard, icon) Add an item to the Actions dropdown. set_primary_action(label, click, icon, working_label), set_secondary_action(...) Set the main or second button. The toolbar sets these on each render. set_indicator(label, color), clear_indicator() Set or clear the status indicator next to the title. clear_actions_menu() Remove all items of the Actions dropdown.

docs.title: frm.toolbar
docs.text:
frappe.ui.form.Toolbar builds the title, the indicator, the primary button and the ... menu on each render.

Method Description refresh() Build the menu, title, indicator and primary action again. set_primary_action(dirty) Set the primary button for the current state: Save, Submit, Update, Cancel or Amend. get_action_status() Return "Submit", "Save", "Update", "Cancel", "Amend", "Edit" or null. set_indicator() Set the indicator from frappe.get_indicator(frm.doc). set_title() Set the form title. show_linked_with() Open the Links dialog. show_jump_to_field_dialog() Open the Jump to Field dialog. can_save(), can_submit(), can_update(), can_cancel(), can_amend(), can_repeat(), can_rename() Return true if the action applies now. has_workflow(), get_docstatus() Workflow check and cint(frm.doc.docstatus).

The other add_* and make_* methods build the menu.

Do not call get_dropdown_menu(label). It calls frm.page.add_dropdown, which does not exist on develop, so it throws.

The form adds these keyboard shortcuts: shift+ctrl+> next record, shift+ctrl+< previous record, ctrl+p print, shift+ctrl+z redo.

docs.title: frm.dashboard
docs.text:
frappe.ui.form.Dashboard is the area at the top of the form. It holds messages, progress bars, indicators, the connections links, a heatmap and a chart. The connections data comes from the <doctype>_dashboard.py file of the DocType (frm.meta.__dashboard).

Method Description set_headline(html, color, permanent = false) Show a message at the top of the form. set_headline_alert(text, color, permanent = false) Same, wrapped in a div. With no text, clear it. frm.set_intro uses this. clear_headline() Clear the message. add_comment(text, alert_class, permanent) Show a message. Clears it after 10 seconds unless permanent. clear_comment() Clear the message. add_indicator(label, color) Add a colored indicator in the stats area. Returns the element. add_progress(title, percent, message) Add a progress bar. percent is a number or a list of {title, width, progress_class}. show_progress(title, percent, message) Add or update the progress bar with this title. hide_progress(title) Remove one progress bar, or all with no title. add_section(body_html, label = null, css_class = "custom", hidden = false) Add a collapsible section. Returns its body. add_transactions(opts) Add connection groups {label, items} to the connections area. render_graph(args) Draw a chart with frappe.ui.chart arguments. update_heatmap(data) Update the heatmap data points. show(), hide() Show or hide the dashboard. refresh() Render the dashboard again. Runs on each form render. 
frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order", {
    refresh(frm) {
        frm.dashboard.add_indicator(__("Total: {0}", [format_currency(frm.doc.total)]), "blue");
    },
});

docs.title: frm.timeline
docs.text:
frm.timeline is a FormTimeline. It exists when the DocType does not hide the toolbar and Desk Settings shows the timeline.

Method Description refresh() Render the timeline again, then run timeline_refresh. add_action_button(label, action, icon = null, btn_class = null) Add a button above the timeline. Returns the button. add_timeline_item(item, append_at_the_end = false) Add one item. item has content and creation, and can have timeline_badge, icon, icon_size, hide_timestamp and is_card. add_timeline_items(items, append_at_the_end = false) Add many items. add_timeline_items_based_on_creation(items) Insert items at the place of their creation time. compose_mail(communication_doc = null, reply_all = false) Open the email composer.

Items added in timeline_refresh stay until the next render. To add items from the server, use the additional_timeline_content hook. See Hooks.

docs.title: frm.sidebar
docs.text:
frappe.ui.form.Sidebar exists when Desk Settings shows the form sidebar.

Method Description add_user_action(label, click) Add a link to the sidebar. Returns the link. clear_user_actions() Remove these links. refresh() Render the sidebar again. reload_docinfo(callback) Load docinfo again with frappe.desk.form.load.get_docinfo, then call callback(docinfo).

docs.title: frappe.ui.form.ScriptManager
docs.text:
frm.script_manager loads the form scripts of the DocType and runs events.

Method Description trigger(event_name, doctype, name) Run all handlers of the event, one after the other, and return a promise. doctype and name default to the form document. Pass the child DocType and row name for a child event. Sets frm.selected_doc. get_handlers(event_name, doctype) Return {new_style: [...], old_style: [...]}. New style: handlers of the DocType, then of "*". Old style: names of frm.cscript methods. has_handlers(event_name, doctype) Return a truthy value if the event has a handler. has_handler(event_name) Return the new-style handler list of the form DocType for the event, if any. copy_from_first_row(parentfield, current_row, fieldnames) Copy fields of the first row into current_row with frappe.model.set_value. setup() Run the DocType JS, the layout client script and Client Scripts, bind the controller, set up fetch_from, then run setup. Desk calls it. bind_controller(), make(ControllerClass) Bind the class set with set_controller. log_error(caller, e) Show an alert and log the error.

docs.title: Grid and GridRow
docs.text: The grid of a Table field is frm.fields_dict.<table_fieldname>.grid or frm.get_field(table_fieldname).grid. The classes are not on frappe.ui.form. Their constructors are Grid and GridRow.

docs.title: Grid
docs.text: Method or property Description add_new_row(idx, callback, show, copy_doc, go_to_last_page = false, go_to_first_page = false) Add a row, run <table>_add and render. With idx, insert at that position. With show, open the row form. copy_doc copies its values. Returns the row, or nothing if rows cannot be added. get_row(key) Return the GridRow by index (negative counts from the end) or by row name. get_grid_row(key) Same as get_row. get_selected() Return the names of the selected rows. get_selected_children() Return the selected rows. select_row(name) Select a row. get_data() Return the rows. get_docfield(fieldname) Return the child DocField copy of this form. get_field(fieldname) Return an object where you set get_query for a child Link field. frm.set_query uses it. update_docfield_property(fieldname, property, value) Set a child DocField property for all rows and new rows, then render. Throws if the field is not found. toggle_reqd(fieldname, reqd), toggle_enable(fieldname, enable), toggle_display(fieldname, show) Set reqd, read_only or hidden through update_docfield_property. set_column_disp(fieldname, show) Show or hide a column. Changes the shared DocField. fieldname can be a list. set_column_disp_in_list_view(fieldname, show) Show or hide a column in this grid only. toggle_checkboxes(enable) Enable or disable the row checkboxes. add_custom_button(label, click, position = "bottom") Add a button below the grid, or above it with "top". Returns the button. clear_custom_buttons() Hide the custom buttons. set_multiple_add(link_fieldname, qty_fieldname) Show the Add Multiple button. It opens a search dialog for the Link field. only_sortable(status) Allow drag to reorder, but no other edits. is_editable(), is_sortable(), allow_on_grid_editing() Return the state of the grid. delete_rows(), delete_all_rows(), duplicate_rows() Delete the selected rows, ask and delete all rows, or copy the selected rows. Run the remove and delete events. refresh(), refresh_row(docname), reset_grid() Render the grid, one row, or the grid with its columns again. set_focus_on_row(idx) Focus the first input of a row. grid_rows, grid_rows_by_docname, data, docfields, doctype, df, frm Rows, rows by name, row data, child DocFields, child DocType, Table DocField and form. cannot_add_rows Set true to block new rows. df.cannot_add_rows and df.cannot_delete_rows also work.

docs.title: GridRow
Quick entry
docs.text:
frappe.ui.form.make_quick_entry(doctype, after_insert, init_callback, doc, force, skip_insert) opens a frappe.ui.form.QuickEntryForm, a frappe.ui.Dialog with the mandatory fields and the fields with allow_in_quick_entry.

Argument Description doctype DocType of the new document. after_insert(doc) Called after the insert. Without it, the new document opens unless you are in a list view. init_callback(dialog) Called after the dialog renders. If the full form opens, called with the document. doc A local document to start from. Default: a new document from frappe.model.get_new_doc. force Show the dialog even if quick entry does not apply. skip_insert Do not insert. Call after_insert with the values.

The dialog shows only if the DocType has Quick Entry set, has no mandatory Table field, and has at least one field to show. Else the full form opens. The dialog saves with frappe.client.save. For a submittable DocType without a workflow, the primary button then changes to Submit.

To change the dialog of one DocType, define frappe.ui.form.<DocType without spaces>QuickEntryForm as a subclass of frappe.ui.form.QuickEntryForm. Frappe has AddressQuickEntryForm and ContactQuickEntryForm.

Method Description set_df_property(fieldname, prop, value) Set a field property in the dialog. toggle_display(fieldnames, show), toggle_enable(fieldnames, enable), toggle_reqd(fieldnames, mandatory) Change fields of the dialog. set_intro(text, color) Show a message in the dialog. insert(values) Save the document. Returns a promise of the document. open_doc(set_hooks) Close the dialog and open the full form with the values. update_doc(data) Copy dialog values into doc. render_dialog(), register_primary_action(), set_defaults(), is_quick_entry() Override these in a subclass to change the dialog.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• frappe.ui.form.off removes all handlers of the event, not only the one you pass.
  • frm.add_child, frm.clear_table and direct changes to frm.doc do not render. Call frm.refresh_field().
  • frm.set_value is asynchronous. Use await before you save or read values that other handlers set.
  • frm.get_sum gives NaN if a row has no value in the column. Sum with flt() if values can be empty.
  • frm.set_value sets parent fields only. Use frappe.model.set_value(cdt, cdn, ...) for a row.
  • frm.is_new() returns undefined for a saved document, not false.
  • Set field properties and buttons in refresh. setup runs once per DocType, and the toolbar is cleared on each render.
  • A form script is not a security check. Repeat each rule in the controller.

docs.title: frappe (JavaScript)
docs.text:
This page lists the functions and properties of the global frappe object in desk (/desk). Use it to look up a signature, a default or a side effect. The names come from Object.keys() on a logged-in desk page on develop. The signatures come from the source files in the frontmatter. For how-to guides, see Client API and Form Scripts.

Other parts of the client API have their own pages:

Namespace Page frappe.utils, frappe.datetime, frappe.format, flt, cint, frappe.dom Utils and Formatting frappe.ui.form.Form (frm), grids, form events Form frappe.model, frappe.db, locals, frappe.perm Model and DB frappe.ui.Dialog, frappe.ui.Page, other UI classes UI Components List, report, Kanban, calendar and tree views List and Report Views REST routes that these calls use REST Endpoints

docs.title: frappe.call
docs.text:
frappe.call(opts)
frappe.call(method, args, callback, headers)

Calls a whitelisted server method. The default URL is /api/method/<method>. With the string form, the four arguments become opts.method, opts.args, opts.callback and opts.headers.

Returns the jQuery jqXHR of the request. It is a thenable. It resolves with the response body (r.message holds the return value). On an HTTP error it rejects with the jqXHR object. When debounce skips the call, it returns Promise.resolve().

Option Type Default Description method string Dotted path of the whitelisted method. With doc, the name of the controller method. args object {} Arguments. Objects and arrays are sent as JSON strings in a form-encoded body. type string "POST" HTTP method. callback(r, response_text) function Runs after a 200 response. error(r) function Runs after an error. The argument depends on the status code. For 417 it is the parsed body. For 404 and 403 it is undefined. always(r) function Runs after success or error, with the parsed body or null. doc object Run method as a controller method of this document. Sends cmd=run_doc_method and the document from locals as docs. module, page string With both set, calls <module>.page.<page>.<page>.<method>. btn element Disable this button while the request runs. freeze bool false Show a full-page overlay (frappe.dom.freeze) while the request runs. freeze_message string Text on the overlay. headers object {} Extra request headers. error_handlers object {} Map of exception name (exc_type) to handler for this call. See below. silent bool false Do not show _server_messages from the response. Status-code dialogs (403, 404, 500 and others) still show. async bool true false makes a blocking request. debounce number Skip the call if a call with the same args was sent less than this many ms ago. cache bool false Let the browser cache the response. Ignored when window.dev_server is set. api_version string Use /api/<api_version>/method/. With "v2", messages are read from r.messages. url string Request this URL instead of /api/method/<method>. json bool Force a JSON body (true) or a form-encoded body (false). Default: JSON when the app of the method is in frappe.boot.json_request_apps. Never for GET. queued(data) function Runs when the server returns a task_id (a queued call). The client subscribes to the task with frappe.realtime.subscribe. quiet bool Sets opts.no_spinner. frappe.call does not pass it on, so it has no effect.

Each request sends the headers X-Frappe-CSRF-Token, Accept: application/json and X-Frappe-CMD. If args.doctype is set, it also sends X-Frappe-Doctype.

What happens with the response:

  1. docs and docinfo in the response are synced into locals (frappe.model.sync).
  2. __messages are merged into the translation dictionary. _link_titles are merged into the link title cache.
  3. Handlers for r.exc_type run: first the global ones from frappe.request.on_error, then the one in opts.error_handlers.
  4. If no handler ran and silent is not set, _server_messages are shown with frappe.msgprint.
  5. Some status codes show their own dialog: 403 "Not permitted", 404 "Not found", 413 "File too big", 500 "Server Error" (with a copy or report button), 502, 504 and 508. A 401 or an expired session opens the session-expired dialog.
  6. QueryTimeoutError and QueryDeadlockError show a "please try again" dialog.
const r = await frappe.call({
    method: "frappe.client.get_count",
    args: { doctype: "ToDo" },
    type: "GET",
});
// r.message -> number of ToDo records

frappe.call("frappe.ping").then((r) => console.log(r.message)); // "pong"

Routing
docs.text:
Desk routes start with /desk. A route is an array, for example ["List", "ToDo", "List"] or ["Form", "ToDo", "<name>"].

Function Description frappe.set_route(...parts) Go to a route. Accepts parts ("Form", "ToDo", name), one array, or one path string ("todo/view/report" or "/desk/todo?status=Open"). A plain object in the parts becomes frappe.route_options. Returns a Promise that resolves after the new page loads. Clears frappe.route_flags. frappe.get_route() Current route array (frappe.router.current_route). frappe.get_route_str() Current route joined with /, for example "List/ToDo/List". frappe.get_prev_route() Previous route array from frappe.route_history, or []. frappe.set_re_route(...parts) Call frappe.set_route and record a redirect from the old sub path to the new one in frappe.re_route. frappe.has_route_options() Return true if frappe.route_options has keys. Property Description frappe.route_options Object or null. Set it before set_route. Its keys become the query string. A list view reads them as filters. A new form reads them as values. The router sets it from the query string of the URL. frappe.route_flags Flags for the next route. replace_route uses history.replaceState instead of pushState. jump marks a route picked from outside the sidebar. frappe.open_in_new_tab Set to true before set_route to open the route in a new tab. Reset after the call. frappe.route_history List of visited routes. frappe.route_titles Map of sub path to page title. frappe.re_route Map of old sub path to new sub path. frappe.route_hooks Object for app code. Empty by default.

Route conversion (frappe.router.convert_from_standard_route):

Route URL ["List", "Sample Item"] /desk/sample-item ["List", "Note", "Report"] /desk/note/view/report ["Form", "Sample Item", "ITEM-1"] /desk/sample-item/ITEM-1 ["Tree", "Sample Item"] /desk/sample-item/view/tree

The router can add a sidebar shell segment to the URL after /desk, for example /desk/build/todo. frappe.get_route() does not contain it.

frappe.router members that app code can use:

Member Description on(evt, handler) Run handler(router) on an event. The router triggers "change" after each route change. once(evt, handler) Run handler on the next event only. off(evt, handler) Does not remove the handler. See Pitfalls. trigger(evt, data) Trigger an event. current_route Current route array. slug(name) Lowercase name and replace spaces with -. "Sample Order Item" becomes "sample-order-item". routes Map of slug to { doctype } for each DocType the user can read. list_views View names valid after /view/: list, kanban, report, calendar, tree, gantt, dashboard, image, inbox, map. get_sub_path(route) Current path after /desk/, decoded. make_url(params) Build /desk/<parts> from an array. convert_from_standard_route(route) Convert a route array to URL parts (table above). 
frappe.route_options = { status: "Open" };
await frappe.set_route("List", "ToDo");
// URL: /desk/<shell>/todo?status=Open

frappe.router.on("change", () => console.log(frappe.get_route_str()));

docs.title: Realtime
docs.text:
frappe.realtime is a RealTimeClient that wraps a Socket.IO client. frappe.socketio is the same object. It connects to <origin>/<sitename>, on port frappe.boot.socketio_port when window.dev_server is set. If frappe.boot.disable_async is set, it does not connect and all methods do nothing. See Realtime.

Method Description on(event, callback) Listen to an event that the server sends with frappe.publish_realtime. off(event, callback) Remove callback. Without callback, Socket.IO removes only the first listener of the event. emit(event, ...args) Send an event to the Socket.IO server. The server only handles its own events (below). publish(event, message) Same as emit(event, message). The server does not relay it to other clients. doc_subscribe(doctype, docname) Join the room of a document. The server checks read permission. Calls within 1 second of the last doc_subscribe are dropped. Forms call it on load. doc_unsubscribe(doctype, docname) Leave the room of a document. doc_open(doctype, docname) / doc_close(doctype, docname) Join or leave the "who is viewing" room. Forms call them on refresh and unload. doctype_subscribe(doctype) / doctype_unsubscribe(doctype) Join or leave the room of a DocType (list updates). Counts callers. The room is left when the count is 0. task_subscribe(task_id) / task_unsubscribe(task_id) Join or leave the room of a task. subscribe(task_id, opts) Join the task and progress rooms. When the task status changes, call opts.success, opts.callback, opts.always or opts.error. frappe.call uses it for queued calls. Property Description socket The Socket.IO client. disabled true when disable_async is set. open_docs Set of "<doctype>:<name>" keys of subscribed documents. subscribed_doctypes Map of DocType to the number of subscribers.

Events that the client handles by default: msgprint (calls frappe.msgprint), progress (calls frappe.show_progress), task_status_change and task_progress. After a reconnect, the client subscribes again to its DocTypes and documents.

frappe.realtime.on("sample_order_ready", (data) => {
    frappe.show_alert(__("Order {0} is ready", [data.order]));
});

# server side
frappe.publish_realtime("sample_order_ready", {"order": "SO-0001"}, user="Administrator")

docs.title: Boot and session
docs.text:
frappe.boot is the object that frappe/boot.py (get_bootinfo) sends when desk loads. Apps add keys with the boot_session hook. These keys are used most:

Key Description user Current user: name, email, roles, defaults, user_type, language, mute_sounds, default_workspace, user_permissions, permission lists (can_read, can_write, can_create, can_submit, can_cancel, can_delete, can_print, can_email, can_export, can_import, can_search, can_get_report, can_select, in_create, all_read), allow_modules, permitted_modules, impersonated_by. user_info Map of user name to { fullname, image, name, email, time_zone }. sysdefaults System defaults: date_format, time_format, number_format, currency, currency_precision, float_precision, rounding_method, country, time_zone, first_day_of_the_week, setup_complete and more. sitename Site name. lang, lang_dict Language code of the user. Map of language name to code. time_zone { system, user } time zone names. server_date Server date as yyyy-mm-dd. versions Map of app name to version. app_data Installed apps with app_name, app_title, logo and route. single_types, nested_set_doctypes, tree_view_doctypes DocType name lists. module_app Map of scrubbed module name to app. max_file_size, file_chunk_size Upload limits in bytes. socketio_port Port of the Socket.IO server. json_request_apps Apps that receive JSON request bodies. assets_json Map of bundle name to built file. desk_settings, navbar_settings Desk and navbar settings. home_page Default page after login. read_only true when the site is in read-only mode. developer_mode Set when developer mode is on. disable_async Set when realtime is turned off.

Globals that desk sets from the boot (set_globals in frappe/public/js/frappe/desk.js):

Name Value frappe.session.user frappe.boot.user.name. "Guest" for website visitors. frappe.session.logged_in_user Same as user at boot. frappe.session.user_email frappe.boot.user.email. frappe.session.user_fullname Full name from frappe.user_info(). frappe.user_roles frappe.boot.user.roles. frappe.user_defaults frappe.boot.user.defaults. frappe.sys_defaults frappe.boot.sysdefaults. frappe.ui.py_date_format System date format in Python strftime form, for example %d-%m-%Y.

docs.title: User
docs.text:
frappe.user holds the current user name and helpers. String(frappe.user) returns the name, so frappe.user == "Administrator" works.

Member Description frappe.user.name Current user name. "Guest" before boot. frappe.user.has_role(rl) Return true if the user has the role, or one of a list of roles. Returns undefined, not false, when there is no match. frappe.user.is_report_manager() has_role(["Administrator", "System Manager", "Report Manager"]). frappe.user.full_name(uid) Full name of a user. Returns the translated "You" for the current user. frappe.user.image(uid) Image URL of a user, or null. frappe.user.abbr(uid) Initials of a user. frappe.user.get_formatted_email(email) "Full Name <email>". The name is quoted if it has special characters. It looks up email as a user name. frappe.user.get_emails() Email addresses of all users in frappe.boot.user_info. frappe.user_info(uid) Return { fullname, image, name, email, time_zone, abbr, color } for a user. Defaults to the current user. An unknown user gets { fullname: uid, abbr, color }. frappe.update_user_info(user_info) Merge a map of user name to info into frappe.boot.user_info. frappe.session_alive false after 30 seconds without mouse movement. 
if (frappe.user.has_role("Sample Role")) {
    frm.add_custom_button(__("Approve"), () => {});
}
frappe.user_info("Administrator").fullname; // "Administrator"

docs.title: Defaults
docs.text:
frappe.defaults reads defaults from the boot. User defaults are in frappe.boot.user.defaults. System defaults are in frappe.sys_defaults.

Function Description get_default(key) User default for key. Parses JSON values. For a DocType name key (for example "Company"), uses the single User Permission value, or the scrubbed key. Returns undefined if the value is not allowed by User Permissions. get_user_default(key) User default for key. For a DocType name key, prefers the default User Permission. Returns the first value of a list. Does not parse JSON. get_user_defaults(key) All allowed values for key, as a list. get_global_default(key) System default for key. Returns the first value of a list. get_global_defaults(key) System default for key, as a list. is_enabled(key) true if the system default is 1. set_user_default_local(key, value) Set a user default in the browser only. Does not save it. get_user_permissions() User Permissions of the current user: { <doctype>: [{ doc, is_default, ... }] }. update_user_permissions() Load User Permissions again from the server (get_current_user_permissions). load_user_permission_from_boot() Load User Permissions from frappe.boot.user.user_permissions, or from the server if missing. is_a_user_permission_key(key) true if key has no : and is not already scrubbed, for example "Company". in_user_permission(key, value) true if value is allowed for the DocType key, or if there is no User Permission for it. 
frappe.defaults.get_default("date_format");     // "dd-mm-yyyy" on a site with that format
frappe.defaults.get_global_default("currency"); // system currency

docs.title: Metadata
docs.text:
Function Description frappe.get_meta(doctype) DocType document from locals.DocType. Returns undefined until the DocType is loaded. Load it with frappe.model.with_doctype (see Model and DB).

frappe.meta reads the fields of loaded DocTypes. name is a document name. With a name, the functions use a per-document copy of the fields, so property changes apply to one document only.

Function Description get_docfield(doctype, fieldname, name) Field definition, or null. get_field(doctype, fieldname, name) Like get_docfield, but also finds standard fields such as owner and creation. get_docfields(doctype, name, filters, docfield_list = null) Field definitions sorted by idx. filters is an object such as { fieldtype: "Link" }. get_fieldnames(doctype, name, filters) Fieldnames that match filters. has_field(dt, fn) The field definition if it exists, else undefined. get_table_fields(dt, include_computed = false) Table fields. Virtual tables only with include_computed. get_parentfield(parent_dt, child_dt) Fieldname of the table field for child_dt. Throws if none. get_doctype_for_field(doctype, key) DocType (parent or child) that has the field key. get_linked_fields(doctype) options of all Link fields. get_label(dt, fn, dn) Label of a field. Standard fields have fixed labels, for example owner is "Created By". Returns fn if no label. get_translated_label(dt, fn, dn) Translated label, with dt as context. get_field_precision(df, doc) Precision of a field: df.precision, else for Currency the currency_precision default or the currency number format, else float_precision (default 3). get_field_currency(df, doc) Currency of a Currency field, from df.options and doc. Defaults to the system currency or "USD". get_print_formats(doctype) Print format names available for the DocType. "Standard" first, the default print format before it. get_restricted_print_formats(doctype) Print formats that the user cannot use because of their roles. get_print_sizes() Page sizes: "A0" to "A9", "B0" to "B10", "Letter", "Legal", "Custom" and others. set_formatter(doctype, fieldname, name, formatter) Set df.formatter on a field. set_indicator_formatter(doctype, fieldname, name, get_text, get_color) Set a formatter that shows an indicator pill. get_docfield_copy(doctype, name, docfield_list = null) Map of fieldname to field definition for one document. make_docfield_copy_for(doctype, docname, docfield_list = null) Make that per-document copy. sort_docfields(docs) Sort field definitions by idx. sync(doc) Add the fields of a DocType document to the maps. Called when a DocType loads. add_field(df) Add one field definition to the maps. get_fields_to_check_permissions(doctype) Link fields that check User Permissions, plus an ID entry. Property Description frappe.meta.docfield_map { doctype: { fieldname: df } }. frappe.meta.docfield_list { doctype: [df] }. frappe.meta.docfield_copy { doctype: { docname: { fieldname: df } } }. 
await frappe.model.with_doctype("Sample Order");
frappe.meta.get_label("Sample Order", "owner");                // "Created By"
frappe.meta.get_parentfield("Sample Order", "Sample Order Item"); // "items"

docs.title: Toolbar
docs.text:
frappe.ui.toolbar helpers. The develop desk has no navbar with #navbar-<name> menus or a .navbar-right element, so the menu helpers find nothing.

Function Description clear_cache() Clear local storage caches, call frappe.sessions.clear, show the result and reload. Throttled to once every 10 seconds. Shortcut Shift+Ctrl+R. show_about() Open the About dialog. route_to_user() Open the User form of the current user. view_website() Open /index in a new tab. toggle_full_width() Toggle full-width mode. Saves it in localStorage.container_fullwidth. Triggers toggleFullWidth on body. set_fullwidth_if_enabled() Apply the saved full-width mode. show_shortcuts(e) Open the keyboard shortcuts dialog. fetch_session_defaults() Load Session Default Settings into frappe.boot.session_defaults. setup_session_defaults() Open the Session Defaults dialog. Saving it clears the cache. add_dropdown_button(parent, label, click, icon) Add an item to the menu #navbar-<parent>. get_menu(label) jQuery of #navbar-<label>. add_menu_divider(menu) Add a divider to a menu. add_icon_link(route, icon, index, class_name) Add an icon link to .navbar-right. Throws on develop because the element does not exist.

docs.title: Keyboard shortcuts
docs.text:
frappe.ui.keys binds keys on window. A key name is lowercase. Modifiers come first in the order alt+, shift+, ctrl+. On macOS, Cmd counts as ctrl. Examples: "ctrl+s", "shift+ctrl+r", "alt+shift+ctrl+s", "shift+/".

Function Description add_shortcut({ shortcut, action, description, page, target, condition, ignore_inputs = false }) Add a shortcut and list it in the shortcuts dialog. Details below. on(key, handler) Add a raw handler handler(e). It also runs while an input has focus. If it returns false, the default action is blocked. off(key, page) Remove the handlers of key that are attached to page. Without page, removes all handlers of key. get_key(e) Key name of a keyboard event, for example "shift+ctrl+s". get_shortcut_label(shortcut) Display label. On macOS, Ctrl+, Alt+ and Shift+ become ⌘, ⌥ and ⇧. show_keyboard_shortcut_dialog() Open the shortcuts dialog. Shortcut Shift+/. get_shortcut_groups() Global, page and grid shortcut groups for the dialog. get_shortcut_group(parent) AltShortcutGroup of an object. Used for Alt+letter shortcuts in menus and the sidebar. Property Description handlers { key: [handler] }. standard_shortcuts Shortcuts added with add_shortcut. key_map Map of key code to name: letters, enter, escape, tab, space, arrows, f1 to f5, /, <, >, shift, ctrl, alt, meta, backspace. frappe.ui.keyCode Key codes: ESCAPE, LEFT, RIGHT, UP, DOWN, ENTER, TAB, SPACE, BACKSPACE.

Options of add_shortcut:

Option Default Description shortcut Key name. action(e) Runs on the key. If it returns nothing or a truthy value, the default browser action is blocked. description Text in the shortcuts dialog. Without it, the shortcut is not listed. page A page object (for example frm.page or cur_page.page.page). The shortcut runs only while page.wrapper is visible. target A jQuery element. The shortcut clicks it. Replaces action. condition() () => true The shortcut runs only when this returns a truthy value. ignore_inputs false Also run while an input, select, textarea or editable element has focus.

add_shortcut first calls off(shortcut, page). A new shortcut with the same key and page replaces the old one. A global shortcut (no page) removes all other handlers of that key, including built-in ones.

Global shortcuts on develop:

Key Action ctrl+s Trigger the primary action (for example Save). ctrl+k Toggle the awesomebar. ctrl+g Open global search. shift+/ Show keyboard shortcuts. shift+ctrl+r Clear cache and reload. shift+t Open the console (needs write access to System Console). ctrl+/ Toggle the sidebar. shift+ctrl+g Switch the theme. shift+ctrl+/ Open the app dock. escape Close the open grid row or dialog. enter Click the primary button of a confirm dialog. ctrl+up / ctrl+down Open the previous or next grid row. 
frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order", {
    refresh(frm) {
        frappe.ui.keys.add_shortcut({
            shortcut: "shift+ctrl+a",
            action: () => frm.trigger("approve"),
            description: __("Approve order"),
            page: frm.page,
        });
    },
});

docs.title: Other functions
docs.text: Function Returns Description frappe.render_template(name, data) string Render a client template. name is a key of frappe.templates (built from .html files in the bundle), or a template string if it has a space. Throws if not found. frappe.render(str, data, name) string Compile and render a template string. Supports {{ expr }}, {% if %}, {% else %}, {% endif %}, {% for x in list %}, {% endfor %} and plain JavaScript in {% %}. frappe.template.compile(str, name) function Compile a template. Cached by name or by str. frappe.run_serially(tasks) Promise Run functions one after the other. A function can return a Promise. Falsy entries are skipped. frappe.timeout(seconds) Promise Resolve after seconds. frappe.load_image(src, onload, onerror, preprocess = () => {}) Load an image. onload(img) runs when it loads. frappe.markdown(txt) string Convert Markdown to HTML with showdown. Removes tags and attributes that are not on an allow list (for example javascript: links). frappe.get_abbr(txt, max_length) string Initials of the words, up to max_length (default 2). Returns "" for empty input. frappe.get_palette(txt) array [bg_var, color_var] CSS variable names, picked from a hash of txt. frappe.avatar(user, css_class, title, image_url = null, remove_color = false, filterable = false) string Avatar HTML of a user. Default class avatar-small. frappe.get_avatar(css_class, title, image_url = null, remove_color, data_attributes) string Avatar HTML from a title and an image. frappe.avatar_group(users, limit = 4, options = {}) jQuery Group of avatars. Extra users show as +N. options: css_class, filterable, action_icon, action, align, overlap. frappe.get_data_pill(label, target_id = null, remove_action = null, image = null, colored = false) jQuery A pill button. remove_action(target_id or label, $pill) adds a remove icon. frappe.get_modal(title, content) jQuery Bare Bootstrap modal markup. Use frappe.ui.Dialog instead. frappe.create_shadow_element(wrapper, html, css, js) Render HTML, CSS and JS inside a shadow DOM in wrapper. Script and style tags are removed from html. frappe.get_cookie(name) string Value of a cookie. frappe.get_cookies() object All cookies that JavaScript can read. frappe.is_mobile() bool true when the window is narrower than 768 px. frappe.is_large_screen() bool true when the window is taller than 1180 px. frappe.is_online() bool navigator.onLine. Always true in developer mode. frappe.preview_email(template, args, header, with_container = false, only_html = false) Promise Render an email template on the server (frappe.email.email_body.get_email_html). Shows it in a dialog, or resolves with the HTML if only_html. frappe.render_pdf(html, opts = {}) Post html to frappe.utils.print_format.report_to_pdf and download the PDF. opts: orientation, print_format, report_name. frappe.download_report_pdf(args, filename) Post args to frappe.utils.print_format.download_report_pdf and download the PDF. frappe.get_module(m, default_module) object Module definition from frappe.modules.

docs.title: Deprecated
docs.text: Name Use instead frappe.verify_password(callback) frappe.confirm_sensitive_action(callback). It now calls that function and logs a warning. It does not ask for a password.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• frappe.call rejects with the jqXHR object, not with an Error. Read xhr.responseJSON for details.
  • silent: true hides only _server_messages. A 404 or 403 still shows a dialog.
  • quiet has no effect.
  • debounce stores all calls under one log key ("undefined"), because args.cmd is removed before the check. The check still compares the full args.
  • frappe.router.off(evt, handler) does not remove the handler. It unbinds a new wrapper function. Use once or a flag in the handler.
  • frappe.realtime.off(event) without a callback removes only one listener.
  • frappe.realtime.doc_subscribe drops a second call within 1 second. Only the first document is subscribed.
  • frappe.ui.keys.off(key) without page removes every handler of key, including built-in ones.
  • frappe.user.full_name() returns "You" for the current user. frappe.user.get_formatted_email() uses it, so the current user gets "You <...>".
  • frappe.user.has_role() returns undefined instead of false.
  • frappe.meta.get_fields_to_check_permissions() uses the global window.name as a fieldname. The ID entry has an empty fieldname.
  • frappe.get_meta() returns undefined for a DocType that is not loaded yet.

docs.title: List and Report Views (JavaScript)
docs.text:
Each desk view reads a settings object from a global registry. An app fills the registry in a JavaScript file next to the DocType or the report. This page lists every key each view reads, with its arguments, and the view methods you can call from those keys. For where the files go, the hooks and worked examples, see List View Settings and Reports.

Registry Filled by Read by frappe.listview_settings[doctype] <doctype>_list.js, hook doctype_list_js, Client Script with view = List List, Report, Gantt, Map, Kanban, Image and other list-based views, indicators frappe.query_reports[report_name] <report_name>.js in the report folder, or the javascript field of a Report Query and Script Report view frappe.views.calendar[doctype] <doctype>_calendar.js, hook doctype_calendar_js Calendar and Gantt views frappe.treeview_settings[doctype] <doctype>_tree.js, hook doctype_tree_js Tree view frappe.kanban_v2.settings[doctype] <doctype>_kanban.js, hook doctype_kanban_js Kanban boards on Kanban v2 frappe.dashboards.chart_sources[source] <source>.js in <module>/dashboard_chart_source/<source>/ Dashboard Charts with chart_type = Custom

docs.title: listview_settings
docs.text:
frappe.listview_settings[doctype] is read when a view is set up, so changes after that need a new view (reload the page).

Key Type Read by Description add_fields list list, report Extra fields to fetch for each row. Add every field that get_indicator, button or formatters reads. filters list list Default filters, [fieldname, operator, value] or [doctype, fieldname, operator, value]. Used only when the user has no saved filters for the view. hide_name_column bool list Hide the "ID" column. That column shows only when the DocType has a title_field other than name. hide_name_filter bool list Hide the "ID" filter in the standard filter bar. custom_filter_configs list or function list Extra standard filter fields, as field definitions. A function can return a list or a Promise of one. get_indicator(doc) function indicators Return [label, color, filter]. filter is "fieldname,operator,value", applied on click. Return nothing to fall through to the next rule. has_indicator_for_draft bool indicators Use get_indicator for drafts of a submittable DocType. has_indicator_for_cancelled bool indicators Use get_indicator for cancelled documents. formatters object list { fieldname: (value, df, doc) => html }. On the subject (first) column, the result shows as text. button object list Row button: show(doc), get_label(doc), get_description(doc), action(doc). All four are required. dropdown_button object list Row dropdown: get_label (a string) and buttons, a list of { get_label, show(doc), get_description(doc), action(doc) }. get_label of a button is a string. show and get_description are optional. onload(listview) function list, report Runs once when the view is set up, after the columns. before_render() function list Runs before each render of the rows. No arguments. refresh(listview) function list, report Runs after each data load and render. primary_action() function list Replaces the "Add" button action and the "Create" button of the empty state. get_form_link(doc) function list Return the URL a row opens. Default /desk/<doctype-slug>/<name>. reports list view switcher Extra reports in the switcher: { name, title, report_type, ref_doctype, route }. get_coords_method any view switcher Shows "Map" in the view switcher. The Map view does not call it. gantt_custom_popup_html(task, doc) function gantt Return the HTML of the task popup.

The indicator rules in frappe/public/js/frappe/model/indicator.js run in this order: unsaved, workflow state, draft and cancelled (submittable only), DocType states that match doc.status, get_indicator, submitted, status, enabled, disabled.

// sample_app/sample_module/doctype/sample_order/sample_order_list.js
frappe.listview_settings["Sample Order"] = {
    add_fields: ["status", "total"],
    hide_name_filter: true,
    has_indicator_for_draft: true,
    get_indicator(doc) {
        const colors = { Draft: "gray", Open: "orange", Completed: "green" };
        return [__(doc.status), colors[doc.status] || "gray", "status,=," + doc.status];
    },
    formatters: {
        total: (value) => `<b>${format_currency(value)}</b>`,
    },
    dropdown_button: {
        get_label: __("More"),
        buttons: [{ get_label: __("Copy Name"), action: (doc) => frappe.utils.copy_to_clipboard(doc.name) }],
    },
    onload(listview) {
        listview.page.add_actions_menu_item(__("Mark Completed"), () =>
            listview.call_for_selected_items("sample_app.api.mark_completed")
        );
    },
};

docs.title: ListView members
docs.text:
frappe.views.ListView extends frappe.views.BaseList. The settings functions get the instance as listview. Other ways to reach it:

Name Description window.cur_list The list-based view on screen, or null. frappe.get_list_view(doctype) The List view of doctype made in this session (frappe.views.list_view["List/<doctype>/List"]). frappe.views.list_view[route] All list-based views made, by route string. Member Description doctype, meta, view_name DocType, its meta and the view name ("List", "Report", "Kanban", ...). page The frappe.ui.Page. See UI Components. data Rows of the current page. settings The listview_settings object, or {}. list_view_settings The List View Settings record (disable_count, disable_auto_refresh, ...). start, page_length Paging. page_length is 20, or 100 on a large screen. sort_by, sort_order Current sort. refresh() Load and render the data again. Returns a Promise. get_checked_items(only_docnames) Checked rows, or their names. clear_checked_items() Uncheck all rows. call_for_selected_items(method, args = {}) frappe.call(method) with args.names set to the checked names, with freeze. Refreshes on success. get_filter_value(fieldname) Value of a filter. like values lose their %. get_args() Arguments of the frappe.desk.reportview.get call. make_new_doc() Open a new form. Copies = filters into the new document. filter_area Filter controller. See below. filter_area method Returns Description get() list All filters, standard filters included, as [doctype, fieldname, operator, value]. add(filters, refresh = true) Promise Add filters (a list of 4-item lists, or one filter as arguments). Filters that exist are skipped. set(filters) Promise Add filters without a refresh. remove(fieldname) Promise Remove the filter of a field. remove_filters(filters) Remove the filters of the fields in filters. clear(refresh = true) Promise Remove all filters. exists(filter) bool Check a filter. 
await cur_list.filter_area.add([["Sample Order", "status", "=", "Draft"]]);
cur_list.get_filter_value("status"); // "Draft"

Other registries: frappe.views.view_modes lists the view names (List, Report, Dashboard, Gantt, Kanban, Calendar, Image, Inbox, Tree, Map). frappe.views.is_valid(view_mode) checks one.

docs.title: Which view needs what
docs.text: View Route Needs Report /desk/<doctype>/view/report Reads onload, refresh and add_fields from listview_settings. Image /desk/<doctype>/view/image image_field of the DocType. Map /desk/<doctype>/view/map A Geolocation field named location, or fields latitude and longitude. Calendar /desk/<doctype>/view/calendar/default frappe.views.calendar[doctype], or is_calendar_and_gantt on the DocType. A Calendar View record adds a named calendar. Gantt /desk/<doctype>/view/gantt frappe.views.calendar[doctype], or is_calendar_and_gantt on the DocType. Tree /desk/<doctype>/view/tree frappe.treeview_settings[doctype] or is_tree on the DocType. Dashboard /desk/<doctype>/view/dashboard Dashboard Charts and Number Cards of the DocType.

docs.title: query_reports
docs.text:
frappe.query_reports[report_name] configures a Query Report or Script Report. The report view loads it with frappe.desk.query_report.get_script (whitelisted). For the report files and the Python side, see Reports.

Key Type Description filters list Filter field definitions. See below. onload(report) function Runs after the filters are made and route values set, before the first run. Add page buttons here. formatter(value, row, column, data, default_formatter, filter) function Format a cell. Call default_formatter(value, row, column, data) for the standard result. get_datatable_options(options) function Change the DataTable options. Return the options. after_datatable_render(datatable) function Runs after each DataTable render. after_refresh(report) function Runs after each run of the report, also on error. get_chart_data(columns, result) function Return a chart config with data.labels and data.datasets. Replaces the chart from the server. tree bool Rows form a tree. Sent to the server as is_tree (no total row for trees). parent_field string Parent column of a tree. Sent to the server. initial_depth number Tree depth to expand on render. 0 collapses all. collapsible_filters bool Show one row of filters with a toggle for the rest. separate_check_filters bool Put Check filters in their own row. export_hidden_cols bool Offer hidden columns in the export dialog. get_pdf_format(report, bundled) function Return the print template (string or Promise) for PDF and print. bundled is the <report_name>.html template.

The view also sets these keys from the server: html_format, has_python_formatter, execution_time. If the Report has validate_filters, the server filters are merged into filters.

docs.title: Filter definitions
docs.text:
A filter is a field definition passed to page.add_field. These keys have a special meaning:

Key Description fieldname, label, fieldtype, options, default As for any field. fieldtype "Break" is skipped. reqd or mandatory The report does not run until the filter has a value. get_query() Query of a Link filter. on_change(report) Runs instead of the refresh when the value changes. Call report.refresh() yourself. depends_on eval: expression on the filter values (doc), a fieldname, or a boolean. A hidden filter is reset to its default. wildcard_filter Send the value as %value%. hidden Hide the filter. Its value is still sent. 
// sample_app/sample_module/report/sample_order_summary/sample_order_summary.js
frappe.query_reports["Sample Order Summary"] = {
    filters: [
        { fieldname: "status", label: __("Status"), fieldtype: "Select", options: "\nDraft\nOpen\nCompleted" },
        { fieldname: "from_date", label: __("From Date"), fieldtype: "Date", reqd: 1, default: frappe.datetime.month_start() },
    ],
    formatter(value, row, column, data, default_formatter) {
        value = default_formatter(value, row, column, data);
        return column.fieldname === "total" && data?.total > 1000 ? `<b>${value}</b>` : value;
    },
    onload(report) {
        report.page.add_inner_button(__("Open Orders"), () => report.set_filter_value("status", "Open"));
    },
};

docs.title: frappe.query_report
docs.text:
frappe.query_report is the frappe.views.QueryReport instance of the report page.

Member Description report_name, report_settings, report_doc Name, the query_reports object, the Report record. page The frappe.ui.Page. filters Filter controls. Each has df, get_value(), set_value(). columns, data Columns and rows of the last run. datatable The DataTable instance, or null before the first render. refresh() Run the report with the current filters. Throws "Filter missing" if a mandatory filter is empty. get_filter_values(raise) Object of filter values. Empty values are left out, unless the Report has validate_filters. With raise, missing mandatory filters show a message and throw. Also get_values. get_filter_value(fieldname, warn = true) Value of one filter. get_filter(fieldname, warn = true) Filter control. set_filter_value(fieldname, value) or set_filter_value({ fieldname: value }) Set filter values. Each change runs the filter on_change or refreshes the report. toggle_filter_display(fieldname, flag) true hides the filter. get_checked_items(only_docnames) Checked rows. Needs checkboxColumn: true in the DataTable options. get_visible_columns() Columns not hidden by the user. expand_all_rows(), collapse_all_rows() Tree reports.

docs.title: Calendar settings (frappe.views.calendar)
docs.text:
frappe.views.calendar[doctype] configures the Calendar view and, with gantt, the Gantt view.

Key Description field_map Maps start, end, id, title, allDay, convertToUserTz to fieldnames. Default { id: "name", start: "start", end: "end", allDay: "all_day", convertToUserTz: "convert_to_user_tz" }. get_events_method Whitelisted method for events. Default frappe.desk.calendar.get_events. It gets doctype, start, end, field_map, filters, fields, order_by. update_event_method Whitelisted method called on drag or resize. Default frappe.desk.calendar.update_event (gets args, field_map, saves the document). fields Fields to fetch. The field_map start, end and title and name are added. get_css_class(event) Return a color: danger, success, warning, default, a color name (red, green, ...) or a hex. Without it, a Color field of the DocType colors the event. options FullCalendar options, merged last. apply_to_custom_calendar_views Also apply fields and get_css_class to Calendar View records. gantt true shows the Gantt view. An object also overrides keys in the Gantt view. order_by Gantt sort field (ascending). Default is the user sort, else field_map.start.

The Gantt field_map adds progress (a fieldname or a function (doc) => number), color, is_milestone and depends_on. Defaults: progress, color, is_milestone, depends_on_tasks.

// sample_app/sample_module/doctype/sample_order/sample_order_calendar.js
frappe.views.calendar["Sample Order"] = {
    field_map: { start: "order_date", end: "order_date", id: "name", title: "customer_name", allDay: "all_day" },
    get_css_class: (event) => (event.status === "Completed" ? "success" : "default"),
    gantt: true,
};

docs.title: Tree view (frappe.treeview_settings)
docs.text:
frappe.treeview_settings[doctype] is merged into the options of frappe.views.TreeView. The DocType needs an is_group field or settings. window.cur_tree is the frappe.ui.Tree on screen.

Key Default Description get_tree_nodes frappe.desk.treeview.get_children Method that returns child nodes. add_tree_node frappe.desk.treeview.add_node Method that adds a node. get_tree_root true Ask get_tree_nodes for the root. false skips it. root_label Root label. Also the filter key whose value replaces the root. title "<DocType> Tree" Page title. filters Filter fields: field definitions with onchange, disable_onchange. A value is sent to the methods as an argument and becomes the root label. fields, ignore_fields Fields of the "Add Child" dialog. Default: mandatory fields of the DocType. disable_add_node Hide "Add Child" and the primary button. toolbar Node actions: { label, icon, click(node), condition(node), get_disabled_reason(node), danger, btnClass }. extend_toolbar true adds toolbar to the standard actions (same label replaces). Without it, toolbar replaces them. menu_items Page menu items: { label, action, condition }. condition is a function or a string. onload(treeview) Runs after setup. post_render(treeview) Runs after the tree renders. onrender(node), on_node_render(node, deep), on_get_node(nodes) Node hooks. click(node) Runs on node click. get_label(node) Node label. view_template Template name to render node.data beside the tree. show_expand_all true Show "Expand All". use_row_actions, row_style Passed to frappe.ui.Tree. do_not_make_page, page Render inside another page. do_not_setup_menu No standard menu items.

docs.title: Kanban settings (frappe.kanban_v2.settings)
docs.text:
Applies to Kanban boards that use Kanban v2. Keys:

Key Description card_context_menu(card, page) Return extra card menu items (frappe.ui.Dropdown items). They show before "Delete". bulk_actions(ids, page) Return extra buttons for selected cards: { label, icon, theme, variant, condition(), onclick(ids, page, done) }. callbacks Engine callbacks: canMoveCard, onBeforeCardMove (can be async, false cancels the drag), onCardMove, onAfterCardMove, onCardClick(card, ev), onCardOpen(card), onSelectionChange(ids), onMoveError(move), onAddCard(columnId). select_styles { value: theme } or { value: { theme, icon } } for Select values on cards. open_on_title_click false stops the card title opening the document. renderCard(card, el, ctx, page), renderColumnHeader, renderEmptyState Custom renderers. options Extra engine options. boards { board_name: settings } overrides for one board.

frappe.kanban_v2.extend_settings(doctype, patch) changes the settings without losing the base. patch is an object (menu and bulk items append, maps merge) or a function (base) => settings.

docs.title: Dashboard chart sources and number cards
docs.text:
A Dashboard Chart with chart_type = Custom uses a Dashboard Chart Source. Its config file is <module>/dashboard_chart_source/<source>/<source>.js, served by frappe.desk.doctype.dashboard_chart_source.dashboard_chart_source.get_config.

Key of frappe.dashboards.chart_sources[source] Description method Whitelisted method that returns the chart data. It gets chart_name, filters, refresh, time_interval, timespan, from_date, to_date, heatmap_year. filters Filter field definitions for the chart filter dialog. 
// sample_app/sample_module/dashboard_chart_source/sample_orders_by_status/sample_orders_by_status.js
frappe.provide("frappe.dashboards.chart_sources");
frappe.dashboards.chart_sources["Sample Orders by Status"] = {
    method: "sample_app.sample_module.dashboard_chart_source.sample_orders_by_status.sample_orders_by_status.get",
    filters: [{ fieldname: "status", label: __("Status"), fieldtype: "Select", options: "\nDraft\nOpen\nCompleted" }],
};

# sample_app/sample_module/dashboard_chart_source/sample_orders_by_status/sample_orders_by_status.py
import frappe
from frappe.utils.dashboard import cache_source


@frappe.whitelist()
@cache_source
def get(chart_name=None, chart=None, no_cache=None, filters=None, from_date=None, to_date=None,
        timespan=None, time_interval=None, heatmap_year=None):
    rows = frappe.get_list("Sample Order", fields=["status", {"COUNT": "*", "as": "count"}], group_by="status")
    return {
        "labels": [r.status for r in rows],
        "datasets": [{"name": "Orders", "values": [r.count for r in rows]}],
        "type": "bar",
    }

cache_source caches the result in chart-data:<chart name> until a refresh.

A Number Card with type = Custom calls its method field (a whitelisted dotted path) with filters. The method returns a number, or { value, fieldtype, route_options, route }.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• listview_settings from a file applies only to DocTypes in an app. For a custom DocType, use a Client Script with view = List.
  • A field that get_indicator, button or formatters reads is undefined unless it is a column or in add_fields.
  • dropdown_button.get_label and each button get_label are strings. A function shows as its source text.
  • filters in frappe.views.calendar is not read. Neither is style_map.
  • get_coords_method only adds "Map" to the view switcher. The Map view needs location or latitude and longitude fields.
  • set_filter_value with an object can refresh the report once per changed filter.
  • frappe.query_report.get_checked_items() throws before the first render, because datatable is null.
  • Query report charts from get_chart_data need data.labels. Without labels no chart is drawn.
