docs.title: JavaScript Model and DB API
docs.text:
This page lists the client-side API for documents in desk JavaScript. frappe.model works on documents that the browser has loaded into locals. frappe.db sends requests to the server and returns promises. Use frappe.model in form scripts to change the open document. Use frappe.db to read or write other records. For how-to guides, see Client API and Form Scripts.

The names on this page come from Object.keys() on each namespace in a logged-in desk at /desk on develop. Every example was run in that desk.

docs.title: locals
docs.text:
locals is a global object. It holds every document that the browser loaded, by DocType and name: locals[doctype][name].

Key Content locals[doctype][name] A document as a plain object. Child rows are also stored here, under their child DocType. locals.DocType[doctype] The meta of a loaded DocType. frappe.get_meta(doctype) reads it. locals[":" + doctype] Partial documents sent in boot, for example locals[":Print Format"].

Keys of a local document that start with __ are client-only flags:

Key Meaning __islocal 1 if the document is not saved on the server yet. Its name starts with new-. __unsaved 1 if the document has changes that are not saved. __unedited true on a new grid row that the user has not changed. __last_sync_on Date of the last frappe.model.sync for this document. __run_link_triggers Set on a new document. The form runs Link field triggers for default values once. __newname The name that the user typed for a DocType with autoname = prompt. __needs_refresh Set when another user changed the document. The form reloads or shows a message. __checked 1 if the row is selected in a grid.

Note

locals holds only documents that the browser loaded. Call frappe.model.with_doc or frappe.db.get_doc before you read a record with frappe.get_doc.

docs.title: frappe.model: load documents and meta
docs.text:
Function Description with_doctype(doctype, callback, async) Load the meta of doctype and of its child DocTypes into locals.DocType, then call callback(r). Returns a promise. If the meta is loaded, it calls callback() and returns a resolved promise. Calls frappe.desk.form.load.getdoctype (GET). Also loads list, calendar, tree and Kanban scripts and the user settings of the DocType. with_doc(doctype, name, callback, error_callback) Load a document, its child rows and its docinfo into locals. Returns a promise that resolves with the document. Calls frappe.desk.form.load.getdoc (GET), which checks read permission. Uses the local copy if the document and its docinfo are already loaded and you pass no error_callback. With no name, loads the Single DocType doctype. callback(name, r). error_callback(r, permission_denied). On PermissionError, removes the document from locals. sync(r) Put documents from a server response into locals and docinfo into frappe.model.docinfo. r is a document, a list of documents, or {docs, docinfo}. Updates a document that is already loaded in place. Renames a local document when the response has localname. Returns the list of documents. get_docinfo(doctype, name) Return the docinfo of a loaded document, or null. Keys include attachments, comments, communications, versions, assignments, shared, permissions, tags, views and is_document_followed. set_docinfo(doctype, name, key, value) Set one key of a loaded docinfo. Does nothing if the docinfo is not loaded. get_shared(doctype, name) Return docinfo.shared of a loaded document. Throws if the docinfo is not loaded. is_fresh(doc) Return true if the document was synced less than 5 seconds ago. 
const doc = await frappe.model.with_doc("Sample Item", "Keyboard");
doc.rate; // 45
frappe.get_doc("Sample Item", "Keyboard") === doc; // true

docs.title: frappe.model: read local documents
docs.text:
These functions read locals only. They do not send a request, except get_value with a callback.

Function Description get_doc(doctype, name) Return locals[doctype][name], or null. With no name, name is doctype (Single DocType). If name is an object, return the first local document that matches these filters. Also frappe.get_doc. get_list(doctype, filters) Return the local documents of doctype that match filters. Reads locals[":" + doctype] if locals[doctype] does not exist. Returns [] if nothing is loaded. Also frappe.get_list. get_children(doc, parentfield, filters) or get_children(doctype, parent, parentfield, filters) Return the rows of a child table of a local document, filtered by filters if given. Also frappe.get_children. get_value(doctype, filters, fieldname, callback) Without callback: return fieldname of the local document with name filters, or of the first local match of filters, or null. With callback: call frappe.client.get_value and pass r.message to callback. Returns undefined in that case, not a promise. has_value(doctype, name, fieldname) Return true if the field has a value. For a Table field, return true if the table has rows. get_doc_title(doc) Return "New <DocType>" for an unsaved document. Else return the value of the title field, or the name. Needs the meta of the DocType. get_title_from_title_field(doc, meta) Return the title field value. For a Link title field, return the cached link title. get_all_docs(doc) Return [doc, ...all child rows]. get_no_copy_list(doctype) Return the fieldnames that copy_doc skips: name, amended_from, amendment_date, cancel_reason and fields with no_copy. 
frappe.model.get_value("Sample Item", "Keyboard", "rate");             // 45
frappe.model.get_value("Sample Item", { category: "Hardware" }, "name"); // "Keyboard"
frappe.model.get_list("Sample Item", { category: "Hardware" });          // only rows in locals

docs.title: frappe.model: create and change local documents
docs.text:
These functions change locals only. Save the document to write it to the database.

Function Description get_new_doc(doctype, parent_doc, parentfield, with_mandatory_children) Make a new local document with default values and add it to locals. Sets docstatus: 0, __islocal: 1, __unsaved: 1, owner and a new-<doctype>-<random> name. With parent_doc, adds it as a row of parent_doc[parentfield]. With with_mandatory_children, adds one empty row to each mandatory Table field. Applies frappe.route_options as values (only fields that exist and are not no_copy), then clears frappe.route_options. Returns the document. make_new_doc_and_get_name(doctype, with_mandatory_children) Same as get_new_doc for a parent document. Returns the name. get_new_name(doctype) Return a new local name, for example new-sample-order-zglqhgctzg. add_child(parent_doc, doctype, parentfield, idx) or add_child(parent_doc, parentfield) Add a new row to a child table and return it. With two arguments, the child DocType comes from the Table field. With idx, inserts before that position and renumbers. Marks cur_frm dirty if it shows parent_doc. Does not render the grid and does not run <table>_add. clear_table(doc, parentfield) Remove all rows of a child table from the document and from locals. Does not render. copy_doc(doc, from_amend, parent_doc, parentfield) Return a new local copy of a document and its child rows. Skips name, amended_from, amendment_date, cancel_reason, keys that start with __, and Password fields. Skips no_copy fields unless from_amend is set. Clears creation, modified, lft and rgt, and sets owner and modified_by to the current user. set_value(doctype, docname, fieldname, value, fieldtype, skip_dirty_trigger = false) Set a value on a local document and run the change handlers. fieldname can be an object {fieldname: value}. Returns a promise. Does nothing for a key whose value is the same, except for a Link or Dynamic Link when you pass that fieldtype. With skip_dirty_trigger, the form is not marked dirty. set_default_values(doc, parent_doc) Set default values on fields that are empty. Returns the list of fieldnames it set. get_default_value(df, doc, parent_doc) Return the default of one field. Checks user permissions, user defaults, the last selected value and df.default (__user, user_fullname, Today, now, :DocType). create_mandatory_children(doc) Add one empty row to each mandatory Table field. round_floats_in(doc, fieldnames) Round fields to their precision. Without fieldnames, rounds all Currency and Float fields. Needs the meta. validate_missing(doc, fieldname) Call frappe.throw if the field is empty. 
await frappe.model.with_doctype("Sample Order");
const order = frappe.model.get_new_doc("Sample Order");
const row = frappe.model.add_child(order, "items");
row.doctype;     // "Sample Order Item"
row.parentfield; // "items"
await frappe.model.set_value(row.doctype, row.name, "qty", 2);

Warning

Inside a form, frappe.model.set_value runs the form field events of the document. For a child row, it runs the event on the child DocType. It does not fetch fetch_from values of a Link field in a row. The server fetches them when the document is saved.

docs.title: frappe.model: change handlers
docs.text:
Function Description on(doctype, fieldname, fn) Run fn(fieldname, value, doc, skip_dirty_trigger) after set_value changes fieldname on a document of doctype. Use "*" for all fields. The form uses this to run form events. trigger(fieldname, value, doc, skip_dirty_trigger = false) Run the handlers of fieldname and "*" for doc.doctype, one after the other. Returns a promise. events The registered handlers, by DocType and fieldname.

Prefer frappe.ui.form.on in form scripts. See Form API.

docs.title: frappe.model: server actions
frappe.model: DocType checks and permissions
docs.text:
The can_* functions read the lists in frappe.boot.user. They check the DocType, not one document. For one document, use frm.has_perm(ptype) or frappe.perm.has_perm.

Function Description can_create(doctype), can_read(doctype), can_write(doctype), can_delete(doctype), can_submit(doctype), can_cancel(doctype), can_select(doctype), can_get_report(doctype) Return true if the user has this right on the DocType. can_import(doctype, frm, meta = null) false if meta is given and does not allow import. true for System Manager. With frm, reads frm.perm[0].import. can_export(doctype, frm) true for System Manager. With frm, reads frm.perm[0].export. can_print(doctype, frm), can_email(doctype, frm) With frm, read frm.perm[0]. Else read frappe.boot.user. can_share(doctype, frm) false if document sharing is disabled and the user is not Administrator. With frm, reads frm.perm[0].share. can_print_docstatus(doctype, docstatus) Return true if a document in this docstatus can print, as set in Print Settings. can_print_doc(frm) Return true if the form document can print: docstatus, print permission and not a Single. is_submittable(doctype), is_table(doctype), is_tree(doctype) Return the flag from the loaded meta. Return undefined if the meta is not loaded. is_single(doctype) Return true if the DocType is in frappe.boot.single_types. has_workflow(doctype) Return the number of active Workflow records in locals for the DocType.

Warning

frappe.model.can_share(doctype) without frm throws a TypeError on develop, because frappe.boot.user has no can_share list. Pass frm, or use frappe.perm.has_perm(doctype, 0, "share").

docs.title: frappe.model: fieldtype helpers and constants
docs.text: Name Description scrub(txt) Replace spaces with _ and make lowercase: "Sample Order" gives "sample_order". unscrub(txt) Replace _ and - with spaces and capitalize words. is_value_type(fieldtype) false for fieldtypes that store no value, such as Table, Section Break and HTML. Accepts a DocField. is_numeric_field(fieldtype) true for Int, Float, Currency, Percent and Duration. Accepts a DocField. is_non_std_field(fieldname) false for standard fields such as name, owner, docstatus, parent. get_std_field(fieldname, ignore = false) Return the DocField of a standard field. Shows a message for an unknown column unless ignore is set. get_full_column_name(fieldname, doctype) Return `tab<doctype>`.`<fieldname>`. get_server_module_name(doctype) Return the Python module of the DocType controller, for example frappe.desk.doctype.todo.todo. Needs the meta. all_fieldtypes, no_value_type, layout_fields, table_fields, numeric_fieldtypes, html_fieldtypes, plain_text_fieldtypes Lists of fieldtypes. std_fields, std_fields_list, std_fields_table, child_table_field_list, restricted_fields, core_doctypes_list Lists of standard fields and core DocTypes. docinfo, new_names, user_settings Loaded docinfo by DocType and name, map of local names to saved names, and loaded user settings. DocTypeController Form controller class of the DocType form.

docs.title: frappe.model: internal functions
docs.text:
Desk calls these. Apps rarely need them: init, init_doctype, add_to_locals, update_in_locals, remove_from_locals, clear_doc, delete_from_locals, rename_doc_in_locals, rename_after_save, sync_docinfo, sync_print_format_for_meta, get_default_from_boot_docs, set_default_views_for_doctype.

remove_from_locals(doctype, name) and clear_doc(doctype, name) remove a document from locals. clear_doc also removes a child row from its parent and renumbers idx.

docs.title: frappe.model.user_settings
docs.text:
User settings store list, report and grid settings per user and DocType on the server. frappe.model.user_settings[doctype] holds the loaded settings.

Function Description get(doctype) Call frappe.model.utils.user_settings.get. Returns a promise of the settings object. save(doctype, key, value) Set key. If value is a plain object, merge it into the existing value. Saves only if something changed. Returns a promise. Does nothing for Guest. remove(doctype, key) Delete key and save. update(doctype, user_settings) Save the whole settings object with frappe.model.utils.user_settings.save, then store the response in frappe.model.user_settings[doctype]. frappe.get_user_settings(doctype, key) Return the loaded settings, or one key of them. Returns {} if not loaded. No request. 
await frappe.model.user_settings.save("Sample Item", "sample_app", { compact: 1 });
frappe.get_user_settings("Sample Item", "sample_app").compact; // 1
await frappe.model.user_settings.remove("Sample Item", "sample_app");

docs.title: frappe.db
docs.text:
Each function calls a whitelisted method on the server. The server checks the permissions of the current user. Each function returns a promise.

Function Server method Resolves with get_list(doctype, args) frappe.desk.reportview.get_list (GET) List of row objects. get_value(doctype, filters, fieldname, callback, parent_doc) frappe.client.get_value (GET) The response r. The values are in r.message. callback(r.message) if given. get_single_value(doctype, field) frappe.client.get_single_value (GET) The value. get_doc(doctype, name, filters) frappe.client.get (GET) The document. Also adds it to locals. Rejects on error. exists(doctype, name_or_filters) get_value or count true or false. count(doctype, {filters, limit} = {}, cache = false) frappe.desk.reportview.get_count A number. insert(doc) frappe.client.insert (POST) The inserted document. set_value(doctype, docname, fieldname, value, callback) frappe.client.set_value (POST) The response r. The saved document is in r.message. delete_doc(doctype, name) frappe.client.delete (POST) r.message. Removes the document from locals. get_link_options(doctype, txt = "", filters = {}, page_length = 0, include_image = false) frappe.desk.search.search_link (GET) List of {value, label, description}.

docs.title: get_list
docs.text:
args keys:

Key Default Description fields ["name"] Fields to read. filters none Object, or list of [doctype, field, operator, value] or [field, operator, value]. or_filters none Filters joined with OR. order_by server default For example "rate asc". group_by none Group by a field. Write aggregates in fields in the dict form, for example {COUNT: "*", as: "n"}. limit 20 Maximum rows. Pass 0 for no limit. start or limit_start 0 Offset.

The server passes the arguments to DatabaseQuery.execute, which applies permissions.

await frappe.db.get_list("Sample Item", {
    fields: ["name", "rate"],
    filters: { category: "Hardware" },
    order_by: "rate asc",
    limit: 2,
});
// [{ name: "Keyboard", rate: 45 }, { name: "Monitor", rate: 250 }]

Warning

frappe.db.get_list does not reject when the server returns an error. The promise stays pending. The error dialog shows, but code after await does not run. Use frappe.xcall("frappe.client.get_list", {...}) if you must handle the error.

docs.title: get_value and exists
docs.text:
filters is a name or a filters object. fieldname is a fieldname or a list. For a child DocType, pass the parent DocType as parent_doc.

const r = await frappe.db.get_value("Sample Item", "Keyboard", ["rate", "category"]);
r.message; // { rate: 45, category: "Hardware" }

(await frappe.db.get_value("Sample Item", "No Such Item", "rate")).message; // {}

await frappe.db.exists("Sample Item", "Keyboard");             // true
await frappe.db.exists("Sample Item", { category: "Service" }); // true

exists with a string calls get_value for name. With an object it calls count with limit: 1.

docs.title: count
docs.text:
count sends a POST request. With cache = true it sends a GET request that the browser can cache. If a filter is on a child DocType, the count is distinct. If you pass limit, the server stops counting at that number.

await frappe.db.count("Sample Item", { filters: { category: "Hardware" } }); // 3
await frappe.db.count("Sample Order", { filters: [["Sample Order Item", "item", "=", "Keyboard"]] });

docs.title: insert, set_value, delete_doc
docs.text:
insert(doc) needs doc.doctype. It runs the full insert on the server, with validations and controller methods.

set_value loads the document on the server, updates it and calls doc.save(). Validations, controller methods and permission checks run. fieldname can be an object of values, then leave out value. Standard fields such as name, owner and docstatus are ignored. For a child DocType, the server saves the parent document.

const doc = await frappe.db.insert({ doctype: "Sample Item", item_name: "Sample Probe", category: "Hardware", rate: 10 });
const r = await frappe.db.set_value("Sample Item", doc.name, { rate: 15, disabled: 1 });
r.message.rate; // 15
await frappe.db.delete_doc("Sample Item", doc.name);

docs.title: frappe.perm
docs.text:
frappe.perm evaluates permissions in the browser from the meta, frappe.boot and docinfo. The server checks again on every request.

Function Description has_perm(doctype, permlevel = 0, ptype = "read", doc) Return true if the user has ptype at permlevel. With a saved doc, applies owner rules, shares and the permissions in docinfo. get_perm(doctype, doc) Return a list of permission objects, one per permlevel, for example perm[0].write. Without doc, the result is cached per DocType once the meta is loaded. get_rights(doctype) Return the standard rights plus the custom permission types of the DocType. get_role_permissions(meta) Return the rights from the DocPerm rows of the roles of the user. get_match_rules(doctype, ptype) Return the user permission and owner rules that limit the records the user sees. get_field_display_status(df, doc, perm, explain) Return "Write", "Read" or "None" for a field. Applies permlevel, hidden, docstatus, allow_on_submit, workflow, read_only and set_only_once. With explain, logs each step. is_visible(df, doc, perm) Return true unless the display status is "None". df can be a fieldname. get_allowed_docs_for_doctype(user_permissions, doctype) Return the names allowed by user permissions for doctype. filter_allowed_docs_for_doctype(user_permissions, doctype, with_default_doc = true) Return {allowed_records, default_doc}, or only the list if with_default_doc is false. rights, doctype_perm Standard right names and the cache of get_perm.

The globals READ, WRITE, CREATE, DELETE, SUBMIT, CANCEL and AMEND hold the lowercase right names, for old code.

docs.title: frappe.workflow
docs.text:
frappe.workflow reads the Workflow records that desk loaded into locals with the meta.

Function Description get_state_fieldname(doctype) Return the workflow state field, or null if the DocType has no workflow. get_workflow(doc) Return the workflow that applies to the document. With many workflows, the first by priority whose conditions match. has_workflow(doc) Return true if a workflow applies to the document. applies_to(workflow, doc) Return true if all conditions of the workflow match. get_state(doc) Return the state of the document, or the default state for its docstatus. get_default_state(doc, docstatus) Return the first state with this docstatus. doc can be a DocType name. get_transitions(doc) Call frappe.model.workflow.get_transitions. Returns a promise of the transitions the user can run. get_document_state_roles(doc, state) Return the roles that can edit in this state. is_read_only(doctype, name) Return true if the workflow state does not let the user edit the document. is_self_approval_enabled(doc) Return allow_self_approval of the workflow. get_update_fields(doctype) Return the fields that workflow states set. get_all_transitions(doctype), get_all_transition_actions(doctype) Return the transitions or their action names of all workflows of the DocType. setup(doctype) Read the workflows of the DocType from locals into the caches workflows, candidates, state_fields and avoid_status_override.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• frappe.model.set_value(doc, fieldname, value) with a document object and three arguments sets the field to the fieldname string on develop. Pass the DocType and name, or an object: frappe.model.set_value(doc, { customer_name: "Customer A" }).
  • frappe.db.get_value and frappe.db.set_value resolve with the response. Read r.message.
  • frappe.model.get_value with a callback returns undefined, not a promise. Use frappe.db.get_value with await.
  • frappe.model.get_list and frappe.get_list read locals only. They are not the same as the server frappe.get_list. Use frappe.db.get_list.
  • frappe.model.get_doc_title, round_floats_in, is_submittable and get_server_module_name need the meta. Call frappe.model.with_doctype first.
  • frappe.model.add_child and clear_table do not render. In a form, call frm.refresh_field(table_fieldname).

docs.title: UI Components (JavaScript)
docs.text:
This page lists the desk UI classes and helpers in frappe.ui that an app can use: dialogs, field groups, pages, uploaders, charts and the Espresso components (buttons, menus, toasts and more). Use it to look up options, defaults and method signatures. For how to build a page or a dialog, see Desk Pages and Client API. For field definitions and control methods, see Controls.

All names on this page exist in a logged-in desk at /desk. Names from a lazy bundle say which bundle to load with frappe.require.

docs.title: frappe.ui.Dialog
docs.text:
new frappe.ui.Dialog(opts) makes a Bootstrap modal with fields. Dialog extends frappe.ui.FieldGroup, which extends frappe.ui.form.Layout. The constructor builds the modal at once (auto_make), but does not show it.

const d = new frappe.ui.Dialog({
    title: __("New Sample Item"),
    fields: [
        { fieldname: "item_name", fieldtype: "Data", label: __("Item Name"), reqd: 1 },
        { fieldname: "rate", fieldtype: "Currency", label: __("Rate"), default: 10 },
    ],
    primary_action_label: __("Create"),
    primary_action(values) {
        // values: { item_name: "Pen", rate: 10 }
        return frappe.db.insert({ doctype: "Sample Item", ...values }).then(() => d.hide());
    },
});
d.show();

docs.title: Options
docs.text: Option Type Default Description title string Title. Set as HTML. fields list Field definitions. See Controls. size string computed "small", "large" or "extra-large". If not set: 4 or more Column Breaks in one section give "extra-large", 2 or 3 give "large", else normal. primary_action(values) function Runs on click of the primary button, and on Enter in a text input. Gets get_values(). Does not run if a mandatory field is empty. If it returns a Promise, the button shows a busy state until it settles. primary_action_label string "Submit" Label of the primary button. primary_action_loading_label string Label while the primary button is busy. secondary_action function Click handler of the secondary button. secondary_action_label string Label of the secondary button. minimizable bool Show a minimize button. A click on the title restores the dialog. static bool No close on backdrop click or Esc. Hides the close button. centered bool false Center the dialog on the screen. animate bool true Fade in. auto_make bool true Build the modal in the constructor. keep_grid_form_open bool false Do not close an open grid row form when the dialog closes. sheet_on_mobile bool false On a phone, show as a frappe.ui.BottomSheet. Ignored for static and minimizable dialogs. indicator string Indicator color class in the header, for example "green". on_hide, onhide function Runs when the dialog closes. on_page_show function Runs after the dialog is shown. on_minimize_toggle(is_minimized) function Runs after minimize or restore. no_submit_on_enter bool Enter does not run the primary action. no_focus bool Do not focus the first input on show. doc object Document to bind. If it is saved, field defaults are not applied.

docs.title: Methods
docs.text:
Method Returns Description show() the dialog Open the dialog. Sets window.cur_dialog and adds the dialog to frappe.ui.open_dialogs. hide() Close the dialog. cancel() Click the close button. no_cancel() Hide the close button. set_title(t) Set the title as HTML. set_primary_action(label, click) jQuery button Set or replace the primary button. click(values) works as primary_action. set_secondary_action(click) jQuery button Set the click handler of the secondary button and show it. set_secondary_action_label(label) Set the label of the secondary button and show it. disable_primary_action(), enable_primary_action() Disable or enable the primary button. get_primary_btn(), get_secondary_btn(), get_close_btn(), get_minimize_btn() jQuery Footer and header buttons. add_custom_action(label, action, css_class = null) Add a button to the footer. set_message(text) Hide the fields and show text (plain text). clear_message() Show the fields again. set_alert(text, alert_class = "info") Put an alert (HTML) above the fields. alert_class is a Bootstrap alert class suffix. clear_alert() Remove the alert. clear() Set every field to its default or empty, and clear the message. toggle_minimize() Minimize or restore.

The dialog also has every FieldGroup method. See frappe.ui.FieldGroup.

Properties: $wrapper (the .modal), body and $body (field area), header, footer, fields_dict, display (true while shown), is_visible, is_minimized.

Globals:

Name Description window.cur_dialog The dialog on top, or null. frappe.ui.open_dialogs List of open dialogs, the top one last. frappe.ui.hide_open_dialog() Close cur_dialog. A minimizable dialog is minimized instead.

docs.title: frappe.ui.FieldGroup
docs.text:
new frappe.ui.FieldGroup({ fields, body }) renders fields in any element. Call make() after the constructor. Controls describes the options, get_values() rules and default keywords.

Method Returns Description make() Render the fields and apply defaults. get_values(ignore_errors, check_invalid) object or null Values of non-empty fields. null and a message if a mandatory field is empty. get_value(fieldname) any Value of one field. set_value(fieldname, value) Promise Set one value, then evaluate depends_on. set_values(dict) Promise Set many values. Unknown keys are skipped. set_input(fieldname, value) Promise Same as set_value. get_field(fieldname) control The control object. has_field(fieldname) bool get_input(fieldname) jQuery The input element. set_df_property(fieldname, prop, value) Change a field property and refresh the field. set_query(fieldname, query), set_query(fieldname, table_fieldname, query) Set get_query of a Link field, or of a Link field in a Table field. add_fetch(link_field, source_field, target_field, target_doctype) Copy source_field of the linked record into target_field. clear() Set every field to its default or empty. refresh_dependency() Evaluate depends_on, mandatory_depends_on and read_only_depends_on again. add_fields(fields) Render more fields at the end. replace_field(fieldname, df, render) Replace a field with a new definition. select_tab(label_or_fieldname) Activate a Tab Break. show_message(html, color, permanent = false) jQuery Show a message block above the fields. color is yellow, blue, red, green, orange or white. Empty html clears it.

Properties: fields_dict, fields_list, wrapper, dirty (true after the user changes a value).

docs.title: frappe.ui.form.MultiSelectDialog
docs.text:
new frappe.ui.form.MultiSelectDialog(opts) opens a dialog to search and check many records of a DocType. The constructor loads the DocType meta, builds the dialog and shows it. Search uses frappe.desk.search.search_widget, so the user needs read access.

new frappe.ui.form.MultiSelectDialog({
    doctype: "Sample Item",
    setters: { category: "Hardware" },
    data_fields: [{ fieldname: "qty", fieldtype: "Int", label: __("Qty"), default: 1 }],
    get_query() {
        return { filters: { disabled: 0 } };
    },
    action(selections, args) {
        // selections: ["Monitor"], args: { category: "Hardware", qty: 1, filtered_children: [] }
        cur_dialog.hide();
    },
});
Option Type Description doctype string DocType to search. setters object or list Filter fields above the results. An object maps fieldname to default value and copies the field definition from the meta. A list holds full field definitions. A Data setter in object form filters with like. read_only_setters list Fieldnames of object setters to show read-only. action(selections, args) function Primary action. selections is the list of checked names. args holds the setter values, data_fields values, filter group values and filtered_children. The dialog stays open. Call cur_dialog.hide() to close it. get_query() function Returns { filters, query }. filters is added to the search. query is a dotted path of a custom search method. columns list Result columns. Used only when get_query() returns a query. Otherwise the columns are name and the setters. data_fields list Extra fields below the results. Their values go to args. add_filters_group bool Show a filter group for more conditions. primary_action_label string Default "Get Items". size string Dialog size. allow_child_item_selection bool Show a check box to pick child table rows instead of parents. Needs child_fieldname and child_columns. child_fieldname string Table field of doctype that holds the child rows. child_columns list Child fieldnames to show and search.

The secondary button "Make " sets frappe.route_options from the setters and opens a new form. Method Returns Description get_checked_values() list Names of checked rows. get_checked_items() list Checked result rows with all columns. get_results() Promise Run the search again.

Properties: dialog (the frappe.ui.Dialog), results, page_length (20, grows by 20 with "More").

docs.title: frappe.ui.Page
docs.text:
frappe.ui.make_app_page(opts) makes a frappe.ui.Page in opts.parent, stores it as opts.parent.page and returns it. Forms, lists and reports use the same class, so frm.page, listview.page and frappe.query_report.page have these methods. See Desk Pages for a full page script.

const page = frappe.ui.make_app_page({ parent: wrapper, title: __("Sample Board"), single_column: true });
page.set_primary_action(__("New Order"), () => frappe.new_doc("Sample Order"), "plus");
const status = page.add_field({
    fieldname: "status",
    label: __("Status"),
    fieldtype: "Select",
    options: ["", "Open", "Closed"],
    change: () => load(page),
});
page.get_form_values(); // { status: "" }

docs.title: Options
docs.text: Option Type Default Description parent element required Wrapper element. title string Page title. HTML is stripped. Also sets the browser tab title. single_column bool No side section. sidebar_position string left "Right" puts the side section on the right. icon string Icon name shown before the title. make_page function Runs at the end of setup, with the page as this. hide_sidebar bool false Hide the desk sidebar on desktop. Closes the drawer on a small screen. hide_dock bool false Hide the dock. hide_mobile_nav bool false Hide the phone tab bar. required_libs list Assets that load_lib(callback) loads with frappe.require. show_breadcrumbs bool false draws no breadcrumb trail.

docs.title: Parts
docs.text: Property Description body, main Main content area (jQuery). sidebar Side section (jQuery). Empty with single_column. footer Footer below the main area. Hidden by default. page_form Row of filter fields made by add_field. fields_dict Controls made by add_field, by fieldname (or label). btn_primary, btn_secondary Header buttons. menu, actions Item stores of the "..." menu and the Actions menu. inner_toolbar Area of inner buttons. Same element as custom_actions. indicator Status pill next to the title. views, current_view Views made by add_view.

docs.title: Title and indicator
docs.text: Method Description set_title(title, icon = null, strip = true, tab_title = "", tooltip_label = "") Set the title (last breadcrumb) and the browser tab title. strip removes HTML. set_title_sub(txt) Set the subtitle. Empty txt hides it. get_title_area() jQuery of the title area. set_breadcrumbs(items) Set the trail. items take frappe.ui.breadcrumbs item keys. get_breadcrumbs() Current trail. set_indicator(label, color) Show the status pill. color is a theme name such as green, red, orange, blue, gray. clear_indicator() Hide the status pill.

docs.title: Header buttons
docs.text:
A click function that returns a Promise (or jQuery deferred) puts its button in a busy state until it settles.

Method Returns Description set_primary_action(label, click, icon, working_label) jQuery Set the primary button. label can be { label, short_label, options }. short_label shows on small screens. options adds a chevron menu with frappe.ui.Dropdown items. working_label shows while busy. set_primary_action_options(options) Set or remove the chevron menu next to the primary button. set_secondary_action(label, click, icon, working_label) jQuery Set the secondary button. clear_primary_action(), clear_secondary_action(), clear_actions() Hide the buttons. add_action_icon(icon, click, css_class = "", tooltip_label) jQuery Icon button in the header icon group. show_icon_group(), hide_icon_group(), clear_icons() Icon group visibility.

docs.title: Menus
docs.text:
Method Returns Description add_menu_item(label, click, standard, shortcut, show_parent, group) jQuery <a> Item in the "..." menu. standard items go after a divider. shortcut is a key string such as "ctrl+p" or a frappe.ui.keys.add_shortcut object, and is bound. group is a heading. A label that exists is not added again. add_custom_menu_item(parent, label, click, standard, shortcut, icon = null) jQuery <a> Item in the store parent, for example one from add_custom_button_group. add_divider() jQuery Divider in the "..." menu. clear_menu(), show_menu(), hide_menu() "..." menu. add_action_item(label, click, standard, icon = null) jQuery <a> Item in the Actions menu. Shows the menu. add_actions_menu_item(label, click, standard, shortcut, icon = null, theme = null) jQuery <a> Item in the Actions menu. Does not show the menu. theme "red" marks a risky item. show_actions_menu(), hide_actions_menu(), clear_actions_menu() Actions menu. add_dropdown_item({ label, click, standard, parent, shortcut, show_parent = true, icon, icon_right, theme, group }) jQuery <a> Generic form of the methods above. clear_user_actions() Remove the non-standard items of the "..." menu.

The menus render with frappe.ui.Dropdown each time they open. Changes to a returned <a> (.text(), .toggle(), .addClass("disabled")) show at the next open.

docs.title: Inner toolbar

docs.text:
Method Returns Description add_field(df, parent) control Control in the page form (or in parent). Applies df.default. Stored in fields_dict. An HTML field returns nothing. Use df.change for a change handler. get_form_values() object Values of all add_field controls. docs.title: frappe.ui.FileUploader
docs.text:
new frappe.ui.FileUploader(opts) opens the upload dialog. With wrapper, it renders inside that element without a dialog. Files go to /api/method/upload_file (whitelisted, POST), in chunks for files larger than frappe.boot.file_chunk_size (default 25 MB). Each upload makes a File record.

new frappe.ui.FileUploader({
    doctype: "Sample Order",
    docname: frm.doc.name,
    folder: "Home/Attachments",
    restrictions: { allowed_file_types: [".pdf", "image/*"] },
    on_success(file_doc) {
        // file_doc: { doctype: "File", name: "405e5841b5", file_url: "/private/files/a.pdf", is_private: 1, ... }
        frm.reload_doc();
    },
});
Option Default Description doctype, docname Attach the file to this document. fieldname, field_doctype Attach field to set. folder "Home" File folder. method Dotted path of a whitelisted method that upload_file calls with the file instead of saving it. on_success(file_doc, response) Runs once per uploaded file. With as_dataurl, gets the file object with dataurl. allow_multiple true Allow more than one file. as_dataurl false Do not upload. Return base64 data URLs to on_success. restrictions {} max_file_size (bytes, default from frappe.core.api.file.get_max_file_size), max_number_of_files (default max_attachments of the DocType), allowed_file_types (MIME types or extensions, default from System Settings allowed_file_extensions), crop_image_aspect_ratio. make_attachments_public Make new files public. Files are private by default. Ignored when the DocType has force_private_attachments. allow_toggle_private true Show the private and public toggle. Off if the user cannot upload public files. allow_toggle_optimize true Show the image optimize toggle. Images larger than 200 KB are optimized by default. allow_web_link true Show "Link". allow_take_photo true Show "Camera" when the browser has a camera API. allow_google_drive true Show Google Drive when Google Settings has it on. disable_file_browser false Hide "Library". upload_notes Help text under the drop area. attach_doc_image false Resize the image to 200 x 200 on the server. files File objects to add at once. dialog_title "Upload" Dialog title. wrapper Render here instead of in a dialog. keep_grid_form_open false Passed to the dialog. frm Form. Its attachment limit is checked first. Member Description upload_files() Upload the selected files. Returns a Promise. dialog The frappe.ui.Dialog, if any. uploader The mounted Vue component. frappe.ui.FileUploader.UploadOptions Static list of extra upload sources: { label, icon, action({ dialog, uploader, doctype, docname, fieldname }) }. icon is SVG markup or a component.

docs.title: frappe.ui.Capture
docs.text:
new frappe.ui.Capture(options) takes photos with the camera. On a phone it opens the file input with capture. On desktop, or when the user default force_web_capture_mode_for_uploads is on, it shows a video stream.

Option Default Description title "Camera" Dialog title. animate false Fade the dialog. error false Show an alert when the camera fails to load. Method Description show() Open the camera. submit(fn) Set the callback. fn(images) gets a list of data URLs on "Submit". hide() Close the dialog and stop the stream. set_options(options) Merge options. Returns the instance. 
const capture = new frappe.ui.Capture({ title: __("Photo") });
capture.submit((images) => console.log(images.length));
capture.show();

docs.title: frappe.ui.Scanner
docs.text:
new frappe.ui.Scanner(options) scans barcodes and QR codes with the camera. It loads html5-qrcode on demand and needs HTTPS.

Option Description dialog true opens a "Scan QRCode" dialog and starts scanning. container Element to scan in, without a dialog. Call scan() then. on_scan(result) Runs on a scan. result.decodedText is the text. multiple Default false. false stops after the first scan and closes the dialog. allow_keep_open Show a "keep open" toggle. Default is true with dialog. minimizable, primary_action_label, primary_action Passed to the dialog.

Methods: scan(), stop_scan().

docs.title: frappe.ui.Tags and frappe.ui.TagEditor
docs.text:
frappe.ui.Tags is a tag input. frappe.ui.TagEditor uses it for the document tags in the form sidebar and saves them with frappe.desk.doctype.tag.tag.add_tag and remove_tag.

frappe.ui.Tags option Description parent jQuery container. The add button goes into its .form-sidebar-items child. placeholder Content of the add button (HTML). tagsList Initial tags. onTagAdd(tag), onTagRemove(tag), onTagClick(tag) Callbacks.

Methods: addTag(label), addTags(labels), removeTag(label), clearTags(), activate() (show the input), deactivate().

frappe.ui.TagEditor options: parent, frm (required, gives doctype and docname), user_tags (comma-separated string), on_change(user_tags). Method: refresh(user_tags).

docs.title: frappe.ui.Tree
docs.text:
new frappe.ui.Tree(opts) renders a lazy-loading tree. The tree view of a DocType uses it. See List and Report Views for tree view settings.

Option Default Description parent Container element. label Root label. root_value label Value of the root node. method Whitelisted method that returns children. Called with args, parent and is_root. Returns [{ value, title, expandable }]. args Extra arguments for method. toolbar Node buttons: { label, icon, click(node), condition(node), danger }. get_label(node) Return the node label. on_click(node), on_render(node), on_node_render(node, deep) Node hooks. use_row_actions false Full-width rows with hover actions and a context menu. row_style false Row look without actions. sort_order "default" "default" (server order), "asc" or "desc". with_skeleton 1 Show a loading skeleton. icon_set chevrons { open, closed, leaf } HTML.

Methods: refresh() (reload the parent of the selected node), load_children(node, deep = false) (Promise), expand_node(node, click = true), toggle_node(node), get_selected_node(), set_selected_node(node), filter_nodes(txt) (returns the match count), set_sort_order(sort_order). Properties: root_node, nodes.

docs.title: Charts
docs.text:
frappe.ui.chart(el, config) draws a chart into el and returns a handle at once. The chart is a frappe-ui chart, drawn by the frappe.chart island inside a shadow root. If System Settings has Use Classic Charts (use_classic_charts) on, a frappe-charts config is drawn with Frappe Charts and the handle is the Frappe Charts object.

const chart = frappe.ui.chart(page.main.find(".sample-chart")[0], {
    type: "bar",
    data: [
        { month: "Jan", total: 5 },
        { month: "Feb", total: 7 },
    ],
    x: "month",
    y: "total",
    height: 240,
});
await chart.ready;
chart.update({ type: "line", data: rows, x: "month", y: "total" });
chart.destroy();
Config key Description type bar, line, area, donut, funnel, heatmap, calendar-heatmap, percentage-bar, sankey, scatter or number. data List of rows. A plain object with labels and datasets is a Frappe Charts config, and is converted. x, y, y2 Column names for axis charts. y can be a list. height Height in pixels. fieldtype, options, precision, currency Format values as desk formats a field of this type. A number with no type is a Float.

Other keys are props of the frappe-ui chart component of that type.

Name Description frappe.ui.chart(el, config) Returns { update(config), destroy(), ready }. A converted Frappe Charts config also has data and draw(). update of such a handle takes a full config or a data object. frappe.ui.chart.is_classic(config) true if this config is drawn with Frappe Charts. frappe.ui.chart.with_classic_palette(config) Add the theme palette when the chart is classic and has no colors.

docs.title: Espresso components
docs.text:
These functions make the desk design system elements. Most come in three forms: a factory that returns a jQuery element (frappe.ui.button(opts)), an .html(opts) form that returns a string, and for stateful ones a class (frappe.ui.Dropdown). Labels and titles are escaped unless the table says HTML. Icon names are Lucide names.

Common keys: css_class (extra classes) and attrs (extra attributes, { name: value }).

docs.title: Static elements
docs.text: Function Main options Description frappe.ui.button(opts), .html(opts) label, loading_label, variant (solid, subtle, outline, ghost, default subtle), size (xs, sm, md, lg, default sm), theme (gray, red), icon, icon_left, icon_right, title, tooltip, href, disabled, loading, type (default button), onclick Button. If onclick returns a Promise, the button is busy until it settles. With href, renders an <a>. frappe.ui.button.dress(el, opts) same as button Turn an existing element into a button, or change its label, variant or icon. frappe.ui.badge(opts), .html(opts) label, theme (gray, blue, green, amber, red, violet, orange), size (sm, md, lg), variant, icon, icon_right, title Badge. frappe.ui.alert(opts), .html(opts) title, description, theme (yellow, blue, red, green, amber), variant (subtle, outline), icon, primary_action, secondary_action, footer, dismissible, on_dismiss Inline alert box. Actions take frappe.ui.button options. frappe.ui.avatar(opts), .html(opts) image, label, size (xs to 3xl), shape (circle, square), theme (auto picks by label), indicator, title Avatar. Falls back to the first letter. frappe.ui.avatar_group(opts), .html(opts) avatars, max (3), size, shape, theme, onclick, hover_card, add Overlapping avatars with a "+N" circle. frappe.ui.breadcrumbs(opts), .html(opts) items: { label, href, onclick, prefix, suffix, title } Breadcrumb trail. frappe.ui.divider(opts), .html(opts) orientation, flex_item, action, position Line, with an optional button on it. frappe.ui.skeleton(opts), .html(opts) width, height Loading placeholder. frappe.ui.empty_state(opts), .html(opts) icon, title, description, actions ({ label, variant, theme, icon, onclick, href }) Empty state block. frappe.ui.panel_header({ title, closable = true, on_close }) Returns { $header, $title, $items, $actions }.

docs.title: Toasts
docs.text:
frappe.ui.toast(opts) shows a toast and returns { id, $el, dismiss(), update(opts) }.

Option Default Description message Text. description Second line. type "message" message, info, success, warning or error. duration 5000 Milliseconds. 0 keeps the toast until closed. Hover pauses the timer. icon, icon_class Icon and its classes. closable true Close button. action Button: { label, onclick }. id random A toast with the same id updates the open one.

frappe.ui.toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error, duration }) shows a spinner toast until promise settles, then a success or error toast. success and error can be functions of the result. It returns promise.

frappe.show_alert also shows a toast. See frappe (JavaScript).

docs.title: Menus and overlays
docs.text:
Menu items have these keys: label, icon, icon_right, image, letter, description, theme (gray, red), selected, disabled, shortcut (display only), onclick(e), href, target, condition() (checked at each open), css_class, submenu (list, or a function that returns a list or a Promise). A group is { group, hide_label, options }. options can be a function, called at each open, that returns the items or a Promise.

Class (factory) Options Methods frappe.ui.Dropdown (frappe.ui.dropdown(opts) returns the trigger) trigger or button (button options), options, side (bottom), align (start), offset (4), empty_text, on_open, on_close(reason), sheet_on_mobile (false), sheet_title() open({ motion, focus }), close(reason), toggle(), set_options(options), destroy(), is_open frappe.ui.SegmentedButton (frappe.ui.segmented_button(opts) returns the wrapper) label, icon, variant, size, theme, onclick, options, menu_title, align (end), sheet_on_mobile set_options(options), destroy() frappe.ui.ContextMenu target, options, empty_text, on_open(event), on_close(reason) open_at(x, y), close(reason), set_options(options), destroy(), is_open frappe.ui.Popover (frappe.ui.popover(opts) returns the trigger) trigger or button, content (element, function or text), side, align, offset, css_class, on_open, on_close(reason) open(), close(reason), toggle(), destroy(), is_open frappe.ui.HoverCard(trigger, opts) (frappe.ui.hover_card(trigger, opts)) content, side, align (center), offset, open_delay (700), close_delay (300), css_class, on_open, on_close open(), close(), destroy(), is_open frappe.ui.Tooltip(trigger, opts) (frappe.ui.tooltip(trigger, opts)) text, only_on_overflow, shortcut, side (top), align (center), text_align, delay (500), offset, class show(), hide(), set_text(text), destroy() frappe.ui.Tooltip.delegate(root, selector, opts) same as Tooltip Tooltips for all matches in root. Returns a function that stops it.

A factory that returns the trigger stores the instance on it: .data("es-dropdown"), .data("es-popover"), .data("es-tooltip"), .data("es-hover-card").

Components in lazy bundles
Notifications and sidebar

The desk makes one frappe.ui.Notifications in the sidebar. An app does not make another. Use these helpers:

Caches it in frappe.ui.notifications.config. frappe.ui.notifications.show_open_count_list(doctype) Open the list of doctype with the "open" conditions of the notification_config hook as filters.

frappe.app.sidebar is the frappe.ui.Sidebar of the desk. See Workspaces, Sidebar and Dock.

Bound to Ctrl+/. toggle(hide) Hide or show the sidebar element. refresh() Pick the sidebar for the route and refresh the header and dock. get_item(label) Sidebar item object by label.

docs.text: Name Use instead frappe.Chart frappe.ui.chart. Logs a warning once. frappe.ui.RealtimeChart(element, socketEvent, maxLabelPoints = 8, data) frappe.ui.chart and update(data). frappe.utils.make_chart(wrapper, options) frappe.ui.chart. page.add_help_button(txt) Does nothing. dialog.add_custom_button() Does nothing. Use add_custom_action. frappe.app.sidebar.update_item(), remove_item() Do nothing.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• The values option is ignored by frappe.ui.Dialog and frappe.ui.FieldGroup. Call set_values() after make() (or after the dialog constructor).
  • primary_action does not close the dialog. Call d.hide().
  • set_message() sets plain text. set_title() and set_alert() set HTML. Escape user data.
  • frappe.ui.chart draws inside a shadow root. el.querySelector("svg") finds nothing. Use the handle.
  • MultiSelectDialog with columns and no get_query().query ignores columns.
  • frappe.ui.Tags.removeTag(label) updates the list and calls onTagRemove, but leaves the tag element. A click on the tag close button removes both.
  • frappe.ui.TagEditor reads frm.doctype and frm.docname. Options doctype and docname alone are not enough.
  • stat_card, OptionalSections and BottomSheet are undefined until you load their bundle.

docs.title: Utils and Formatting (JavaScript)
docs.text:
This page lists the client-side helpers that desk loads: type conversion, number and currency formatting, field formatting, dates, frappe.utils, frappe.urllib, frappe.dom and some globals on window. The names come from Object.keys() on a logged-in desk page on develop. Each example ran on the develop site. Results that depend on site settings name the setting. The example site uses date format dd-mm-yyyy, number format #,##,###.##, currency INR, float precision 3 and "Banker's Rounding".

For the frappe namespace (calls, messages, routing, boot), see frappe (JavaScript). For field types, see Number Fields and Date and Time Fields.

docs.title: Type conversion
docs.text:
These are globals on window.

Function Description flt(v, decimals, number_format, rounding_method) Convert to a float. Strips a currency symbol before a space and the group separators of number_format (default: system format). Returns 0 for null, "" or a value that does not parse. Rounds with _round when decimals is given. cint(v, def) Convert to an integer with parseInt. true is 1, false is 0. Returns def (default 0) if the value does not parse. cstr(s) Convert to a string. null and undefined become "". _round(num, precision, rounding_method) Round a number. rounding_method defaults to the rounding_method system default, else "Banker's Rounding (legacy)". Other values: "Banker's Rounding", "Commercial Rounding". Throws for an unknown method. roundNumber(num, precision) _round(num, precision). Kept for old code. precision(fieldname, doc) Precision of a field of doc (default cur_frm.doc). Without an open form, returns frappe.boot.sysdefaults.float_precision, which is a string. remainder(numerator, denominator, precision) Remainder, rounded to precision. round_based_on_smallest_currency_fraction(value, currency, precision) Round to the smallest_currency_fraction_value of the Currency. Without one, _round(value). is_null(v) true for null, undefined or a blank string. Returns undefined (not false) otherwise. in_list(list, item) list.includes(item). copy_dict(d) Shallow copy of an object. 
flt("1,234.567", 2);              // 1234.57
flt("1.234,56", 2, "#.###,##");   // 1234.56
flt("₹ 1,200.50");                // 1200.5
flt(2.5, 0);                      // 2 (Banker's Rounding)
flt(2.5, 0, null, "Commercial Rounding"); // 3
cint("12.9");                     // 12
cint("abc", 5);                   // 5
cstr(null);                       // ""

docs.title: Number and currency formatting
docs.text:
Globals on window.

Function Description format_number(v, format, decimals) Format a number with the group and decimal separators of format. Without format, uses the system number format and, if decimals is not given, the float_precision default (else 3). Without decimals, uses the decimals of format. format_currency(v, currency, decimals) format_number with the currency symbol before the value, or after it when the Currency has symbol_on_right. decimals defaults to the currency_precision system default. No symbol when hide_currency_symbol is set. get_currency_symbol(currency) Symbol from the Currency in locals, else the currency code. currency defaults to the system currency. Returns null when hide_currency_symbol is "1" or "Yes". get_number_format(currency) Number format of the Currency when use_number_format_from_currency is enabled. Else the system number_format, else "#,###.##". get_number_format_info(format) { decimal_str, group_sep, precision } of a format. Unknown formats get . and ,. strip_number_groups(v, number_format) Remove group separators and change the decimal separator to .. Returns a string. convert_old_to_new_number_format(v, old_number_format, new_number_format) Change the separators of a formatted string from one format to another. fmt_money(v, format) Deprecated. Calls format_currency(v, format).

frappe.number_format_info lists the supported formats: #,###.##, #.###,##, # ###.##, # ###,##, #'###.##, #, ###.##, #,##,###.##, #,###.###, #.###, #,###.

format_number(1234567.891, "#,###.##");     // "1,234,567.89"
format_number(1234567.891, "#.###,##", 1);  // "1.234.567,9"
format_number(1234567.891);                 // "12,34,567.891" (format #,##,###.##, precision 3)
format_currency(1234.5, "USD");             // "$ 1,234.50"
format_currency(1234.5, "INR", 0);          // "₹ 1,234"
get_number_format_info("#.###,##");         // { decimal_str: ",", group_sep: ".", precision: 2 }

docs.title: frappe.format
docs.text:
frappe.format(value, df, options, doc)

Format a value for display by its field definition df. Returns HTML (or a plain value for some options). Without df, the value is formatted as Data. Fields in the masked_fields of the DocType are formatted as Data. A Dynamic Link is formatted as a Link to doc[df.options]. df.formatter, if set, replaces the standard formatter. The result has <script>, <style> and similar tags removed (frappe.dom.remove_script_and_style). Other HTML in a Data value is not escaped.

Option Description inline Return numbers without the right-aligned <div> wrapper. only_value Like inline. For Link, return the title or value as text, not an <a> tag. for_print For Link, return text, not an <a> tag. always_show_decimals For Float, keep decimals on whole numbers. By default 2.000 shows as 2. label For Link, the link text.

Formatters exist for: Data, Autocomplete, Select, Float, Int, Percent, Rating, Currency, Check, Link, Date, DateRange, Datetime, Text, Time, Duration, LikedBy, Tag, Comment, Assign, SmallText, TextEditor, Code, WorkflowState, Email, FileSize, TableMultiSelect, Color, Icon, Attach, AttachImage. Other field types use Data.

frappe.format(1234.5, { fieldtype: "Currency", options: "currency" }, { inline: 1 }, { currency: "USD" }); // "$ 1,234.50"
// options is the fieldname that holds the currency, not a currency code
frappe.format(2, { fieldtype: "Float" });            // "<div style='text-align: right'>2</div>"
frappe.format("2026-01-15", { fieldtype: "Date" });  // "15-01-2026" (date format dd-mm-yyyy)
frappe.format(3661, { fieldtype: "Duration" });      // "1h 1m 1s"
frappe.format(1536, { fieldtype: "Int", options: "File Size" }); // "1.50K"
frappe.format("ToDo", { fieldtype: "Link", options: "DocType" }, { only_value: 1 }); // "ToDo"

docs.title: Related helpers
docs.text: Name Description frappe.form.get_formatter(fieldtype) Formatter function of a field type. Spaces are removed ("Small Text" gives SmallText). Unknown types get Data. frappe.form.formatters Map of field type to formatter(value, df, options, doc). Assign a key to add or replace a formatter. frappe.form.link_formatters[doctype] fn(value, doc, docfield) that changes the display value of Links to doctype. Frappe sets one for User that shows <fieldname>_full_name from doc. frappe.get_format_helper(doc) Copy of doc with get_formatted(fieldname), which calls frappe.format with { inline: 1 }. frappe.meta.set_formatter(doctype, fieldname, name, formatter) Set df.formatter on one field. See frappe (JavaScript). $.format(str, args) Replace {0}, {1} (or {} in order) with items of args. Used by __().

docs.title: Dates and times
docs.text:
frappe.datetime uses moment.js. The system string formats are frappe.defaultDateFormat (YYYY-MM-DD), frappe.defaultTimeFormat (HH:mm:ss) and frappe.defaultDatetimeFormat. moment.defaultFormat is set to YYYY-MM-DD, so functions that call moment().format() return a date only.

Function Description get_today() / nowdate() / now_date(as_obj = false) Today in the user time zone, as yyyy-mm-dd, or a Date with as_obj. now_time(as_obj = false) Current time in the user time zone, HH:mm:ss. now_datetime(as_obj = false) Current date and time in the user time zone. system_datetime(as_obj = false) Current date and time in the system time zone. add_days(d, days) Add days. Returns yyyy-mm-dd. The time part is dropped. add_months(d, months) Add months. Returns yyyy-mm-dd. get_diff(d1, d2) / get_day_diff(d1, d2) Whole days of d1 minus d2. get_hour_diff(d1, d2) / get_minute_diff(d1, d2) Whole hours or minutes of d1 minus d2. week_start() / week_end() First or last day of this week. The week starts on Sunday (moment locale en). month_start() / month_end() First or last day of this month. quarter_start() / quarter_end() First or last day of this quarter. year_start() / year_end() First or last day of this year. str_to_obj(d) System string to Date. obj_to_str(d) Date to yyyy-mm-dd. obj_to_user(d) Date to a date string in the user format. str_to_user(val, only_time = false, only_date = false) System string to user format. A datetime is also converted from the system to the user time zone. user_to_str(val, only_time = false) User format to system format. Also accepts a 2-digit year. user_to_obj(d) User format to Date. get_datetime_as_string(d) Date to yyyy-mm-dd plus the system time format. global_date_format(d) Long date, for example 15th January 2026. Adds the time for a datetime. get_time(timestamp) Time as hh:mm A. convert_to_user_tz(date, format) System time zone to user time zone. Returns a string, or a moment object with format === false. convert_to_system_tz(date, format) User time zone to system time zone. Same return as above. is_system_time_zone() / is_timezone_same() true if the user and system time zones have the same offset now. get_user_date_fmt() / get_user_fmt() System date_format, for example dd-mm-yyyy. Default yyyy-mm-dd. get_user_time_fmt() System time_format. Default HH:mm:ss. validate(d) true if d is a valid date, datetime or time in system format (strict parse). get_first_day_of_the_week_index() Index (0 is Sunday) of the first_day_of_the_week system default. prettyDate(date, mini) Relative time, for example 2 hours ago or yesterday. frappe.datetime.add_days("2026-01-31", 1);                  // "2026-02-01"
frappe.datetime.add_months("2026-01-31", 1);                // "2026-02-28"

Function Description unique(list) Remove duplicates. Keys are compared as strings. sum(list) Sum with flt. all(lst) true if every item is truthy. remove_nulls(list) Remove items for which is_null is true (also blank strings). dict(keys, values) List of objects from a key list and a list of rows. arrays_equal(arr1, arr2) Compare two arrays item by item. docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• frappe.datetime.add_days and add_months drop the time part of a datetime.
  • get_user_date_fmt() and get_user_time_fmt() return the system formats. There is no per-user date format.
  • frappe.scrub does not replace hyphens. The Python frappe.scrub does.
  • filter_dict with <, <=, > or >= compares against the whole [op, value] array, so these filters do not match.
  • cleanup_filters removes the last filter row when rows have 5 items. get_filter_from_json('[["ToDo","status","=","Open",false]]', "ToDo") returns [].
  • nth(11), nth(12) and nth(13) return "11st", "12nd" and "13rd".
  • frappe.tools.downloadify checks has_common(roles, roles), which is always true, so the role check never blocks.
  • frappe.get_avatar() without data_attributes writes undefined="" into the HTML.
  • make_event_emitter off() does not remove handlers. It unbinds a new wrapper function.
  • frappe.format does not escape HTML in a Data value. Escape user input with frappe.utils.escape_html before you show it.
  • precision() returns a string when no form is open.
  • is_null returns undefined instead of false.

docs.title: frappe.db
docs.text: frappe.db is the database connection of the current site. Use this page to look up the exact signature, return value and side effects of a method. For how to read, filter and write data, and for when Frappe commits, see Database. For frappe.db.qb and frappe.qb.get_query, see Query Builder reference.

docs.title: Classes
docs.text:
frappe.database.get_db() makes the connection object from db_type in the site config. frappe.connect() stores it in frappe.local.db.

db_type Class Module mariadb (default) MariaDBDatabase(MariaDBConnectionUtil, MariaDBExceptionUtil, Database) frappe/database/mariadb/database.py postgres PostgresDatabase(PostgresExceptionUtil, Database) frappe/database/postgres/database.py sqlite SQLiteDatabase(SQLiteExceptionUtil, Database) frappe/database/sqlite/database.py

All three extend Database in frappe/database/database.py. A method that the base class does not implement raises NotImplementedError on an engine that does not override it.

Unless a row says so, a method:

  • does not check permissions,
  • does not run controller methods, validations or doc_events,
  • does not commit.

The signatures below come from inspect.signature on a develop site (MariaDB) and from the code of the other engines.

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text: Attribute Type Description db_type str "mariadb", "postgres" or "sqlite". cur_db_name str Name of the connected database. qb query builder class Query builder for the dialect of this connection. frappe.qb is bound to the site's primary database. Use frappe.db.qb when the connection can be a replica. transaction_writes int Count of INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE statements in the open transaction. Reset by commit and rollback. MAX_WRITES_PER_TRANSACTION int 200_000. Overridden by max_writes_per_transaction in the site config. auto_commit_on_many_writes int 0. When true, Frappe commits instead of raising frappe.TooManyWritesError at the write limit. value_cache defaultdict Request cache used by cache=True reads. Cleared on commit and rollback. in_read_only_transaction bool True inside read_only(). last_query str The last query with its values. Set on MariaDB and Postgres after the first query. before_commit, after_commit, before_rollback, after_rollback CallbackManager Callback queues. See Transactions. type_map dict Field type to (column type, length) for this engine. VARCHAR_LEN int 140. MAX_COLUMN_LENGTH int 64 (63 on Postgres). DEFAULT_COLUMNS tuple ("name", "creation", "modified", "modified_by", "owner", "docstatus", "idx"). CHILD_TABLE_COLUMNS tuple ("parent", "parenttype", "parentfield"). OPTIONAL_COLUMNS tuple ("_user_tags", "_comments", "_assign", "_liked_by"). ProgrammingError, OperationalError, InternalError, DataError, SQLError, TableMissingError, InterfaceError, SequenceGeneratorLimitExceeded exception class Driver exception classes of the engine. SQLite has no InterfaceError. InvalidColumnName exception class Subclass of frappe.ValidationError.

docs.title: get_value
docs.text:
frappe.db.get_value(
    doctype: str,
    filters: str | int | bool | dict | list | None = None,
    fieldname: str | list[str] = "name",
    ignore: bool = False,
    as_dict: bool = False,
    debug: bool = False,
    order_by: str = "KEEP_DEFAULT_ORDERING",
    cache: bool = False,
    for_update: bool = False,
    *,
    run: bool = True,
    pluck: bool = False,
    distinct: bool = False,
    skip_locked: bool = False,
    wait: bool = True,
)

Return a value from the first matching row. It calls get_values with limit=1.

Parameter Description filters A document name, a dict, a list of filters, or a query builder criterion. Use None for a Single DocType. fieldname A column, a list of columns, or "*". "*" returns a dict. ignore Return None when the table or column does not exist. as_dict Return a frappe._dict. order_by The default sorts on creation desc for a name or dict filter. For a list filter it uses the sort settings of the DocType. Pass None for no ORDER BY. cache Keep the result in value_cache for the request. Works only when filters is a name. for_update Add FOR UPDATE. The row stays locked until commit or rollback. skip_locked, wait Add SKIP LOCKED, or NOWAIT when wait=False. wait is ignored for a list filter. run False returns the SQL with placeholders, not the result. pluck, distinct Passed to the query. distinct=True removes ORDER BY.

Returns a single value when one field is asked for, a tuple for a list of fields, a dict with as_dict=True, or None when no row matches.

frappe.db.get_value("Sample Item", "Laptop", "rate")                       # 900.0
frappe.db.get_value("Sample Item", "Laptop", ["item_name", "rate"])        # ('Laptop', 900.0)
frappe.db.get_value("Sample Item", {"category": "Hardware"}, "name")       # 'Keyboard'
frappe.db.get_value("System Settings", None, "date_format")                # 'dd-mm-yyyy'
frappe.db.get_value("Sample Item", "Laptop", "rate", run=False)
# 'SELECT `rate` FROM `tabSample Item` WHERE `name`=%(param1)s ORDER BY `creation` DESC LIMIT 1'

Same filters and ordering as get_value. get(doctype, filters=None, as_dict=True, cache=False) Return get_value(doctype, filters, "*"). A dict of all columns. get_single_value(doctype: str, fieldname: str, cache: bool = True, *, debug=False, for_update=False, run=True) Return a field of a Single DocType, cast to its field type. Cached in value_cache by default. Raises frappe.ValidationError if the field does not exist. get_singles_value(*args, **kwargs) Alias of get_single_value. get_singles_dict(doctype, debug=False, *, for_update=False, cast=False) Return all stored fields of a Single DocType as a frappe._dict. Values are strings unless cast=True. get_values_from_single(fields, filters, doctype, as_dict=False, debug=False, update=None, *, run=True, pluck=False, distinct=False) Internal helper of get_values for Single DocTypes. get_list(*args, **kwargs) Calls frappe.get_list. Checks permissions. See frappe. get_all(*args, **kwargs) Calls frappe.get_all. Does not check permissions. exists(dt, dn=None, cache=False, *, debug=False) Return the name of a matching document, or None. dn is a name or a dict of filters. dt can be a dict with a doctype key. Adds no ORDER BY. For a Single DocType with dt == dn, returns dn without a query. cache works only when dt and dn are strings. count(dt, filters=None, debug=False, cache=False, distinct: bool = True) Return COUNT(*) for the filters. cache works only without filters. estimate_count(doctype: str) -> int Return the row count from table statistics. Cached in Redis for 60 minutes. On SQLite it runs COUNT(*) with no cache. a_row_exists(doctype) Return a non-empty result if the table has at least one row. The value is a list of rows, not a bool. get_creation_count(doctype, minutes) Return the number of records with creation in the last minutes. get_last_created(doctype) Return the latest creation as a datetime, or None. get_descendants(doctype, name) Return the names below a node in a tree DocType. Returns [] if the node does not exist. get_system_setting(key) Return frappe.get_system_settings(key). 
frappe.db.get_values("Sample Item", {"category": "Hardware"}, ["name", "rate"], limit=2)
# (('Keyboard', 45.0), ('Monitor', 250.0))
frappe.db.exists("Sample Item", {"item_name": "Laptop"})    # 'Laptop'
frappe.db.count("Sample Item", {"category": "Hardware"})    # 3

docs.text:
Method Description set_value(dt: str, dn: str \| int \| bool \| dict, field: str, val=None, modified=None, modified_by=None, update_modified=True, debug=False) Run an UPDATE. dn is a name or filters. field can be a dict of field and value. Sets modified and modified_by unless update_modified=False. Clears the document cache of dn, or of the whole DocType when dn is a filter. set_single_value(doctype: str, fieldname: str \| dict, value: str \| int \| None = None, *, modified=None, modified_by=None, update_modified=True, debug=False) Delete and insert the rows of the fields in tabSingles. Clears the document cache of the Single DocType. bulk_update(doctype: str, doc_updates: dict, *, chunk_size: int = 100, modified: str \| None = None, modified_by: str \| None = None, update_modified: bool = True, debug: bool = False) Update many documents with one UPDATE ... CASE per chunk. doc_updates maps each name to a dict of values. Does not clear the document cache. bulk_insert(doctype: str, fields: list[str], values: Iterable[Sequence], ignore_duplicates=False, *, chunk_size=1000) Insert many rows with one INSERT per chunk. Does not set creation, modified or owner. ignore_duplicates uses INSERT IGNORE (MariaDB, SQLite) or ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (Postgres). delete(doctype: str, filters: dict \| list \| None = None, debug=False, **kwargs) Run DELETE for the matching rows. Without filters it deletes all rows. conditions= is an old name for filters. truncate(doctype: str) Commit, then run TRUNCATE. It cannot be rolled back. 
frappe.db.set_value("Sample Item", "Keyboard", {"rate": 50, "disabled": 0}, update_modified=False)
frappe.db.set_single_value("System Settings", "country", "India")
frappe.db.bulk_update("Sample Item", {"Keyboard": {"rate": 40}, "Monitor": {"rate": 240}})

Warning

bulk_update and bulk_insert leave the document cache as it is. frappe.get_cached_doc can return old values until the cache expires. Call frappe.clear_document_cache(doctype, name) after them.

docs.title: sql
docs.text:
frappe.db.sql(
    query: str | QueryBuilder,
    values: tuple | list | dict | None = <no value>,
    *,
    as_dict=0, as_list=0, debug=0, ignore_ddl=0, auto_commit=0,
    update=None, explain=False, run=True, pluck=False, as_iterator=False,
)
Parameter Description query SQL with %s or %(key)s placeholders, or a query builder object. A query builder object is converted with walk(), so its values are bound. values Values for the placeholders. A single value that is not a tuple, list or dict is wrapped in a tuple. as_dict Return a list of frappe._dict. as_list Return a list of lists. pluck Return a list of the first column. update Dict to merge into each row. Works with as_dict. as_iterator Return a generator that fetches 1,000 rows at a time. Needs as_dict or as_list (or pluck). Use it in unbuffered_cursor() to keep memory low. debug Log the query and its run time. explain Return None without running the query. With debug=True, also log EXPLAIN of a SELECT. ignore_ddl Return () instead of raising when the table, column or key is missing. auto_commit Commit before and after the query. run False returns the query string.

Returns a tuple of tuples by default, or () for a statement without a result set.

Side effects:

  • ifnull( is rewritten to coalesce(.
  • A deadlock raises frappe.QueryDeadlockError. A lock wait timeout raises frappe.QueryTimeoutError. A write in read-only mode raises frappe.InReadOnlyMode.
  • A write after more than MAX_WRITES_PER_TRANSACTION writes raises frappe.TooManyWritesError.
  • On MariaDB, START, BEGIN, CREATE, ALTER, DROP or TRUNCATE after a write raises frappe.exceptions.ImplicitCommitError. Use sql_ddl for DDL.
  • In a Server Script, frappe.db.sql allows only SELECT and EXPLAIN queries. It cannot read __Auth.
frappe.db.sql(
    "select name, rate from `tabSample Item` where category=%s limit 2", "Hardware", as_dict=True
)
# [{'name': 'Keyboard', 'rate': 45.0}, {'name': 'Laptop', 'rate': 900.0}]

with frappe.db.unbuffered_cursor():
    for row in frappe.db.sql("select name from `tabSample Item`", as_iterator=True, as_dict=True):
        print(row.name)

Warning

Pass values in values. Never put user input in the query with string formatting.

"*" is the fallback. mogrify(query, values) Return the query with values filled in. For logs only. lazy_mogrify(query, values) Return a LazyMogrify object. It builds the string only when you call str() on it. escape(s, percent=True) Return s as a quoted SQL string literal. Doubles % when percent=True. explain_query(query, values=<no value>) Log EXPLAIN of the query. unbuffered_cursor() Context manager. Uses a server-side cursor for the block. Read all rows inside the block. get_description() Return the cursor description (column metadata) of the last query. execute_query(query, values=None) Run the query on the cursor without the checks of sql. Internal. fetch_as_dict(result) -> list[_dict] Convert rows of the last query to dicts. Internal. convert_to_lists(res) Convert tuples to lists. Internal. log_query(query, query_type, values=None, debug=False) Log a query as sql does. Internal. check_transaction_status(query: str, query_type: str \| None = None) Apply the write limit and the implicit-commit check. Internal. check_implicit_commit(query: str, query_type: str) Raise ImplicitCommitError for implicit-commit statements after writes. MariaDB only. Postgres and SQLite do nothing. format_date(date) Return "YYYY-MM-DD". format_datetime(datetime) Return "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff", or "0001-01-01 00:00:00.000000" for an empty value. SQLite uses isoformat(" "). 
frappe.db.escape("a'b%c")                 # "'a\\'b%%c'"  (MariaDB)
frappe.db.escape("a'b%c", percent=False)  # "'a\\'b%c'"
frappe.db.mogrify("select %s, %s", ("x", 1))   # "select 'x', 1"

docs.title: Transactions
docs.text:
See Database for when Frappe commits and rolls back for you.

Method Description begin(*, read_only=False) Run START TRANSACTION, or START TRANSACTION READ ONLY. frappe.flags.read_only also makes it read-only. commit(*, chain=False) Run before_commit callbacks, COMMIT, then start a new transaction. Clears value_cache and the rollback callbacks. Then runs after_commit callbacks. Inside read_only() it rolls back instead. rollback(*, save_point=None, chain=False) Run before_rollback callbacks, ROLLBACK, then start a new transaction. Clears the commit callbacks. Then runs after_rollback callbacks. With save_point, roll back to that savepoint only and run no callbacks. savepoint(save_point) Run SAVEPOINT <save_point>. release_savepoint(save_point) Run RELEASE SAVEPOINT <save_point>. read_only() Context manager. Rolls back, then runs the block in read-only transactions. A write raises frappe.InReadOnlyMode. Raises frappe.ValidationError if the open transaction has writes or after_commit callbacks. Rolls back at the end. run_after_transaction_callbacks(callbacks) Run the queued callbacks. A failing callback is logged in Error Log and the rest still run. execution_timeout(seconds: float) Context manager. Sets the statement timeout for the block, then restores the old value. set_execution_timeout(seconds: float) Set the statement timeout of the session. get_execution_timeout() -> float Return the statement timeout in seconds. 0 means no timeout. advisory_lock(key, *, timeout=10) Context manager. Holds a session-level named lock for the block. Polls every 0.1 seconds. Raises frappe.QueryTimeoutError after timeout seconds. transaction_advisory_lock(key, *, timeout=10) Take a lock that the database releases when the transaction ends. Postgres only.

A commit or rollback is ignored with a warning while _disable_transaction_control is set. Document.run_method sets it while controller hooks and doc_events run.

Callbacks:

frappe.db.after_commit.add(lambda: frappe.publish_realtime("sample_event"))
frappe.db.before_rollback.add(cleanup_files)

frappe.database.database.savepoint(catch=Exception) is a context manager and a decorator. It makes a savepoint with a random name, rolls back to it when catch is raised, and suppresses the exception:

from frappe.database.database import savepoint

for name in ["Keyboard", "Webcam"]:
    with savepoint(catch=frappe.DuplicateEntryError):
        frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Sample Item", "item_name": name}).insert()

Note

A rollback to a savepoint undoes database changes only. Files written in the block stay.

Other helpers in frappe/database/utils.py:

Function Description commit_after_response(func) In a request, run func and commit after the response is sent. Each function runs in a savepoint, and errors go to Error Log. Outside a request or in tests, runs func at once. dangerously_reconnect_on_connection_abort(func) Decorator. After an InterfaceError or OperationalError, reconnects and calls func once more. The open transaction is lost. Use it only for logging or final steps of a job. drop_index_if_exists(table: str, index: str) Drop an index with sql_ddl if it exists. Prints the result.

frappe.database.database.get_query_execution_timeout() returns the timeout set at connect time. It is 0 unless enable_db_statement_timeout is set in the site config. Then it is 1.5 times http_timeout (default 300) for a request, or 1.5 times the job timeout. See Site Config.
