docs.title: How Settings Work
docs.text: A settings page in Frappe is a Single DocType. A Single DocType has exactly one record, and the record has the same name as the DocType. For example, the one record of System Settings is named System Settings. Use this page to find a settings page, to know when a change takes effect, and to read or build settings in an app.

docs.title: Single DocTypes and tabSingles
docs.text:
A DocType with Is Single (issingle) set has no table of its own. Frappe stores its values in the shared table tabSingles. Each value is one row with the columns doctype, field and value. All values are stored as text and cast to the field type when you read them.

  • A Single DocType cannot be submittable, importable or renamed. Frappe clears these flags when you save the DocType.
  • Until you save a Single for the first time, tabSingles has no rows for it. See Defaults of a Single.
  • The desk opens a Single as a form, not as a list.

docs.title: Open a settings page
docs.text:
Each Single has a desk route /desk/<slug>. The slug is the DocType name in lowercase, with hyphens for spaces. For example, System Settings opens at /desk/system-settings.

You can also use the awesomebar:

  1. Press Ctrl+K.
  2. Type part of the name, for example print sett.
  3. Select the settings page in the results.

docs.title: Who can edit
docs.text:
The permission rules on each DocType control who can open and save it. In Frappe, the System Manager role can read and write all settings DocTypes, except the website settings. The Website Manager role writes Website Settings, Portal Settings, Contact Us Settings, About Us Settings and Website Script. See the table in Settings DocTypes in Frappe.

Some controllers check the role again. For example, the System Settings form loads its values through frappe.core.doctype.system_settings.system_settings.load, which throws PermissionError for users without System Manager.

docs.title: When a change takes effect
docs.text:
A change in a settings form takes effect at different times on the server and in the browser.

Where When the new value is used Server code that reads the document (frappe.get_cached_doc, frappe.get_single_value, frappe.get_system_settings) On the next request after the save. Save clears the document cache. Server code that reads a global default (frappe.db.get_default) On the next request, if the controller copies the value to the defaults. System Settings does this. Desk JavaScript that reads frappe.boot After the user reloads the page. The boot data loads once per page load.

How the cache is cleared:

  • Document.save() calls clear_cache() after on_update. This runs frappe.clear_document_cache(doctype, name). It removes the document from Redis and from frappe.db.value_cache.
  • frappe.db.set_single_value() also calls frappe.clear_document_cache().
  • When you save System Settings, on_update writes each changed value as a global default with frappe.db.set_default. A changed global default clears the full site cache, including the cached boot data of all users (bootinfo).
  • After you save System Settings with a changed Language or Rounding Method, the form reloads the page.

Note

Other users keep the old boot data in their open browser tabs. They see the change after they reload the page.

docs.title: Read and write settings in Python
docs.text:
Function Returns Cache Notes frappe.get_single(doctype) Document No Same as frappe.get_doc(doctype, doctype). Applies field defaults if the Single was never saved. frappe.get_cached_doc(doctype) Document Redis, 1 hour Use for frequent reads. Do not change and save the returned object. frappe.get_single_value(doctype, fieldname) value Redis, through get_cached_doc Use for frequent reads of one value. frappe.db.get_single_value(doctype, fieldname, cache=True) value cast to the field type Per request (frappe.db.value_cache) Reads tabSingles directly. Does not apply field defaults. frappe.db.get_singles_dict(doctype, cast=False) frappe._dict of all values No Pass cast=True to cast values to field types. frappe.db.set_single_value(doctype, fieldname, value) None Clears document cache Pass a dict as fieldname to set many values. Skips validation, controller methods and permissions. frappe.get_system_settings(key) value Client cache and frappe.local for the request Only for System Settings. 
# Read
date_format = frappe.get_system_settings("date_format")
backup_limit = frappe.db.get_single_value("System Settings", "backup_limit")  # int
print_settings = frappe.get_cached_doc("Print Settings")

# Write with validation and controller methods
settings = frappe.get_single("Sample Settings")
settings.page_limit = 20
settings.save()

# Write without validation and controller methods
frappe.db.set_single_value("Sample Settings", {"page_limit": 20, "enable_feature": 1})

Warning

frappe.db.set_single_value("System Settings", ...) does not run on_update. The global default is not updated, so frappe.boot.sysdefaults and frappe.db.get_default() keep the old value. Use doc.save() when the value must reach the desk.

docs.title: Read settings in JavaScript
docs.text:
The desk gets some settings in frappe.boot when the page loads.

Key Content frappe.boot.sysdefaults Global defaults, from frappe.defaults.get_defaults(). Includes the System Settings values that were saved in the form. The user's own defaults override them. frappe.sys_defaults Same object as frappe.boot.sysdefaults. Set in frappe/public/js/frappe/desk.js. frappe.boot.time_zone {system, user} time zones. frappe.boot.navbar_settings Values of Navbar Settings. 
// Values loaded at boot
frappe.boot.sysdefaults.date_format; // "dd-mm-yyyy"
frappe.defaults.get_default("date_format"); // reads frappe.sys_defaults
frappe.defaults.is_enabled("hide_empty_read_only_fields"); // true if the value is 1

// Value read from the server on demand. Needs read permission on the DocType.
const time_zone = await frappe.db.get_single_value("System Settings", "time_zone");

frappe.db.get_single_value calls frappe.client.get_single_value. That method uses frappe.read_doc, so the user needs read permission on the settings DocType. Most settings DocTypes allow read only to System Manager. To give a value to all desk users, add it to the boot data from your app. See Build your own settings DocType.

docs.title: Defaults of a Single
docs.text:
A field default in the DocType JSON is applied only when the Single has no rows in tabSingles. This was checked on a temporary Single with a Check field (default 1) and an Int field (default 50):

Read Before the first save After a field is added to a saved Single frappe.get_single() 1 and 50 (defaults applied) None for the new field frappe.db.get_single_value() 0 and 0 0 for the new field

Because of this, code in Frappe usually adds a fallback when it reads a value, for example frappe.get_system_settings("email_retry_limit") or 3. Do the same in your app, or set the value in a patch.

docs.title: Set values from an app
docs.text:
Method Use it for Notes after_install hook Initial values when your app is installed Runs once per site. Patch in patches.txt Values for a new field on sites that already have the app Runs once per site at bench migrate. Fixture of a Single Not recommended for settings The whole document is imported again at each bench migrate. Values that a user changed on the site are overwritten. Fixture of Property Setter Change a field property of a Single, for example hidden or default Changes the form, not the stored value. 
# sample_app/hooks.py
after_install = "sample_app.install.after_install"

# sample_app/install.py
import frappe


def after_install():
    settings = frappe.get_single("Sample Settings")
    settings.page_limit = 50
    settings.save()

To change a setting of another DocType, such as System Settings, use doc.save() so that its controller runs. See Fixtures and Patches and Hooks.

docs.title: Change the settings form
docs.text:
• Customize Form does not accept Single DocTypes. It throws "Single DocTypes cannot be customized.", and its DocType picker hides Singles.
  • The DocType picker of the Custom Field form also hides Singles. From code, create_custom_fields() adds a field to a Single. This was checked on a temporary Single.
  • A Client Script or a doctype_js hook works on a Single form like on any other form.

docs.title: Build your own settings DocType
docs.text:
1. Create a DocType in your app module and set Is Single.
  2. Add the fields. Give each field a default, and also use a fallback in code.
  3. Set the permissions. Give write access to System Manager or to an app manager role.
  4. Add validation in the controller.
  5. Read values with frappe.get_single_value() or frappe.get_cached_doc().
# sample_app/sample_app/doctype/sample_settings/sample_settings.py
import frappe
from frappe.model.document import Document


class SampleSettings(Document):
    def validate(self):
        if self.page_limit and self.page_limit > 500:
            frappe.throw(frappe._("Page Limit cannot be more than 500"))

    def on_update(self):
        # Only needed for values that you cache yourself
        frappe.cache.delete_value("sample_app:derived_limits")


def get_page_limit() -> int:
    return frappe.get_single_value("Sample Settings", "page_limit") or 50

Document.save() clears the document cache of the Single for you. Clear only the caches that you build from the values.

To send a value to the desk of every user, use the extend_bootinfo hook. Frappe runs it on each desk load. The boot_session hook runs inside get_bootinfo(), and its result is cached per user in bootinfo until the cache is cleared.

# sample_app/hooks.py
extend_bootinfo = ["sample_app.boot.extend_bootinfo"]

# sample_app/boot.py
import frappe


def extend_bootinfo(bootinfo):
    bootinfo.sample_page_limit = frappe.get_single_value("Sample Settings", "page_limit") or 50

// read it in the desk
frappe.boot.sample_page_limit;

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• frappe.db.get_single_value() returns 0 or an empty string for a field that was never saved. It does not use the field default.
  • frappe.db.set_single_value() skips validation and on_update. For System Settings, the desk does not see the new value.
  • frappe.get_cached_doc() returns a shared cached object. Do not change it. Use frappe.get_single() to change and save.
  • A fixture of a Single overwrites the values on each bench migrate.
  • Open browser tabs keep the old frappe.boot values until the user reloads the page.

docs.title: Integration Settings
docs.text:
This page is the field reference for the settings DocTypes that connect a site to outside systems. For each field it gives the default and the code that reads it. For step-by-step setup of OAuth clients, LDAP login, Google and push notifications, see Integrations. For how Single DocTypes work in general, see How Settings Work.

All DocTypes on this page are Single DocTypes. Only the System Manager role can read or write them.

DocType Module Route OAuth Provider Settings Integrations /desk/oauth-provider-settings OAuth Settings Integrations /desk/oauth-settings LDAP Settings Integrations /desk/ldap-settings Push Notification Settings Integrations /desk/push-notification-settings Geolocation Settings Integrations /desk/geolocation-settings Google Settings Integrations /desk/google-settings SMS Settings Core /desk/sms-settings

docs.title: OAuth Provider Settings
docs.text:
This DocType has one field. It sets if a user must approve an OAuth client again when the user already has an active token for it. Open it at /desk/oauth-provider-settings. The newer OAuth Settings has a Skip Authorization check that takes precedence (see below).

Field Default Effect Skip Authorization (skip_authorization) Force (first option) Force or Auto. Read by get_oauth_settings() in frappe/integrations/utils.py, but only when Skip Authorization in OAuth Settings is off. With Auto, authorize in frappe/integrations/oauth2.py skips the approval page when the user has an Active OAuth Bearer Token for the client. With Force, the user sees the approval page each time.

The per-client check Skip Authorization on OAuth Client skips the approval page for that client in all cases.

docs.title: OAuth Settings
docs.text: OAuth Settings controls how this site acts as an OAuth 2.0 authorization server and protected resource: the /.well-known/ metadata endpoints, dynamic client registration and CORS for public clients. Open it at /desk/oauth-settings. The Enable MCP field in System Settings links to this form, because MCP clients sign in with OAuth. The controller has no validate. All reads use frappe.get_cached_value or frappe.get_cached_doc, so a save takes effect on the next request.

docs.title: Authorization (tab)
docs.text: Field Default Effect Show Auth Server Metadata (show_auth_server_metadata) 1 When on, handle_wellknown in frappe/integrations/oauth2.py serves GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (RFC 8414). When off, that path falls through to the files apps ship in www/.well-known/. Skip Authorization (skip_authorization) 0 When on, get_oauth_settings() returns Auto. The approval page is skipped for a user who has an Active token for the client. Overrides OAuth Provider Settings. Enable Dynamic Client Registration (enable_dynamic_client_registration) 1 When on, register_client (POST /api/method/frappe.integrations.oauth2.register_client, guest, 5 calls per 10 minutes) makes a new OAuth Client (RFC 7591). The authorization server metadata then includes registration_endpoint. When off, the endpoint returns 404. Also allows CORS on that endpoint, see the next row. Allowed Public Client Origins (allowed_public_client_origins) empty One origin per line, or * for all. Read by _set_allowed_cors() in frappe/integrations/oauth2.py, called from the before_request hook set_cors_for_privileged_requests. Sets CORS for POST and OPTIONS on the token, revoke, introspect and user info endpoints, and on register_client when dynamic registration is on. Empty: no CORS headers are added for these endpoints.

docs.title: Config (Resource tab)
docs.text: Field Default Effect Show Protected Resource Metadata (show_protected_resource_metadata) 1 When on, GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource returns the resource metadata (RFC 9728). Also, frappe/app.py adds the header WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="<site>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" to every 401 and 403 response. Show Social Login Key as Authorization Server (show_social_login_key_as_authorization_server) 0 When on, the resource metadata lists in authorization_servers the Base URL of each Social Login Key that has Enable Social Login and Show in Resource Metadata on, after this site.

docs.title: Metadata (Resource tab)
docs.text:
These fields go into the JSON of /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, built by _get_protected_resource_metadata() in frappe/integrations/oauth2.py. An empty field is left out of the response.

Field Default Effect Resource Name (resource_name) Frappe Framework Application Sent as resource_name. Resource Policy URI (resource_policy_uri) empty Sent as resource_policy_uri. Resource Documentation (resource_documentation) https://docs.frappe.io/framework Sent as resource_documentation. Resource TOS URI (resource_tos_uri) empty Sent as resource_tos_uri. Scopes Supported (scopes_supported) empty One scope per line. Sent as the list scopes_supported.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
from frappe.integrations.utils import get_oauth_settings

get_oauth_settings().skip_authorization  # "Auto", "Force" or None
frappe.get_cached_value("OAuth Settings", "OAuth Settings", "enable_dynamic_client_registration")
  • frappe.integrations.oauth2.is_oauth_metadata_enabled("auth_server") and is_oauth_metadata_enabled("resource") return the two Show ... Metadata checks.
  • GET /.well-known/openid-configuration does not depend on any field here.
  • When allow_cors is * in site config, set_cors_for_privileged_requests returns early and Allowed Public Client Origins has no effect.

docs.title: LDAP Settings
docs.text:
LDAP Settings lets users log in with an LDAP or Active Directory account. Open it at /desk/ldap-settings. Fields marked mandatory in the JSON must be filled before the form saves, even when Enabled is off. When Enabled is on, validate binds to the server with the Base DN and its password, and searches both search paths. A bad connection, path or attribute stops the save.

Field Default Effect Enabled (enabled) 0 Read by frappe/www/login.py: the login page shows an LDAP login button (frappe/www/login.html) that posts to frappe.integrations.doctype.ldap_settings.ldap_settings.login. Also read by: validate_user_pass_login in System Settings (LDAP counts as another login method when you turn on Disable Username/Password Login), frappe/core/doctype/user/user.js (a Reset LDAP Password button for System Managers), and needs_password_setup in frappe/core/doctype/user/user.py (returns False, so users without a password are not asked to set one).

docs.title: LDAP Server Settings
docs.text: Field Default Effect Directory Server (ldap_directory_server) empty, mandatory Active Directory, OpenLDAP or Custom. Sets how fetch_ldap_groups finds a user's groups. Active Directory: object class Group, member attribute member, matched against the user DN. OpenLDAP: object class posixgroup, attribute memberuid, matched against the username. Custom: uses the fields in LDAP Custom Settings. LDAP Server Url (ldap_server_url) mandatory Host passed to ldap3.Server in connect_to_ldap.

docs.title: LDAP Auth
docs.text: Field Default Effect Base Distinguished Name (DN) (base_dn) mandatory Bind user for the service connection. Password for Base DN (password) mandatory Password field (stored encrypted). Read with get_password to bind.

docs.title: LDAP Search and Paths
docs.text: Field Default Effect LDAP search path for Users (ldap_search_path_user) mandatory Search base for users at login and password reset. LDAP Search String (ldap_search_string) mandatory Filter for the login name. Must start with (, end with ), have balanced brackets and contain {0}, or validate throws when Enabled is on. {0} is replaced with the escaped login name. Example: (&(objectclass=user)(uid={0})). LDAP search path for Groups (ldap_search_path_group) mandatory Search base for group lookups.

docs.title: LDAP User Creation and Mapping
docs.text:
Each field holds the name of an LDAP attribute. At login, convert_ldap_entry_to_dict copies the attribute values to the User fields shown. On each login the values overwrite the existing user's fields, except email.

Field Default Effect LDAP Email Field (ldap_email_field) mandatory Maps to email. Also used to find the LDAP entry in Reset LDAP Password. If the attribute has many values, Frappe picks the first one that matches an existing user. LDAP Username Field (ldap_username_field) mandatory Maps to username. Also the group match value for OpenLDAP and Custom. LDAP First Name Field (ldap_first_name_field) mandatory Maps to first_name. Do Not Create New User (do_not_create_new_user) 0 When on, login fails for an LDAP user who has no User with that email. When off, Frappe inserts a User with User Type from Default User Type and no welcome email. LDAP Middle Name Field (ldap_middle_name_field) empty Maps to middle_name. LDAP Last Name Field (ldap_last_name_field) empty Maps to last_name. LDAP Phone Field (ldap_phone_field) empty Maps to phone. LDAP Mobile Field (ldap_mobile_field) empty Maps to mobile_no.

docs.title: LDAP Security
docs.text: Field Default Effect SSL/TLS Mode (ssl_tls_mode) Off StartTLS binds with AUTO_BIND_TLS_BEFORE_BIND. Require Trusted Certificate (require_trusted_certificate) No Yes sets ssl.CERT_REQUIRED on the TLS configuration. No uses ssl.CERT_NONE. Path to private Key File (local_private_key_file) empty File path on the server, passed to ldap3.Tls. Path to Server Certificate (local_server_certificate_file) empty File path on the server, passed to ldap3.Tls. Path to CA Certs File (local_ca_certs_file) empty File path on the server, passed to ldap3.Tls.

docs.title: LDAP Custom Settings
docs.text:
Used only when Directory Server is Custom. With Enabled on, validate requires Group Object Class and LDAP Group Member attribute for Custom.

Field Default Effect Group Object Class (ldap_group_objectclass) empty Object class of group entries, for example group. Custom Group Search (ldap_custom_group_search) empty ({0}) Value matched against the member attribute. {0} is the username. If filled, it must contain {0}. LDAP Group Member attribute (ldap_group_member_attribute) empty Member attribute of group entries, for example member.

docs.title: LDAP Group Mappings
docs.text: Field Default Effect Default User Type (default_user_type) mandatory, validate sets Website User when empty User Type of new users. Default User Role (default_role) empty Shows and is mandatory when Default User Type is System User. Added to the user at each login. For other user types, the role of the User Type is added. LDAP Group Mappings (ldap_groups) empty Table of LDAP Group Mapping rows: LDAP Group (ldap_group) and User Role (erpnext_role). At each login, sync_roles adds the roles of groups the user is in, and removes mapped roles of groups the user is not in. Group names match without case. LDAP Group Field (ldap_group_field) empty Deprecated. Used only when Directory Server has none of the three values: the groups are read from this attribute of the user entry.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• LDAPSettings.get_ldap_client_settings() returns {"enabled": True, "method": "frappe.integrations.doctype.ldap_settings.ldap_settings.login"} when enabled. The login page uses it.
  • login is a guest POST method, rate limited to 10 calls per minute per usr. It runs two-factor authentication when it applies.
  • reset_password(user, password, logout) is whitelisted for System Manager. It writes a salted SHA hash to userPassword in LDAP.
  • The library ldap3 must be installed.

docs.title: Push Notification Settings
docs.text: Push Notification Settings turns on the push notification relay. Frappe apps then send mobile and browser push notifications through a central relay server that uses Firebase Cloud Messaging. Open it at /desk/push-notification-settings.

docs.title: Relay Settings
docs.text: Field Default Effect Enable Push Notification Relay (enable_push_notification_relay) 0 Read by PushNotification.is_enabled() in frappe/push_notification.py. When off, every relay call raises Push Notification Relay is not enabled. validate throws when you turn it on and push_relay_server_url is not in the site config.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text: Field Default Effect API Key (api_key) empty Key for the relay server. Filled by _get_credential() on the first authenticated relay call, not when you save the form. API Secret (api_secret) empty Password field. Filled with the API Key. Delete both to register the site again.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
from frappe.push_notification import PushNotification

push = PushNotification("sample_app")
if push.is_enabled():
    push.send_notification_to_user("user1@example.com", "Order shipped", "Sample Order SO-0001 is on its way")
  • The relay server URL comes from push_relay_server_url in site_config.json. See Site Config.
  • frappe.push_notification.subscribe and unsubscribe (GET, logged-in user) add or remove a device token for the session user.
  • During registration the relay server calls frappe.push_notification.auth_webhook. The token it checks is kept in Redis for 600 seconds.

docs.title: Geolocation Settings
docs.text:
Geolocation Settings turns on address search in the New Address dialog. Open it at /desk/geolocation-settings.

Field Default Effect Enable Address Autocompletion (enable_address_autocompletion) 0 Sent to the browser as frappe.boot.enable_address_autocompletion (frappe/boot.py). When it is 1, the New Address button in the Address and Contacts section of a form opens frappe.ui.AddressAutocompleteDialog (frappe/public/js/frappe/utils/address_and_contact.js) instead of the Address form. The dialog calls frappe.integrations.doctype.geolocation_settings.geolocation_settings.autocomplete. When off, that method returns an empty list. Provider (provider) Geoapify (first option) Geoapify, Nomatim or HERE. Mandatory when autocompletion is on. Base URL (base_url) empty Shows for Nomatim. Mandatory for Nomatim when autocompletion is on. Frappe calls <base_url>/search. API Key (api_key) empty Password field. Shows for Geoapify and HERE. Mandatory for them when autocompletion is on.

validate checks the same mandatory rules on the server. The boot value is read at desk load, so users must reload the desk after you change Enable Address Autocompletion. A failed provider call logs the error type and status code only, because the provider URL contains the API key.

docs.title: Google Settings
docs.text:
Google Settings holds the Google Cloud credentials for Google Calendar, Google Contacts, the Google Drive picker and Google indexing. Open it at /desk/google-settings.

Field Default Effect Enable (enable) 0 Shows the OAuth Client ID and API Key sections. GoogleOAuth (frappe/integrations/google_oauth.py), Google Calendar and Google Contacts throw Enable Google API in Google Settings. or Please enable Google Settings before continuing. when it is off. Website Settings throws on save if Enable Google Indexing is on and this field is off.

docs.title: OAuth Client ID
docs.text:
Shows when Enable is on.

Field Default Effect Client ID (client_id) empty OAuth client ID for the authorization and token calls in frappe/integrations/google_oauth.py and google_calendar.py. Mandatory when Google Drive Picker Enabled is on. Sent to the browser as clientId for the Drive picker. Client Secret (client_secret) empty Password field. Used for the token and refresh calls. GoogleOAuth and Google Calendar throw when Client ID or Client Secret is empty.

docs.title: API Key
docs.text:
Shows when Enable is on.

Field Default Effect API Key (api_key) empty Not read by Frappe code.

docs.title: Google Drive Picker
docs.text: Field Default Effect Google Drive Picker Enabled (google_drive_picker_enabled) 0 When this and Enable are on, get_file_picker_settings() returns enabled, appId and clientId. The file uploader (frappe/public/js/frappe/file_uploader/FileUploader.vue) then shows the Google Drive option. validate requires Client ID and App ID when it is on. App ID (app_id) empty Shows when the picker is on. The Google Cloud project number. Passed to setAppId in frappe/public/js/integrations/google_drive_picker.js.

docs.title: SMS Settings
docs.text:
SMS Settings configures an HTTP SMS gateway. Frappe uses it for SMS notifications and for two-factor authentication by SMS. Open it at /desk/sms-settings.

Field Default Effect SMS Gateway URL (sms_gateway_url) mandatory URL Frappe calls for each receiver. When empty, send_sms shows Please Update SMS Settings and sends nothing. System Settings refuses Two Factor Authentication method SMS while it is empty. Also sent to the browser as the boolean frappe.boot.sms_gateway_enabled, which no Frappe JS reads. Message Parameter (message_parameter) mandatory Request parameter name for the message text. Receiver Parameter (receiver_parameter) mandatory Request parameter name for the mobile number. Static Parameters (parameters) empty Table of SMS Parameter rows: Parameter, Value and Header. A row with Header on is sent as an HTTP header. Other rows are added to the request parameters. A header Content-Type: application/json makes Frappe send the parameters as a JSON body. Use POST (use_post) 0 Send a POST with form data. When off, Frappe sends a GET with query parameters. Allowed Roles (allowed_roles) empty Table of roles. check_sms_permission() lets only System Manager and users with one of these roles call the whitelisted send_sms. The patch seed_sms_settings_allowed_roles adds System Manager on sites that upgrade. New sites start empty.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• frappe.core.doctype.sms_settings.sms_settings.send_sms(receiver_list, msg, sender_name="", success_msg=True) is whitelisted and checks Allowed Roles. Server code that must skip that check calls _send_sms, as Notification does for the SMS channel.
  • The hook send_sms replaces the gateway. Frappe calls the last registered method with (receiver_list, msg, sender_name, success_msg) and does not read SMS Settings.
# sample_app/hooks.py
send_sms = "sample_app.sms.send"
  • Two-factor OTP messages (frappe/twofactor.py) read the gateway fields directly and are sent from the short queue. They do not use the send_sms hook or Allowed Roles.
  • A failed gateway call logs the error type and status code only, because the URL can contain credentials.

docs.title: Print Settings
docs.text: Print Settings is a Single DocType that sets the site defaults for printing: PDF engine, paper size, letter head, draft and cancelled prints, print style and font. Use this page to find what each field does and which code reads it. For Print Formats and the PDF engines, see Print Formats. For concepts that apply to all settings DocTypes, see How settings work.

docs.title: Print Settings
docs.text:
Open it at /desk/print-settings, or from the Print Settings menu item of the print view. Only System Manager can read and write it. The Print Format Builder also opens a Print Settings dialog that saves these fields with frappe.client.set_value, if the user has write permission.

The desk gets all values at boot. load_print() in frappe/boot.py adds the document as :Print Settings to the boot docs. Client code reads it with frappe.model.get_doc(":Print Settings", "Print Settings"). Server code mostly reads frappe.get_cached_doc("Print Settings").

docs.title: PDF Settings
docs.text:
Field Default Effect Send Print as PDF (send_print_as_pdf) 1 frappe.attach_print() (frappe/utils/print_utils.py) makes a .pdf file. When off, it attaches the print as an .html file. This affects email attachments of documents, notifications and workflow actions. Repeat Header and Footer (repeat_header_footer) 1 Repeats the letter head header and footer on each PDF page. When off, they print once, inline (_build_html_for_chrome() in frappe/utils/print_format_generator.py). Also read for report PDFs in frappe/utils/print_format.py. The print view shows "Repeat Header and Footer is disabled" under the Letter Head field when it is off. Print the PDF (print_generated_pdf) 0 The Print button in the print view prints the generated PDF instead of the browser page (printit() in frappe/printing/page/print/print.js). PDF Generator (pdf_generator) PlutoPrint The site default PDF engine, chrome or PlutoPrint. resolve_pdf_generator() in frappe/utils/print_utils.py uses it only when the call and the Print Format give no engine. It uses chrome instead of PlutoPrint when PlutoPrint is not installed or the format uses JavaScript, CSS grid or Print Designer. Max Bulk Print Documents (max_bulk_print_docs) 100 Maximum documents in one bulk PDF (download_multi_pdf and download_multi_pdf_async in frappe/utils/print_format.py). If 0, the max_bulk_print_docs site config key is used, then 100. Max Concurrent Bulk Exports Per User (max_concurrent_bulk_exports) 5 Maximum background bulk PDF jobs one user can have queued or running. If 0, the max_concurrent_bulk_exports site config key is used, then 5. PDF Page Size (pdf_page_size) A4 The default paper size for PDFs (frappe/utils/pdf_generator/browser.py, page_size_mm() in frappe/utils/print_format_generator.py). Also the default of Page Size in the bulk print dialog and the report print page. The print view Paper Size field and a builder layout can override it for one print. Options: A0 to A9, B0 to B10, C5E, Comm10E, DLE, Executive, Folio, Ledger, Legal, Letter, Tabloid, Custom. PDF Page Height (in mm) (pdf_page_height) empty Page height when the size is Custom. Shows only then. Default 297 mm in the new renderer when empty. PDF Page Width (in mm) (pdf_page_width) empty Page width when the size is Custom. Shows only then. Default 210 mm in the new renderer when empty.

Validation: when pdf_page_size is Custom, height and width must not be zero. The controller throws "Page height and width cannot be zero".

docs.title: Page Settings
docs.text:
Field Default Effect Print with letterhead (with_letterhead) 1 Used when the caller does not say if a letter head is wanted: frappe/www/printview.py, the new renderer, the email composer, and Notification print attachments (print_letterhead). Allow Print for Draft (allow_print_for_draft) 1 Lets users print draft documents of submittable DocTypes. Enforced on the server by validate_print_for_docstatus() in frappe/www/printview.py, for every renderer and for attach_print. In the desk, frappe.model.can_print_docstatus() hides print for drafts, and bulk print skips them. An Auto Repeat that emails a print of drafts fails validation when it is off. Always add "Draft" Heading for printing draft documents (add_draft_heading) 1 Adds a "Draft" heading to prints of draft submittable documents (templates/print_formats/standard_macros.html, templates/print_format/print_format.html, frappe/utils/typst_emitter.py). Allow page break inside tables (allow_page_break_inside_tables) 0 When off, templates/styles/standard.css adds page-break-inside: avoid to table td div, so a cell does not split across pages. Allow Print for Cancelled (allow_print_for_cancelled) 0 Lets users print cancelled documents. Same server and desk checks as allow_print_for_draft.

The Administrator user can select draft and cancelled documents in bulk print, but the server check still applies.

docs.title: Print Server
docs.text:
Field Default Effect Enable Print Server (enable_print_server) 0 The print view gets a Select Network Printer menu item. Print sends the PDF to a CUPS printer from Network Printer Settings with frappe.utils.print_format.print_by_server. The server needs pycups.

Warning

The field has depends_on: enable_print_server, so it depends on itself. While it is off, the form hides it. Set it from code if you need it.

docs.title: Raw Printing
docs.text: Field Default Effect Enable Raw Printing (enable_raw_printing) 0 Shows Print Formats with Raw Printing in the print view format list (get_print_formats() in frappe/public/js/frappe/model/meta.js). Adds the Raw Printing Setting menu item, which maps formats to printers for QZ Tray.

docs.title: Print Style
docs.text: Field Default Effect Print Style (print_style) Redesign The default Print Style. Its CSS is added after templates/styles/standard.css (get_print_style() in frappe/www/printview.py). The new renderer uses it when the print has no style. Boot puts the rendered CSS in frappe.boot.print_css. A disabled Print Style is ignored. Print Style Preview (print_style_preview) HTML Shows the preview image of the selected Print Style in the form. Client side only.

docs.title: Fonts
docs.text: Field Default Effect Font (font) Default Font of HTML prints when the Print Format sets no font (get_font() in frappe/www/printview.py). Options: Default, Helvetica Neue, Arial, Helvetica, Inter, Verdana, Monospace. Default uses Inter and system fonts. The CSS in frappe.boot.print_css always uses the default font. Font Size (font_size) empty In points. When set, get_print_style() adds .print-format { font-size: <n>pt; } after the Print Style CSS. Empty or 0 keeps the size of the style.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
Read values in Python:

import frappe

size = frappe.db.get_single_value("Print Settings", "pdf_page_size")  # "A4"
settings = frappe.get_cached_doc("Print Settings")
settings.with_letterhead  # 1

Read values in the desk:

const print_settings = frappe.model.get_doc(":Print Settings", "Print Settings");
print_settings.allow_print_for_draft;
  • on_update calls frappe.clear_cache(). Reload the desk to get the new boot values.
  • A print request can override some values for one print with the settings argument (JSON). get_allowed_print_settings_override() in frappe/www/printview.py keeps only pdf_page_size, pdf_page_height, pdf_page_width, page_orientation, print_font, and the print toggles that the document returns from get_print_settings(). It never accepts allow_print_for_draft or allow_print_for_cancelled.
  • before_print(self, settings) on a controller gets the Print Settings dict.
  • The pdf_generator hook in frappe/hooks.py lists the engine functions. An app can add an engine. See Print Formats.
  • frappe.printing.doctype.print_settings.print_settings.is_print_server_enabled is a whitelisted method that returns enable_print_server. Frappe code does not call it.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• A Print Format with its own PDF Generator wins over this setting. When you save a Print Format with no engine, its validate fills in the engine that applies at that time. A later change of the site default does not change that format.
  • allow_print_for_draft and allow_print_for_cancelled apply only to submittable DocTypes.
  • Desk users keep the old boot values until they reload the page.

docs.title: Security, Session Default and Log Settings
docs.text: This page is the field reference for three Single DocTypes: Security Settings, Session Default Settings and Log Settings. Only the System Manager role can read and write them. For the general rules about settings pages, caching and code access, see How Settings Work.

docs.title: Security Settings
docs.text:
Security Settings builds the security.txt file (RFC 9116) that tells security researchers how to report a vulnerability. Open it at /desk/security-settings. Only System Manager can edit it. Password policy, login and session options are not here. They are in System Settings.

Frappe serves the file at /.well-known/security.txt (frappe/app.py). It serves the file only when the request scheme is https. On plain http the route returns 404 Not Found. The form shows a banner about this (security_settings.js).

docs.title: Security.txt
docs.text:
Field Default Effect Expires (public_expires) empty The Expires: line. Empty means one year from the time of the request. The value is read in the system time zone and written in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). validate rejects a date that is not in the future. A daily job emails System Managers 30, 15, 7 and 1 days before this date. Contact (public_contacts) empty Table of Security Settings Contact rows. Each row is one Contact: line. Empty means Contact: https://security.frappe.io. Preferred Language (public_languages) empty Table MultiSelect of Security Settings Language rows (Link to Language). Written as one Preferred-Languages: line, comma separated. Empty means en. Policy (public_policy) empty The Policy: line. Empty means https://frappe.io/security. validate rejects a value that does not start with https://. Preview (security_txt) computed Read only. Shows the full file text. It is a Python property on the controller, not a stored value.

Security Settings Contact row fields:

Field Default Effect Type (type) none, required Website, Email or Phone. Sets the validation and the URI prefix. Contact (contact) none, required Email is validated as an email address and gets the mailto: prefix. Phone is validated as a phone number and gets the tel: prefix. Website must be a valid URL that starts with https://.

Security Settings Language row fields:

Field Default Effect Language (language) none, required Link to Language. The language code goes into Preferred-Languages.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• Read the file text in Python: frappe.get_doc("Security Settings").security_txt. Each line group comes from a property: public_policy_section, public_contacts_section, public_languages_section, public_expires_section.
  • The daily_maintenance scheduler event runs frappe.core.doctype.security_settings.security_settings_alert.check_security_txt_expiry. It sends the email template security_txt_expiry_alert to all System Managers. It does nothing when public_expires is empty.
  • The output on a new site:
# Read our security policy before reporting an issue
Policy: https://frappe.io/security

# Our security address
Contact: https://security.frappe.io

# We prefer talking in
Preferred-Languages: en

Expires: 2027-11-22T11:03:34Z

docs.title: Session Default Settings
docs.text: Session Default Settings selects the DocTypes for which each user can set a session default. A session default is a user default that fills Link fields in new documents. Open it at /desk/session-default-settings. Only System Manager can edit it.

docs.title: Session Defaults
docs.text:
Field Default Effect Session Defaults (session_defaults) empty Table of Session Default rows. Each row adds one Link field, labeled "Default ", to the user's Session Defaults panel.

Session Default row fields:

Field Default Effect Document Type (ref_doctype) none, required Link to DocType. The form filter (session_default_settings.js) shows only DocTypes that are not Single and not child tables.

How users set the values:

  1. Open the user menu in the sidebar and select Settings.
  2. Open the Session Defaults tab.
  3. Set a value for each DocType and click Save.

The tab is built in frappe/public/js/frappe/ui/user_settings_dialog.js from frappe.boot.session_defaults. If the table is empty, the tab shows "No session defaults configured." The Configure action opens Session Default Settings. Users without permission get a "Not Permitted" error there.

How the values take effect:

  • Each value is stored as a user default with the key frappe.scrub(ref_doctype). For example, Sample Item becomes sample_item.
  • In a new document, a Link field whose fieldname matches the key gets the value (frappe/model/create_new.py). User permissions can override it.
  • After a save, the desk clears the cache and reloads (frappe.ui.toolbar.clear_cache).
  • The on_logout hook runs clear_session_defaults. It deletes these user defaults, so the values last until the user logs out.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• frappe.core.doctype.session_default_settings.session_default_settings.get_session_default_values returns the field list as a JSON string. frappe/public/js/frappe/desk.js calls it at desk start through frappe.ui.toolbar.fetch_session_defaults and stores it in frappe.boot.session_defaults.
  • set_session_default_values(default_values) calls frappe.defaults.set_user_default for each key. It returns "success", or None on the first error.
  • Read a session default in Python with frappe.defaults.get_user_default("sample_item").
  • frappe.ui.toolbar.setup_session_defaults (an older prompt dialog) is still defined in toolbar.js, but no code in Frappe calls it.

docs.title: Log Settings
docs.text: Log Settings sets how many days Frappe keeps the records of each log DocType. Open it at /desk/log-settings. Only System Manager can edit it. For the log DocTypes themselves, see Logs and Monitoring.

docs.title: Logs to Clear
docs.text:
Field Default Effect Logs to Clear (logs_to_clear) filled from the default_log_clearing_doctypes hook Table of Logs To Clear rows. The daily job deletes old records of each DocType in the table.

Logs To Clear row fields:

Field Default Effect Log DocType (ref_doctype) none, required Link to DocType. The link search (get_log_doctypes) shows only DocTypes that are not Single, not child tables and that support log clearing. Clear Logs After (days) (days) 30 Records older than this number of days are deleted. Passed as days to the DocType's clear_old_logs.

Validation in LogSettings.validate:

  1. Rows for a DocType without a clear_old_logs static method are removed with a message.
  2. Duplicate rows for one DocType are removed.
  3. Every DocType in the default_log_clearing_doctypes hook that is missing from the table is added. Its retention is the last value in the hook. A message lists the added DocTypes.

You cannot remove a default log DocType for good. The next save or the next daily run adds it again. To keep its records longer, set a higher days value.

Default retentions that Frappe ships in frappe/hooks.py:

Log DocType Days Error Log, Prepared Report 14 Scheduled Job Log, Submission Queue, Background Task 7 Email Queue, Automation Run, MapReduce Job, Webhook Request Log, Unhandled Email, Reminder, OAuth Bearer Token, Email Queue Recipient, Attachment Queue 30 DuckDB Sync 45 Integration Request, Activity Log, Route History, API Request Log, Flow Session 90

Email Queue Recipient is a placeholder. Email Queue clears its recipients.

docs.title: Log Setting User
docs.text: Log Setting User is a child DocType with one field, User (user, Link to User, required). No DocType uses it as a table. It is not read by Frappe code.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• The daily_maintenance scheduler event runs frappe.core.doctype.log_settings.log_settings.run_log_clean_up. It removes unsupported rows, adds default rows, saves, then calls clear_old_logs(days=...) for each row and commits after each DocType.
  • To make your own log DocType clearable, add a static method clear_old_logs to its controller, then list it in your app's hooks:
# sample_app/sample_app/doctype/sample_log/sample_log.py
import frappe
from frappe.model.document import Document
from frappe.query_builder import Interval
from frappe.query_builder.functions import Now


class SampleLog(Document):
    @staticmethod
    def clear_old_logs(days=30):
        table = frappe.qb.DocType("Sample Log")
        frappe.db.delete(table, filters=(table.creation < (Now() - Interval(days=days))))

# sample_app/hooks.py
default_log_clearing_doctypes = {
    "Sample Log": 30,
}
  • Add or change a row from code with LogSettings.register_doctype(doctype, days=30), then save the document.
  • For a very large log table, use the CLI. It copies recent rows to a new table and swaps the tables, which is faster than a large DELETE. It works only for DocTypes in the default_log_clearing_doctypes hook. It takes a backup of the table first unless you pass --no-backup.
bench --site frappe.localhost clear-log-table --doctype "Error Log" --days 30

Warning

Always pass --days. The option has no default. Without it, days is None, which cint turns into 0, so the command removes all records of the DocType.

docs.title: System Settings
docs.text:
System Settings is the Single DocType with the site-wide settings: regional formats, login, passwords, email, files, backups, background jobs and AI agents. Open it at /desk/system-settings. Only the System Manager role can read and write it. Changes apply to all users after you save. Users see desk changes after they reload the page. For how Single DocTypes, caching and boot data work, see How Settings Work.

The form has ten tabs: Details, Login, Password, Email, Files, App, Display, Backups, Advanced and AI Agents. The tables below list every field. "Default" is the default in the DocType JSON. A field with no default in the JSON shows "none". The setup wizard sets some of these values. See Values set by the setup wizard.

Most fields are read on the server with frappe.get_system_settings("<fieldname>"). Desk code reads frappe.boot.sysdefaults through frappe.defaults.get_default() or frappe.defaults.is_enabled().

docs.title: Details (first section)
docs.text: Field Default Effect Country (country) none Desk loads regional/<country>.js and regional/<country>_list.js of each DocType (frappe/desk/form/meta.py). Workspace links with Only for show only for this country (frappe/desk/desktop.py). Default country of the Phone control (frappe/public/js/frappe/form/controls/phone.js, fallback India). Used to shorten numbers in charts and number cards. The Country document is sent in the boot data. Language (language) none Required. Default language for users with no language on their User record (frappe/translate.py). On save, it is also set as the global default lang. If it changes, the form reloads the page. Time Zone (time_zone) none Required. The controller checks the value against zoneinfo.available_timezones() when it changes. Server dates and times use it (frappe.utils.get_system_timezone, fallback Asia/Kolkata). Sent to the desk as frappe.boot.time_zone.system. A user can set a different time zone on the User record. Currency (currency) none Default display currency. Used for Currency fields with no currency (frappe/utils/formatters.py, frappe/public/js/frappe/utils/number_format.js, frappe/public/js/frappe/model/meta.js with fallback USD). Enable Onboarding (enable_onboarding) 0 Shows module onboarding blocks in workspaces (frappe/desk/desktop.py) and UI form tours (frappe/desk/doctype/form_tour/form_tour.py). The setup wizard sets it to 1. Disable Document Sharing (disable_document_sharing) 0 Denies the share permission (frappe/permissions.py). The desk hides Share for all users except Administrator (frappe/public/js/frappe/model/model.js). Assigning a document to a user without permission fails, because Frappe cannot share it (frappe/desk/form/assign_to.py). Application Name (app_name) Frappe Hidden. Fallback when App Name in Website Settings is empty. Used for the login page title, the desk page title, the email brand name and the login link email (frappe/www/login.py, frappe/www/desk.py, frappe/email/email_body.py). Setup Complete (setup_complete) 0 Hidden and read only. Frappe writes it from Installed Application after the setup wizard (frappe/desk/page/setup_wizard/setup_wizard.py). The desk uses frappe.is_setup_complete() instead of this field.

docs.title: Date and Number Format
docs.text:
Field Default Effect Date Format (date_format) none Required. Options: yyyy-mm-dd, dd-mm-yyyy, dd/mm/yyyy, dd.mm.yyyy, mm/dd/yyyy, mm-dd-yyyy. Used to show and parse dates on the server (frappe/locale.py) and in the desk (frappe/public/js/frappe/utils/datetime.js, frappe/public/js/frappe/form/controls/date.js). Also used for date cells in Excel exports (frappe/utils/xlsxutils.py). Time Format (time_format) HH:mm:ss Required. HH:mm:ss or HH:mm. Used for Time and Datetime fields on the server and in the desk. Number Format (number_format) none Required. For example #,###.##, #.###,## or #,##,###.##. Sets the group and decimal separators (frappe/model/meta.py, frappe/public/js/frappe/utils/number_format.js). Use Number Format from Currency (use_number_format_from_currency) 0 Uses the Number Format of the Currency record for currency values, if it has one. Read on the server in frappe/model/meta.py and in the desk in number_format.js. First Day of the Week (first_day_of_the_week) Sunday First day in the date picker and calendars (frappe/public/js/frappe/utils/datetime.js) and in charts (frappe/public/js/frappe/ui/island/loader.js). Float Precision (float_precision) none Decimal places for number fields, other than Currency, with no precision. Server fallback is 3 (frappe/model/meta.py). Currency Precision (currency_precision) none Decimal places for Currency fields with no precision. If empty, the precision comes from the number format (frappe/model/meta.py, frappe/utils/data.py). Rounding Method (rounding_method) Banker's Rounding (legacy) Banker's Rounding (legacy), Banker's Rounding or Commercial Rounding. Used by frappe.utils.rounded() and flt() on the server and by number_format.js in the desk. The form asks you to confirm a change. After you move away from the legacy option, the form hides it. If the value changes, the form reloads the page. Show Absolute Datetime in Timeline (show_absolute_datetime_in_timeline) 0 Shows the full date and time instead of "2 hours ago" in the form timeline and sidebar (frappe/public/js/frappe/form/footer/base_timeline.js, frappe/public/js/frappe/form/sidebar/form_sidebar.js). Each user can also turn it on for themselves.

Note

A user's Language can override the formats. When you set a language on a User, Frappe copies the Date Format, Time Format, Number Format and First Day of the Week of that Language record into the user's defaults. On the server, frappe/locale.py also reads the Language record of the current language before it reads System Settings.

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text: Field Default Effect Apply Strict User Permissions (apply_strict_user_permissions) 0 When a user has a User Permission for a DocType, documents with an empty link field to that DocType are hidden. When off, they are shown. Read in frappe/permissions.py, frappe/model/db_query.py, frappe/database/query.py, frappe/model/mapper.py and frappe/core/doctype/file/file.py. See User Permissions. Show External Link Warning (show_external_link_warning) Never Never, Ask or Always. Shows a warning dialog before the desk opens a link to another host. With Ask, the user can turn off the warning for one host in the browser. Sent as frappe.boot.show_external_link_warning and read by frappe/public/js/frappe/router.js.

docs.title: Login (first section)
docs.text: Field Default Effect Session Expiry (idle timeout) (session_expiry) 170:00 Idle time in hh:mm before a session ends. The controller rejects other formats. If empty, the server uses 240:00:00 (frappe/sessions.py). Document Share Key Expiry (in Days) (document_share_key_expiry) 30 Days until a new Document Share Key expires. These keys are used in web view links in emails. If 0, the server uses 90 (frappe/core/doctype/document_share_key/document_share_key.py). Allow only one session per user (deny_multiple_sessions) 0 At login, Frappe ends the other sessions of the user (frappe/auth.py). The site config key deny_multiple_sessions does the same. Disable Username/Password Login (disable_user_pass_login) 0 /api/method/login with a password fails, and the login page hides the password form (frappe/auth.py, frappe/www/login.html). The controller requires an enabled Social Login Key, enabled LDAP or Login with email link first. Max signups allowed per hour (max_signups_allowed_per_hour) 300 Website sign-up stops for the hour after this number of new users (frappe/core/doctype/user/user.py).

docs.title: Login Methods
docs.text: Field Default Effect Allow Login using Mobile Number (allow_login_using_mobile_number) 0 Users can log in with the Mobile No of their User record. The login page label shows "Mobile" (frappe/www/login.py, frappe/core/doctype/user/user.py). Allow Login using User Name (allow_login_using_user_name) 0 Users can log in with their Username. The login page label shows "Username". Login with email link (login_with_email_link) 1 Shows the login link option on the login page. frappe.www.login.send_login_link sends a one-time login link by email. Login with email link expiry (in minutes) (login_with_email_link_expiry) 10 Shows when Login with email link is on. Minutes until the link expires. If 0, the server uses 10. Rate limit for email link login (rate_limit_email_link_login) none Shows when Login with email link is on. Maximum login link requests per hour. If empty or 0, the server uses 5 (frappe/www/login.py).

docs.title: Brute Force Security
docs.text: Field Default Effect Allow Consecutive Login Attempts (allow_consecutive_login_attempts) 10 Failed logins before Frappe locks the account. 0 turns off the lock (frappe/auth.py). Allow Login After Fail (allow_login_after_fail) 60 Seconds the account stays locked.

docs.title: Two Factor Authentication
docs.text: Field Default Effect Enable Two Factor Auth (enable_two_factor_auth) 0 Turns on two-factor authentication (frappe/twofactor.py). When you turn it on, the controller sets Two Factor Authentication on the role All. With method SMS, the controller requires SMS Gateway URL in SMS Settings. When off, the controller clears the two bypass fields below. Bypass Two Factor Auth for users who login from restricted IP Address (bypass_2fa_for_retricted_ip_users) 0 Shows when two-factor is on. Users who log in from an IP in their Restrict IP list skip two-factor. Bypass restricted IP Address check If Two Factor Auth Enabled (bypass_restrict_ip_check_if_2fa_enabled) 0 Shows when two-factor is on. All users can log in from any IP. Each user can also have this flag on the User record (frappe/auth.py). Two Factor Authentication method (two_factor_method) OTP App Shows when two-factor is on. OTP App, SMS or Email. OTP Issuer Name (otp_issuer_name) Frappe Framework Shows when two-factor is on. Name shown in the authenticator app and in OTP emails. OTP SMS Template (otp_sms_template) none Shows when the method is SMS. Jinja text of the OTP SMS. It must contain {{ otp }}. If empty, Frappe sends "Your verification code is {{otp}}".

docs.title: Password
docs.text: Field Default Effect Logout All Sessions on Password Reset (logout_on_password_reset) 1 Ends all sessions of a user after a password change or OTP secret reset (frappe/core/doctype/user/user.py, frappe/twofactor.py). Force User to Reset Password (force_user_to_reset_password) none Days. At login, users whose last password reset is older than this must reset the password. Standard users are excluded (frappe/auth.py). When you first set it, Frappe sets Last Password Reset Date to today on users that have none. Reset Password Link Expiry Duration (reset_password_link_expiry_duration) 1200 Duration in seconds. A reset link older than this fails. The reset email shows the expiry in minutes. 0 means no expiry. Password Reset Link Generation Limit (password_reset_limit) 3 Reset link requests allowed per hour (frappe/utils/password.py). Users with System Manager get 1000. Enable Password Policy (enable_password_policy) 1 Checks password strength with zxcvbn (frappe/core/doctype/user/user.py, frappe/utils/password_strength.py). When off, the controller clears Minimum Password Score. Minimum Password Score (minimum_password_score) 2 Shows when the policy is on. Score from 1 to 4 that a new password must reach. The controller requires a value when the policy is on.

docs.title: Email
docs.text: Field Default Effect Email Footer Address (email_footer_address) none Organization name and address in the footer of outgoing emails. Read as a global default in frappe/email/email_body.py. Email Retry Limit (email_retry_limit) 3 Send attempts before an Email Queue record is set to Error (frappe/email/doctype/email_queue/email_queue.py). If 0, the server uses 3. Disable Standard Email Footer (disable_standard_email_footer) 0 Removes the footer from the default_mail_footer hook. Read as a global default in frappe/email/email_body.py. Hide footer in auto email reports (hide_footer_in_auto_email_reports) 0 Removes the footer from Auto Email Report emails (frappe/templates/emails/auto_email_report.html). Include Web View Link in Email (attach_view_link) 1 Adds a web view link of the document to emails sent with a print format (frappe/core/doctype/communication/mixins.py). Store Attached PDF Document (store_attached_pdf_document) 1 Saves the PDF attached to an email as a private File on the Communication (frappe/email/doctype/email_queue/email_queue.py). This uses storage. Welcome Email Template (welcome_email_template) none Email Template for the welcome email to new users (frappe/core/doctype/user/user.py). Reset Password Template (reset_password_template) none Email Template for the password reset email.

docs.title: Files
docs.text: Field Default Effect Max File Size (MB) (max_file_size) none Upload size limit. If empty, Frappe uses max_file_size in site config (bytes), then 25 MB (frappe/core/api/file.py). Sent as frappe.boot.max_file_size. Max Zip Extract Size (MB) (max_zip_extract_size) none Maximum total size of the files in an extracted ZIP. Fallback is max_zip_extract_size in site config, then 25 MB. Allow Guests to Upload Files (allow_guests_to_upload_files) 0 Lets Guest call frappe.handler.upload_file, for example from a web form. Allowed Doctypes for Guest Uploads (allowed_doctypes_for_guest_uploads) none Shows when guest uploads are on. One DocType per line. If set, guests can upload only for these DocTypes (frappe/handler.py). Force Web Capture Mode for Uploads (force_web_capture_mode_for_uploads) 0 The camera dialog uses the web capture mode also on mobile devices (frappe/public/js/frappe/ui/capture.js). Strip EXIF tags from uploaded images (strip_exif_metadata_from_uploaded_images) 1 Removes EXIF data from uploaded JPEG images (frappe/core/doctype/file/file.py). Only allow System Managers to upload public files (only_allow_system_managers_to_upload_public_files) 0 Other users cannot make a file public. The file uploader does not let them make a file public (frappe/public/js/frappe/utils/utils.js), and the server rejects it (frappe/core/doctype/file/file.py). Delete Background Exported Reports After (Hours) (delete_background_exported_reports_after) 48 Hours to keep report files exported in the background and sent by email. The hourly_maintenance job frappe.desk.utils.delete_old_exported_report_files deletes older files. Allowed File Extensions (allowed_file_extensions) none One extension per line. Empty allows all. The controller saves them in upper case. The server checks uploads in a request (frappe/core/doctype/file/file.py). The uploader limits the file picker (frappe/public/js/frappe/file_uploader/file_uploader.bundle.js).

docs.title: App
docs.text: Field Default Effect Default App (default_app) none The app that opens after login. Options are the installed apps. The Default App of a User overrides it (frappe/apps.py).

docs.title: Display
docs.text: Field Default Effect Disable System Update Notification (disable_system_update_notification) 0 Stops the weekly update check and the update popup for System Managers (frappe/utils/change_log.py). Disable Change Log Notification (disable_change_log_notification) 0 Stops the "Updated To A New Version" dialog after an update (frappe/public/js/frappe/desk.js). Hide Empty Read-Only Fields (hide_empty_read_only_fields) 1 Hides read-only fields with no value in forms (frappe/public/js/frappe/form/controls/base_control.js). Disable Product Suggestion (disable_product_suggestion) 0 Hides the promotional banners in the sidebar. They show only to System Managers (frappe/public/js/frappe/ui/sidebar/sidebar.js). Use Classic Charts (use_classic_charts) 0 Draws legacy chart configs and number cards the old way, with frappe-charts (frappe/public/js/frappe/ui/chart.js). Sites updated from an earlier version start with this on.

docs.title: Backups
docs.text: Field Default Effect Number of Backups (backup_limit) 3 Backups that the Download Backups page lists and keeps. The hourly_maintenance job delete_downloadable_backups deletes older ones (frappe/desk/page/backups/backups.py). The controller sets values below 1 to 1. Encrypt Backups (encrypt_backup) 0 Encrypts new backups and adds -enc to the file names (frappe/utils/backups.py). See Backups.

docs.title: Reports
docs.text: Field Default Effect Max auto email report per user (max_auto_email_report_per_user) 20 Enabled Auto Email Report records per user. The site config key max_reports_per_user overrides it (frappe/email/doctype/auto_email_report/auto_email_report.py). Max Report Rows (max_report_rows) 100000 If a query or script report returns more rows, the browser does not show them and asks the user to export (frappe/public/js/frappe/views/reports/query_report.js).

docs.title: Snapshot Reports
docs.text: Field Default Effect Enable Snapshot Reports (enable_snapshot_reports) 0 When it or Frequency changes, the controller deletes and creates the DuckDB Sync scheduled job (frappe.database.duckdb.database.start_duckdb_sync). Sync In Batches (sync_in_batch) 1 Shows when snapshot reports are on. On: the sync uses pyarrow. Off: it uses the DuckDB extension (frappe/core/doctype/duckdb_sync/duckdb_sync.py). Frequency (frequency) Weekly Shows when snapshot reports are on. Daily runs at 00:00 each day. Weekly runs at 00:00 on Sunday. Sync Timeout (Seconds) (sync_timeout) none Shows when snapshot reports are on. Timeout of the sync jobs. If empty, the server uses 1500 seconds.

docs.title: Background Workers
docs.text: Field Default Effect Enable Scheduled Jobs (enable_scheduler) 0 Hidden. If off, the scheduler does not enqueue scheduled jobs (frappe/utils/scheduler.py). The setup wizard sets it to 1. Use bench --site <site> enable-scheduler or disable-scheduler. If disable_scheduler is set in site config, the scheduler does not run, whatever this value is. Submission Queue Timeout (submission_queue_timeout) 600 Seconds that a queued submit or cancel can run in the background (frappe/core/doctype/submission_queue/submission_queue.py). The controller rejects values above 3600. Run Jobs only Daily if Inactive For (Days) (dormant_days) 4 On Frappe Cloud, scheduled jobs run only once a day on sites with no activity for this many days. 0 turns this off. Not used on other hosts or in developer mode (frappe/utils/scheduler.py).

docs.title: Telemetry
docs.text: Field Default Effect Show Full Error and Allow Reporting of Issues to the Developer (allow_error_traceback) 1 System users get the full traceback in error responses (frappe/utils/response.py). Website users never get it. Allow Sending Usage Data for Improving Applications (enable_telemetry) 1 Turns on usage telemetry and the Sentry error DSN in the boot data (frappe/boot.py, frappe/utils/telemetry/pulse/client.py). Telemetry is also off in developer mode. The setup wizard sets it from the user's choice.

docs.title: Search
docs.text: Field Default Effect Link Field Results Limit (link_field_results_limit) 10 Results in the Link field dropdown (frappe/public/js/frappe/form/controls/link.js). The controller sets an empty value to 10 and limits it to 50. Allow Clearing Link Fields (allow_clearing_link_fields) 0 Adds a clear (x) button to Link fields when combobox fields are off. Enable Combobox Fields (Beta) (enable_combobox_link_field) 0 Uses the combobox control for Link, Autocomplete and MultiSelect fields (frappe/public/js/frappe/form/controls/link_combobox.js). When on, the boot data includes link_settings (frappe/boot.py).

docs.title: API Logging
docs.text: Field Default Effect Log API Requests (log_api_requests) 0 Saves each /api request as an API Request Log with path, user and method (frappe/api/__init__.py).

docs.title: MCP Settings
docs.text: Field Default Effect Enable MCP (enable_mcp) 1 Turns on the MCP endpoint /api/v2/mcp (frappe/mcp/__init__.py). The form shows the endpoint URL and a link to OAuth Settings. Server Name (server_name) none Name sent to MCP clients. If empty, Frappe uses the host name (frappe/mcp/protocol.py). Agent Instructions (agent_instructions) none Text sent to AI agents when they connect. Describe what the site is for and how your team uses it.

docs.title: frappectl
docs.text:
This section has only an HTML field (frappectl_help) with install and login commands for the frappectl command-line client. It stores no value.

See MCP and Discovery.

docs.title: Values set by the setup wizard
docs.text: The setup wizard saves float_precision 3, rounding_method Banker's Rounding, enable_scheduler 1, backup_limit 3, and the country, language, time zone, currency and formats that the user selects. Date and time formats come from the Country record. If the wizard gets no country, it writes these values with frappe.db.set_single_value and fills empty required fields with yyyy-mm-dd, HH:mm:ss and #,###.##.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
frappe.get_system_settings("date_format")                    # cached
frappe.db.get_single_value("System Settings", "backup_limit")  # cast to int
settings = frappe.get_single("System Settings")
settings.email_retry_limit = 5
settings.save()
  • frappe.get_system_settings(key) reads the document from the client cache and keeps it on frappe.local for the request. frappe.db.get_system_setting(key) is the same function.
  • validate checks the password score, time zone, session expiry format, two-factor and SMS setup, the username/password lockout, the backup limit, file extensions, the OTP SMS template, the link field limit and the submission queue timeout. It also schedules snapshot reports.
  • on_update saves each changed value as a global default (frappe.db.set_default), sets the default language, and clears the System Settings cache (clear_system_settings_cache). A changed global default clears the full site cache, so the next boot of each user has the new values.
  • The desk reads most values from frappe.boot.sysdefaults, which comes from the global defaults. frappe.db.set_single_value("System Settings", ...) does not update the global defaults, so the desk keeps the old value. Use doc.save() when the desk must see the change.
  • The email footer fields (email_footer_address, disable_standard_email_footer) are read with frappe.db.get_default(). They also need doc.save().
  • Other boot keys from System Settings: frappe.boot.time_zone, frappe.boot.show_external_link_warning, frappe.boot.max_file_size and frappe.boot.link_settings.
  • To set values when your app is installed, use an after_install hook and doc.save(). See How Settings Work.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Disable Username/Password Login fails unless a Social Login Key, LDAP or Login with email link is enabled. This prevents a lockout.
  • Turning on Enable Two Factor Auth sets two-factor on the role All. Turning it off does not clear the flag on the role.
  • enable_scheduler is 0 by default. If it is off, scheduled jobs, such as the email queue flush, do not run.
  • Changing Rounding Method on a site with data can change totals that Frappe calculates again.
